records.source: Some operators are missing (``aten::linalg_qr.out`` among them). ``PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1`` makes those run on the CPU instead of raising, so this module sets it when it selects MPS.

records.context: the device accepts ``torch.bfloat16``. Probed rather than assumed from the backend name, because it is the one capability that moves with the torch version: Metal gained it after 2.2, and 2.2.2 is the last x86-64 macOS wheel, so the same backend answers differently on an Intel Mac and an Apple Silicon one. Cellpose's cpsam loads its weights in bfloat16 by default, so a wrong answer here is a TypeError at model construction.

Cellpose's cpsam loads its weights in bfloat16 by default, so a wrong answer here is a TypeError at model construction.

Probed í stað þess að viðurkenna frá nafni bakgrundsins, vegna þess að það er eina hæfileika sem fer með torch útgáfu: Metal fékk það eftir 2.2, og 2.2.2 er síðasta x86-64 macOS hjól, þannig að sama bakgrunda svara öðruvísi á Intel Mac og Apple Silicon einn. Cellpose cpsam ladda vægi sína í bfloat16 í upphafi, svo að rangt svarið hér er TypeError á mönnun byggingu.

records.context: ``use_bfloat16`` -- cpsam loads its weights in bfloat16 by default and Metal on torch 2.2 has no bfloat16, so the default is a ``TypeError: BFloat16 is not supported on MPS`` at construction. Measured on the reporting iMac; float32 weights work there at the cost of additional VRAM. CPU inference also uses float32: bfloat16 support does not imply native arithmetic, and emulation can be substantially slower. This matches Make Masks; float32 arithmetic need not produce identical predictions to bfloat16.
records.label: spacr.accelerator.cellpose_kwargs#4
records.source: ``use_bfloat16`` -- cpsam loads its weights in bfloat16 by default and Metal on torch 2.2 has no bfloat16, so the default is a ``TypeError: BFloat16 is not supported on MPS`` at construction. Measured on the reporting iMac; float32 weights work there at the cost of additional VRAM. CPU inference also uses float32: bfloat16 support does not imply native arithmetic, and emulation can be substantially slower. This matches Make Masks; float32 arithmetic need not produce identical predictions to bfloat16.
records.translation: ``use_bfloat16`` - cpsam lader vægi sína í bfloat16 í staðsetningu og Metal á torch 2.2 hefur engin bfLOat16, þannig að staðsetningin er ``TypeError: BFloat16 is not supported on MPS`` í byggingu. Miðarlega á upplýsingum í iMac; Float32 vægi vinna þar á kostnað af viðbótar VRAM. CPU niðurstöður notar einnig float32: bfloat16 stuðning þýðir ekki innlendar arithmetic, og emulans getur verið væsentligt hratt. Þetta leikur Make Masks; Float32 arithmetic þarf ekki að framleiða sömu fyrirspurn við bfloat16.

records.context: Annotation is the bottleneck in every screen. An extracted image region the model already calls with 0.999 teaches the model nothing when a human labels it; the extracted image regions worth a person's afternoon are the ones sitting on the decision boundary. This module turns an already-scored ``measurements.db`` into a work list ordered so the informative extracted image regions come first.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#1
records.source: Annotation is the bottleneck in every screen. A crop the model already calls with 0.999 teaches the model nothing when a human labels it; the crops worth a person's afternoon are the ones sitting on the decision boundary. This module turns an already-scored ``measurements.db`` into a work queue ordered so the informative crops come first.
records.translation: Annotation er flöskinn á hverjum skreymni. A myndskurður mynd svæðið sem myndavél þegar hringir með 0.999 kennir myndavélt ekkert þegar manninn merkir það; myndskurður mynd svæðum sem verðmætir eftir eftirliti einstaklinga eru þeir sem sitja á ákvörðun grænsi. Þessi móturinn breytir þegar ritað ``measurements.db`` í vinnuleikinn sem er beðið svo að upplýsingatæknir útgreið mynd svæðir koma fyrst.

records.context: **Already-annotated extracted image regions never enter the annotation work list.** ``NULL`` in the annotation column is the abstention marker — the extracted image region has not been looked at. ``0`` is a real class, and an annotation work list that re-serves it wastes exactly the resource this module exists to save. The two are distinguished by ``IS NULL``, never by falsiness. (Same convention as :mod:`spacr.agreement`.)
records.label: spacr.active_learning#6
records.source: **Already-annotated crops never enter the queue.** ``NULL`` in the annotation column is the abstention marker — the crop has not been looked at. ``0`` is a real class, and a queue that re-serves it wastes exactly the resource this module exists to save. The two are distinguished by ``IS NULL``, never by falsiness. (Same convention as :mod:`spacr.agreement`.)
records.translation: **Sjá notuð myndskurðir myndar svæðum aldrei inn í notkun vinnu listanum.** ``NULL`` á notkunum stólum er abstinensi markari - myndskurður myndar svæðinu hefur ekki verið skoðað. ``0`` er alvöru klás, og notkun vinnu lista sem endurþjónusta það eyðir nákvæmlega orsök þetta samfélagið er til að spara. Þessir tveir eru skilgreint með ``IS NULL``, aldrei með falsiði. (Sann konungur sem :mod:`spacr.agreement`)

records.context: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain extracted image regions on a real laboratory microplate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two microplate sample positions — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the annotation work list is diversified by default (round-robin across microplate sample positions) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many microplate sample positions the annotation work list actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#9
records.source: **Pure uncertainty ranking collapses onto one region of feature space.** The 100 most uncertain crops on a real plate are routinely 100 near copies from the same two wells — one ambiguity, labelled a hundred times, for almost the information of labelling it once. So the queue is diversified by default (round-robin across wells) and :func:`format_queue_summary` prints how many wells the queue actually covers. What that costs is stated plainly in :func:`build_queue`.
records.translation: **Pure óþekktar rannsaka krossar á einum svæðum af staðreyndahús.** 100 mest óþekkta myndarregionum á raunverulegu mikroregionum eru venjulega 100 nálægt kopíum frá sömu tveimur mikroregi sýnilegum stöðum. — 1 óþekkt, merkinn hundrað sinnum, fyrir nánast upplýsingar um að merkja það einu sinni. Þannig annotation vinnu lista er fjölbreytur í staðsetningu (round-robin í gegnum brunna) og :func:`format_queue_summary` sýnir hversu mörg mikróbstæða stöðu annotations vinnu listan virkilega dregur. Hvað kostnaður er greinilega sagt í :func:`build_queue`.

records.context: Return the round, label count, and four-decimal held-out accuracy.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.RoundResult.__repr__#0
records.source: Return the round, label count, and four-decimal held-out accuracy.
records.translation: Til baka runda, merki reikning, og fjórar-décimal held-out nákvæmni.

records.context: Return stop, trend, gain, and labels-in-window for diagnostics.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.StoppingVerdict.__repr__#0
records.source: Return stop, trend, gain, and labels-in-window for diagnostics.
records.translation: Til baka hætta, þendingu, vinnu, og merki-in-window fyrir merki.

records.context: Reads ``png_list`` read-only and returns one row per extracted image region still waiting for a label, ordered so the extracted image regions that would teach the model most come first.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#1
records.source: Reads ``png_list`` read-only and returns one row per crop still waiting for a label, ordered so the crops that would teach the model most come first.
records.translation: Lesa ``png_list`` lesið-eina og endurheimtir einn stefnu á myndskurði myndaregion enn að bíða eftir merki, svo beðið myndskurður myndaregi sem myndi læra mönnun mest koma fyrst.

records.context: keep at most this many extracted image regions.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#10
records.source: keep at most this many crops.
records.translation: geyma í flestir af þessum mörgum myndskurðum myndum svæðum.

records.context: **Already-annotated extracted image regions are excluded.** ``NULL`` in ``annotation_column`` means "not looked at"; anything else — *including 0* — means a human committed to a class. If the column does not exist at all, nothing has been annotated yet and every extracted image region is queued (with a note saying so). This is the same abstention convention as :mod:`spacr.agreement`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#2
records.source: **Already-annotated crops are excluded.** ``NULL`` in ``annotation_column`` means "not looked at"; anything else — *including 0* — means a human committed to a class. If the column does not exist at all, nothing has been annotated yet and every crop is queued (with a note saying so). This is the same abstention convention as :mod:`spacr.agreement`.
records.translation: **Sjá notuð myndskurðir myndar svæðum eru nefndar.** ``NULL`` í ``annotation_column`` þýðir "not looked at"; allt annað - *þar á meðal 0* - þýðir manneskjan að klás. ef stólinn er ekki til alls, ekkert hefur verið notuð enn og hvert myndskurður myndar svæðinu er quedued ( með notandi að segja svo). Þetta er sama abstinenti samning sem :mod:`spacr.agreement`.

records.context: **The annotation work list is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked extracted image regions are dealt round-robin across microplate sample positions: position 1 is still the single most uncertain extracted image region, but position 2 is the most uncertain extracted image region in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 extracted image regions routinely come from two microplate sample positions. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of microplate sample positions, the annotation work list will contain roughly one extracted image region from each of ``limit`` microplate sample positions and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.build_queue#3
records.source: **The queue is diversified by default, and that costs something.** With ``diversity='well'`` the ranked crops are dealt round-robin across wells: position 1 is still the single most uncertain crop, but position 2 is the most uncertain crop in a *different* well, which may be materially less uncertain than the runner-up overall. You give up some per-item uncertainty to stop the annotator labelling the same ambiguity a hundred times — the failure mode of pure uncertainty sampling, where the top 100 crops routinely come from two wells. If ``limit`` is smaller than the number of wells, the queue will contain roughly one crop from each of ``limit`` wells and none from the rest. Pass ``diversity='none'`` for the pure order, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` for other strata, or ``group_columns=[…]`` for your own — including a cluster id you computed from features, which is the more thorough diversification this trades away for not needing a feature matrix.
records.translation: **Törlist annotation er fjölbreytur í staðsetningu, og það kostar eitthvað.** Með ``diversity='well'`` ránuð af myndum svæðum eru meðhöndlað í kringum brunna: staðsetning 1 er enn einn mest óþekkt af myndu svæðum, en staðsetningar 2 er mest óhyggð af myndinni svæðum í *lík* brunnur, sem getur verið efni minna óhyggi en runner-up almennt. Ef ``limit`` er smá en fjölda brunna, mun tákn vinnu lista innihalda nánast einn myndskurð mynd svæðis frá hverjum ``limit`` mikróbstæður stöðum og enginn frá öðrum. Pass ``diversity='none'`` fyrir hreinu orði, ``'field'``/``'plate'`` fyrir aðra skál, eða ``group_columns=[…]`` fyrir eigin — þar á meðal klúster ID sem þú tækir frá eiginleika, sem er nákvæmari fjölbreytingu þetta versla út fyrir að þurfa ekki að virðingu matrix.

records.context: Resolve object identifiers to rows of extracted image regions, **in the caller's order**.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys#0
records.source: Resolve object keys to crop rows, **in the caller's order**.
records.translation: Hættu objektum í ránum af myndskurðum myndum, **í orði hringandi**.

records.context: Typed structured-data names distinguish objects with the same numeric label in one microscope field of view. ``png_list`` identifies the object type through the populated ``<type>_id`` column (:data:`PNG_ID_COLUMN_TYPES`), so nucleus 1 and pathogen 1 resolve independently. An untyped structured-data name selects the first matching extracted image region. If the table does not expose object-type columns, typed lookup falls back to the corresponding untyped structured-data name.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys#3
records.source: Typed keys distinguish objects with the same numeric label in one field. ``png_list`` identifies the object type through the populated ``<type>_id`` column (:data:`PNG_ID_COLUMN_TYPES`), so nucleus 1 and pathogen 1 resolve independently. An untyped key selects the first matching crop. If the table does not expose object-type columns, typed lookup falls back to the corresponding untyped key.
records.translation: Týptir uppbyggð gögnnafn skilja hlutur með sömu tölurlist í einum mikroskópum vöru. ``png_list`` skilja upp á gögn typi í gegnum uppbyggingu ``<type>_id`` stólum (:data:`PNG_ID_COLUMN_TYPES`), þannig að kjarna 1 og sýkill 1 leysa sjálfstætt. Untyped uppbyggður gögn-nafn velur fyrstu samankomandi útgreiningu gögn svæðið. Ef tólinn sýnir ekki uppbyggingar uppbygginga stólur, típtir lookup fallir aftur til viðeigandi untyped upbyggingu gögn nafn.

records.context: Escaped metadata components are resolved in both encoded and raw form. For example, :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys` represents a ``fieldID`` of ``'f_1'`` as ``'f%5F1'``, while a structured-data name assembled from extracted-image-region table columns contains the raw underscore.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys#4
records.source: Escaped metadata components are resolved in both encoded and raw form. For example, :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys` represents a ``fieldID`` of ``'f_1'`` as ``'f%5F1'``, while a key assembled from crop-table columns contains the raw underscore.
records.translation: Til dæmis, :func:`spacr.selection.object_keys` er ``fieldID`` af ``'f_1'`` eins og ``'f%5F1'``, en struktuð gögn nafn sem safnað er úr myndskurði mynd-region tólum inniheldur rauð subscore.

records.context: read the existing label too, so an already annotated extracted image region renders with its colour rather than blank.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys#9
records.source: read the existing label too, so an already annotated crop renders with its colour rather than blank.
records.translation: lesa núverandi merki líka, þannig að þegar notað myndskurðir myndarregion kemur með lituna en ekki hvít.

records.context: How much several score sets disagree about each extracted image region.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.disagreement#0
records.source: How much several score sets disagree about each crop.
records.translation: Hversu mörg skólar setur ekki samræmi um hvern myndskurður mynd svæðis.

records.context: The measures above see one model's opinion and call a 50/50 output "uncertain" whether the model is genuinely torn or merely mis-calibrated. An ensemble — several checkpoints, several folds, or several MC-dropout passes of one model — separates those: extracted image regions the members *disagree* about are where the model class itself is undecided (epistemic uncertainty), which is what a new label actually fixes.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.disagreement#1
records.source: The measures above see one model's opinion and call a 50/50 output "uncertain" whether the model is genuinely torn or merely mis-calibrated. An ensemble — several checkpoints, several folds, or several MC-dropout passes of one model — separates those: crops the members *disagree* about are where the model class itself is undecided (epistemic uncertainty), which is what a new label actually fixes.
records.translation: Þessir aðstæður sýna skilyrði einar mynda og kalla 50/50 útgang "uncertain" hvort mynda er alvöru orðin miskalibrated. A ensemble — nokkrar athygli punktur, nokkrar folds, eða nokkrar MC-dropout passes af einum mynda — skiljar þá: myndskurðir myndar svæðum meðlimir *disagree* um eru þar sem mynda klasa sjálfur er undecided (epistemic óvissu), sem er það sem nýja merki virkilega fixes.

records.context: sequence of M score arrays, each ``(N,)`` or ``(N, C)`` over the same n extracted image regions in the same order (a 3-D ``(M, N, C)`` array works too). Each member is coerced with :func:`as_probabilities`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.disagreement#2
records.source: sequence of M score arrays, each ``(N,)`` or ``(N, C)`` over the SAME N crops in the same order (a 3-D ``(M, N, C)`` array works too). Each member is coerced with :func:`as_probabilities`.
records.translation: Sækinu M skólanar, hver ``(N,)`` eða ``(N, C)`` yfir sama n myndskurður myndar svæðum í sömu orði (þróun 3-D ``(M, N, C)`` fer einnig). Hver meðlimur er þörf með :func:`as_probabilities`.

records.context: ``'bald'`` — mutual information ``H(mean p) − mean H(p)`` (Houlsby et al., 2011). 0 when the members agree, regardless of how uncertain they jointly are — so unlike ``entropy`` it does not fire on extracted image regions that are ambiguous.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.disagreement#4
records.source: ``'bald'`` — mutual information ``H(mean p) − mean H(p)`` (Houlsby et al., 2011). 0 when the members agree, regardless of how uncertain they jointly are — so unlike ``entropy`` it does not fire on crops that are ambiguous.
records.translation: ``'bald'`` — samskipti upplýsingar ``H(mean p) − mean H(p)`` (Houlsby et al., 2011). 0 þegar meðlimir eru sammála, óhátt hversu óþekkt þeir eru sameiginlega — svo mismunandi ``entropy`` það brennir ekki á myndskurði myndum svæðum sem eru tvöfaldur.

records.context: ``(N,)`` scores; NaN where any member is unusable for that extracted image region.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.disagreement#5
records.source: ``(N,)`` scores; NaN where any member is unusable for that crop.
records.translation: ``(N,)`` skóre; NaN þar sem einhver meðlimur er óþægilegt fyrir þessi myndskurðir myndaregion.

records.context: for fewer than one set, or sets of different shapes — a length mismatch means the members are not aligned to the same extracted image regions, and averaging them would be meaningless.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.disagreement#6
records.source: for fewer than one set, or sets of different shapes — a length mismatch means the members are not aligned to the same crops, and averaging them would be meaningless.
records.translation: fyrir minna en einn setur, eða setur af mismunandi formum — lengd mismatch þýðir að meðlimir eru ekki tengd við sömu myndskurði myndar svæðum, og að miðla þá væri óþægilegt.

records.context: The round number the next batch of labels belongs to.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.next_round#0
records.source: The round number the next batch of labels belongs to.
records.translation: Rúnum númer næsta uppsetningu merki er að.

records.label: spacr.active_learning.next_round#2
records.source: Round 0 is "before any model was retrained from inside Annotate" — the labels that seeded the loop. The first retrain produces round 1.

records.context: ``(N,)`` or ``(N, 1)`` — a **single-logit binary head**. Sigmoid, then expanded to ``[1 − p, p]`` so every measure sees two classes. Pushing this through a softmax instead would return a column of 1.0 — every extracted image region maximally certain, the whole ordering gone.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.probabilities_from_logits#2
records.source: ``(N,)`` or ``(N, 1)`` — a **single-logit binary head**. Sigmoid, then expanded to ``[1 − p, p]`` so every measure sees two classes. Pushing this through a softmax instead would return a column of 1.0 — every crop maximally certain, the whole ordering gone.
records.translation: ``(N,)`` eða ``(N, 1)`` — **single-logit binary heita**. Sigmoid, þá breytt til ``[1 − p, p]`` þannig að hvert mæli sé tveimur klásum. Hugsað þetta í gegnum softmax í staðinn myndi aftur kolumn 1.0 - hvert myndskurður mynd svæðis mest viss, allt bestu fór.

records.context: Exactly the shape :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.fetch_page` and :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.fetch_filtered_paths` return, so the Annotate application view can page through an annotation work list with no other change. The annotation is always ``None`` — every extracted image region in an annotation work list is unlabelled by construction.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.queue_rows#1
records.source: Exactly the shape :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.fetch_page` and :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.fetch_filtered_paths` return, so the Annotate screen can page through a queue with no other change. The annotation is always ``None`` — every crop in a queue is unlabelled by construction.
records.translation: Það er nákvæmlega form :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.fetch_page` og :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.fetch_filtered_paths` aftur, þannig að Annotate hugbúnaður sýning getur síðað í gegnum annotations vinnuleikinn með engum öðrum breytingum. Annotations er alltaf ``None`` - hvert myndskurður image svæðis í annotation vinnulist er ekki merkinn af byggingu.

records.context: ties — row index ascending by default, or a permutation seeded with ``seed`` when one is given. Both are deterministic: the same inputs and the same seed always give the same order. Ties are the normal case on a screen where thousands of extracted image regions score exactly 0.5, so an unseeded shuffle there would reshuffle the annotator's annotation work list on every refresh.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.rank_by_uncertainty#3
records.source: ties — row index ascending by default, or a permutation seeded with ``seed`` when one is given. Both are deterministic: the same inputs and the same seed always give the same order. Ties are the normal case on a screen where thousands of crops score exactly 0.5, so an unseeded shuffle there would reshuffle the annotator's queue on every refresh.
records.translation: samningar - áætlun áætlunar, eða áætlan sem er settur með ``seed`` þegar einn er gefið. Bæði eru ákveðnar: sömu inntekjum og sömu sem er alltaf að gefa sömu orði. Títum eru venjulega tilfellin á skrin þar sem þúsundir af myndskurðum myndum svæðum stendur nákvæmlega 0.5, þannig að óseiður sál þar myndi endurhúfla annotator annotation vinnuleikinn á hverjum endurnýjandi.

records.context: ``first_round`` is preserved across re-labelling while ``round`` follows the current value, so both "when was this extracted image region first looked at" and "which round set the label it has now" survive a correction.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.record_labels#2
records.source: ``first_round`` is preserved across re-labelling while ``round`` follows the current value, so both "when was this crop first looked at" and "which round set the label it has now" survive a correction.
records.translation: ``first_round`` er geymt í gegnum endurtekningu meðan ``round`` fylgir núverandi gildi, þannig að bæði "hvenær þetta myndskurður mynd svæðis var fyrst skoðað" og "eina runda setur skilaboð það hefur nú" lifir korrigeringu.

records.context: ``{png_path: class or None}``. ``None`` is a *cleared* label and is recorded as such rather than dropped — an extracted image region that was looked at and deliberately left blank is not the same as one never seen.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.record_labels#5

records.translation: ``{png_path: class or None}``. ``None`` er *cleared* merki og er skráður eins og svo í stað þess að falla niður — myndskurður myndareikning sem var skoðað og hugsanlega hættir blank er ekki það sama sem aldrei séð.

records.context: how the extracted image region reached the annotator — ``'manual'``, ``'queue'``, or a caller's own tag.

records.translation: hvernig myndskurður myndarregion náði annotatorinu — ``'manual'``, ``'queue'``, eða eigin tákn samtalara.

records.context: Fit a model on the current labels, re-score all extracted image regions, log the round.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#0
records.source: Fit a model on the current labels, re-score all crops, log the round.
records.translation: Fínt mönnun á núverandi merki, endurskoða allar myndskurðir myndar svæðum, skráðu runda.

records.context: Without a retrain, the work list order still reflects a model fitted before any of the new labels, so it becomes outdated after the first few dozen labels.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#1
records.source: Without a retrain, the queue order still reflects a model fitted before any of the new labels, so it becomes outdated after the first few dozen labels.
records.translation: Án endurtekni, vinnufélinn skilyrði enn að spegja myndavél sem er sett áður en einhver af nýjum merkjum, þannig að það verður yfirgefið eftir fyrstu þúsund merkja.

records.context: Reweighting and downsampling produce different probabilities from the same extracted image regions, and :func:`spacr.suggest.suggest_from_scores` sorts on those probabilities, so the round records the setting in ``notes`` and on the model card. Downsampling keeps the size of the smaller class.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#25
records.source: Reweighting and downsampling produce different probabilities from the same crops, and :func:`spacr.suggest.suggest_from_scores` sorts on those probabilities, so the round records the setting in ``notes`` and on the model card. Downsampling keeps the size of the smaller class.
records.translation: Að þyngja og niðurstaða framleiðir mismunandi sannleika frá sömu myndskurðum myndum, og :func:`spacr.suggest.suggest_from_scores` sortir á þeim sannleikanum, þannig að rúnur rekst uppsetningu í ``notes`` og á myndavélskortinu.

records.context: ``{crop key: rejected class}`` -- suggestions the annotator rejected (:func:`spacr.suggest.rejected_suggestions`). In a two-class column a rejection of class 1 is an example of class 2, and it is fitted as one; an extracted image region that has since been labelled is left to its label, and in a column with any other classes the rejection cannot be turned into a label and is counted in the notes instead. Without this, the model that proposed the wrong class would be fitted on the same evidence next round and propose it again.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#26
records.source: ``{crop key: rejected class}`` -- suggestions the annotator rejected (:func:`spacr.suggest.rejected_suggestions`). In a two-class column a rejection of class 1 is an example of class 2, and it is fitted as one; a crop that has since been labelled is left to its label, and in a column with any other classes the rejection cannot be turned into a label and is counted in the notes instead. Without this, the model that proposed the wrong class would be fitted on the same evidence next round and propose it again.
records.translation: ``{crop key: rejected class}`` - ráðleggingar annotator neitað (:func:`spacr.suggest.rejected_suggestions`). Í tveimur klásum er neita klás 1 dæmi klás 2, og það er settur eins; myndskurður mynd svæðis sem hefur síðan verið merkinn er kvartað á merki sínu, og í kolumni með einhverjum öðrum klástum neita er ekki hægt að breyta í merki og er talin í notum í staðinn.

records.context: how many unannotated extracted image regions to draw at random and fit as the absent class when only one class has been annotated. ``None`` (default) refuses instead, as before.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#27
records.source: how many unannotated crops to draw at random and fit as the absent class when only one class has been annotated. ``None`` (default) refuses instead, as before.
records.translation: hve margir unannotated myndskurðir myndar svæðum til að ritast á slæmt og passa eins og fjarlægð klasa þegar aðeins einn klasa hefur verið notuð. ``None`` (þekkt) neita í staðinn, eins og áður.

records.context: 1. fits a model on every label in ``annotation_column``; 2. scores it on a **grouped** held-out split, so the number is not an artefact of 190 labels coming from one microplate sample position; 3. writes per-class probabilities back into ``png_list`` as :data:`ROUND_PRED_PREFIX` columns, which :func:`build_queue` prefers over the older ``pred`` — so the next work list is genuinely re-ranked; 4. records the round, giving :func:`learning_curve` another point; 5. returns the :class:`StoppingVerdict` for the curve so far.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#3
records.source: 1. fits a model on every label in ``annotation_column``; 2. scores it on a **grouped** held-out split, so the number is not an artefact of 190 labels coming from one well; 3. writes per-class probabilities back into ``png_list`` as :data:`ROUND_PRED_PREFIX` columns, which :func:`build_queue` prefers over the older ``pred`` — so the next queue is genuinely re-ranked; 4. records the round, giving :func:`learning_curve` another point; 5. returns the :class:`StoppingVerdict` for the curve so far.
records.translation: 1. passa á mönnun á hverri merki í ``annotation_column``; 2. skora það á **þrúnin** haldið út skipt, þannig að tölurinn er ekki artefakt af 190 merkjum sem koma frá einum brunninum; 3. skrifar sönnun per klass aftur til ``png_list`` sem :data:`ROUND_PRED_PREFIX` stólum, sem :func:`build_queue` forðast yfir eldri ``pred`` - þannig að næsta vinnuleikurinn er reiðanlega endurlist; 4. skora runda, gefur :func:`learning_curve` annað poðið; 5. hættir :class:`StoppingVerdict` fyrir krúmi þar til.

records.context: feature matrix indexed by the extracted-image-region structured-data name. Omitted, it is read from the measurement tables with :func:`round_features`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#6
records.source: feature matrix indexed by the crop key. Omitted, it is read from the measurement tables with :func:`round_features`.
records.translation: Hugbúnaður matrix geyktur af myndskurði-mynd-region struktured-data nafn. Þangað, það er lesið úr mæslum með :func:`round_features`.

records.context: ``'well'`` (default), ``'plate'``, ``'field'`` or ``'none'``. What the held-out split refuses to share. Matched exactly and in lower case; anything else produces an error, the way an unknown ``diversity=`` does in :func:`build_queue`. When the strategy is ``'none'``, or the extracted-image-region table has none of the columns it needs, the split is a stratified random one and ``split_rule`` says ``NOT grouped`` — it never claims a grouping it did not perform.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.retrain_round#8
records.source: ``'well'`` (default), ``'plate'``, ``'field'`` or ``'none'``. What the held-out split refuses to share. Matched exactly and in lower case; anything else raises, the way an unknown ``diversity=`` does in :func:`build_queue`. When the strategy is ``'none'``, or the crop table has none of the columns it needs, the split is a stratified random one and ``split_rule`` says ``NOT grouped`` — it never claims a grouping it did not perform.
records.translation: ``'well'`` (þekkt), ``'plate'``, ``'field'`` eða ``'none'``. Það sem hold-out splittur neita að deila. Samkvæmt nákvæmlega og í lægri tilvik; allt annað framleiðir mistök, þannig að ókunnulegt ``diversity=`` gerir í :func:`build_queue`. Þegar stefnu er ``'none'``, eða myndskurður mynd-region tólinn hefur enginn af kolumnum sem það þarf, splitturinn er streituð slæmt einn og ``split_rule`` segir ``NOT grouped`` - það þýðir aldrei hópur sem það hefur ekki gert.

records.context: The measurement features for every extracted image region, indexed by ``png_path``.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#0
records.source: The measurement features for every crop, indexed by ``png_path``.
records.translation: Mæðingarnar eru fyrir hvert myndskurður myndareigni, sem er geymt með ``png_path``.

records.context: the extracted-image-region identifier column.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.round_features#4
records.source: the crop key column.
records.translation: a) myndskurður-mynd-region kennslumálinn.

records.context: **It looks *back over* rounds, not *at* the last one.** A single round that happened to land flat is noise; the question is whether the last fifty labels — however they were divided up — bought anything.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.should_stop#4
records.source: **It looks *back over* rounds, not *at* the last one.** A single round that happened to land flat is noise; the question is whether the last fifty labels — however they were divided up — bought anything.
records.translation: **Það lítur út *back yfir* runda, ekki *at* síðasta. ** Einn runda sem gerðist til landfalla er hljóð; spurningin er hvort síðasta fimmtíu merki - þótt þeir voru deilt - keypt eitthvað.

records.context: **A falling curve stops too, and says so.** Accuracy going down is not convergence; it usually means the newest labels disagree with the earlier ones, or that the held-out split moved. Either way, more of the same is the wrong next move.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.should_stop#7
records.source: **A falling curve stops too, and says so.** Accuracy going down is not convergence; it usually means the newest labels disagree with the earlier ones, or that the held-out split moved. Either way, more of the same is the wrong next move.
records.translation: **A falling kurva hættir líka, og segir svo.** Ráðlegur að fara niður er ekki konvergens; það þýðir yfirleitt að nýjustu merki eru mismunandi við fyrri, eða að hold-out split flýtur.

records.context: This module measures how far two or more annotators agree on the same extracted image regions and lists the extracted image regions on which they disagree. It reads only the ``png_list`` table of a ``measurements.db``.
records.label: spacr.agreement#1
records.source: This module measures how far two or more annotators agree on the same crops and lists the crops on which they disagree. It reads only the ``png_list`` table of a ``measurements.db``.
records.translation: Þessar mælar hversu langt tveir eða fleiri notendur eru sammála um sömu myndskurði myndu svæðum og listar út afgreiddingu myndum svæðum sem þeir eru ekki sammála. Það lætur aðeins ``png_list`` tól ``measurements.db``.

records.context: Annotation columns are the ones the Annotate app writes: an ``INTEGER`` column added to ``png_list`` with ``ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`` (see :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column`), holding the class the annotator pressed — ``1`` for a left click, ``2`` for a right click — and ``NULL`` for every extracted image region they have not looked at yet. Two annotators means two such columns over the same ``png_path`` rows.
records.label: spacr.agreement#2
records.source: Annotation columns are the ones the Annotate app writes: an ``INTEGER`` column added to ``png_list`` with ``ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`` (see :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column`), holding the class the annotator pressed — ``1`` for a left click, ``2`` for a right click — and ``NULL`` for every crop they have not looked at yet. Two annotators means two such columns over the same ``png_path`` rows.
records.translation: Annotation hjólum eru þeir sem Annotate app skrifa: ``INTEGER`` hjólinn lagt til ``png_list`` með ``ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN`` (sjá :func:`spacr.qt.annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column`), með því að halda klásinu sem annotator er pressur — ``1`` fyrir hægri klicka, ``2`` fyrir hægri smell — og ``NULL`` fyrir hverri myndskurði myndu svæðis sem þeir hafa ekki skoðað enn. Tveir annotatorir þýðir tveir þessar stefnu yfir sömu ``png_path`` stefnu.

records.context: **An unlabelled cell is an abstention, not a disagreement.** Every pair is scored on the rows *both* annotators labelled (pairwise complete cases). Rows where only one of them committed are counted and reported separately as ``n_abstained``. Treating them as disagreements would silently deflate κ in proportion to how far behind the slower annotator is — which is a property of the calendar, not of the annotation.
records.label: spacr.agreement#6
records.source: **An unlabelled cell is an abstention, not a disagreement.** Every pair is scored on the rows *both* annotators labelled (pairwise complete cases). Rows where only one of them committed are counted and reported separately as ``n_abstained``. Treating them as disagreements would silently deflate κ in proportion to how far behind the slower annotator is — which is a property of the calendar, not of the annotation.
records.translation: **Óþekkt fruman er aðstæður, ekki óþekking.** Hvert par er ritað á röðum *Bæði* Annotatorum er merkt (farlega fullkomna aðstæður). Rökur þar sem aðeins einn af þeim er gert eru talin og skráð sérstakt eins og ``n_abstained`` Að meðhöndla þá eins og óþekktar myndi þöglu fljóta κ í samræmi við því hversu langt bak slæri annotator er - sem er eign á dagskrá, ekki annotation.

records.context: A 10x10 grid of 2048x2048 uint16 microscope fields of view is a 20480x20480 canvas: 800 MB for one channel, 3.2 GB for four. Nothing in this module ever holds that canvas — or the whole input set — in RAM. That constraint drives every design decision here:
records.label: spacr.align#1
records.source: A 10x10 grid of 2048x2048 uint16 fields is a 20480x20480 canvas: 800 MB for one channel, 3.2 GB for four. Nothing in this module ever holds that canvas — or the whole input set — in RAM. That constraint drives every design decision here:
records.translation: A 10x10 gríðið af 2048x2048 uint16 mikroskópum sviði sýn er 20480x20480 kanvas: 800 MB fyrir einn rás, 3.2 GB fyrir fjórar. Enginn í þessari mólum hefur aldrei þess kanvas - eða allan innfangsetur - í RAM.

records.context: **z is not stitched.** Microscope image fields are 2-D ``(H, W)`` or image-channel-last 3-D ``(H, W, C)``, which is the layout spaCR's ``merged/*.npy`` already uses. A z-stack must be projected first, or aligned one z image layer at a time by calling this module for each image layer; a 4-D array is refused with a message that says so rather than being silently reinterpreted.
records.label: spacr.align#10
records.source: **z is not stitched.** Tiles are 2-D ``(H, W)`` or channel-last 3-D ``(H, W, C)``, which is the layout spaCR's ``merged/*.npy`` already uses. A z-stack must be projected first, or aligned one z-plane at a time by calling this module per plane; a 4-D array is refused with a message that says so rather than being silently reinterpreted.
records.translation: **z er ekki stitched.** Microscope myndbönd eru 2-D ``(H, W)`` eða myndrás síðasta 3-D ``(H, W, C)``, sem er áætlun spaCR's ``merged/*.npy`` er þegar notað. A z-stack verður að sýna fyrst, eða tengjast einn z myndslaginn á sama tíma með því að kalla þetta modul fyrir hvert myndslags; 4-D rás er neitað með skilaboð sem segir það í stað þess að vera hljóðlega endurtekt.

records.context: **Image data channels share one solution.** Registration runs on ``reference_channel`` alone and the resulting placement is applied to every image data channel of that site. Aligning image data channels independently would shear the composite — a nucleus mask and its own DAPI image data channel would no longer line up — so it is not offered.
records.label: spacr.align#9
records.source: **Channels share one solution.** Registration runs on ``reference_channel`` alone and the resulting placement is applied to every channel of that site. Aligning channels independently would shear the composite — a nucleus mask and its own DAPI channel would no longer line up — so it is not offered.
records.translation: **Bildin rásir deila einn lausn.** Registraðurinn fer á ``reference_channel`` ein og niðurstöður staðsetningu er að velja á hverri rás á síðunni. Að sameina mynd gögninna rásir sjálfstætt myndi sýna samsetningu - kjarnmaska og eigin DAPI mynd gönguna rás myndi ekki lengur tengjast upp - þannig að það er ekki boðið.

records.context: the channel registration was measured on.
records.label: spacr.align.AlignPlan#10
records.source: the channel registration was measured on.
records.translation: Rásirnar var mætt á.

records.context: canvas writer selected for the run, ``"stream"`` or ``"memmap"``.
records.label: spacr.align.AlignResult#8
records.source: canvas writer selected for the run, ``"stream"`` or ``"memmap"``.
records.translation: Leiðin er valið fyrir keyrslunni, ``"stream"`` eða ``"memmap"``.

records.context: A "site" is a position on the stage, not a file. When each image data channel is its own file — the Yokogawa case — the sibling paths live in :attr:`channel_paths` and :attr:`path` is the reference image data channel's; when the image data channels are image layers of one ``(H, W, C)`` array —  spaCR's ``merged/*.npy`` — :attr:`channel_paths` is empty and :attr:`path` is the only file. Either way there is exactly one :class:`Tile`, and so exactly one :class:`Placement`, per stage position.
records.label: spacr.align.Tile#1
records.source: A "site" is a position on the stage, not a file. When each channel is its own file — the Yokogawa case — the sibling paths live in :attr:`channel_paths` and :attr:`path` is the reference channel's; when the channels are planes of one ``(H, W, C)`` array —  spaCR's ``merged/*.npy`` — :attr:`channel_paths` is empty and :attr:`path` is the only file. Either way there is exactly one :class:`Tile`, and so exactly one :class:`Placement`, per stage position.
records.translation: A "site" er stöðu á stefnu, ekki faili. Þegar hver rás er eigin skál — Yokogawa tilfinnu — öfingur leiðir lifandi í :attr:`channel_paths` og :attr:`path` er reference image gögnanall; þegar rás eru myndum skál af einum ``(H, W, C)`` röð — spaCR's ``merged/*.npy`` - :attr:`channel_paths` er vaxinn og :attr:`path` er eina skál. Eða leið er það nákvæmlega einn :class:`Tile`, og svo nákvémlega eitt :class:`Placement`, í stefnu stöðu.

records.context: absolute sibling-file paths in assembled channel order, or ``()`` when all channels live inside :attr:`path`.
records.label: spacr.align.Tile#14
records.source: absolute sibling-file paths in assembled channel order, or ``()`` when all channels live inside :attr:`path`.
records.translation: fullkomna bróður-file leiðir í samsettu rás orði, eða ``()`` þegar öll rás lifir í :attr:`path`.

records.context: well token parsed from the filename, such as ``"B07"``, or ``""`` when absent.
records.label: spacr.align.Tile#5
records.source: well token parsed from the filename, such as ``"B07"``, or ``""`` when absent.
records.translation: brunnur token parsed frá filenameinu, svo sem ``"B07"``, eða ``""`` þegar ekki.

records.context: Number of channels this site contributes to the canvas.

records.source: Number of channels this site contributes to the canvas.
records.translation: Númerur af kannaum á þessari síðu veita til að rás.

records.source: Short human label, ``plate_well_field``.
records.translation: Lágt notandi-sögn merki, ``plate_well_field``.

records.context: Always prints the plan before writing anything, so a headless run also records the tiles that fell back to nominal positions in the log.
records.label: spacr.align.align_folder#1
records.source: Always prints the plan before writing anything, so a headless run also records the tiles that fell back to nominal positions in the log.
records.translation: Allavega drukkið áætlun áður en þú skrifar eitthvað, þannig að keyrslulaus keyrir rekst einnig skál sem fellur aftur til nominal stöðum í dagskrá.

records.context: the image layer registration is measured on. Every image data channel of a site then shares that site's single solution — registering image data channels independently would shear the composite. ``None`` (the default) takes the image data channel the microscope image fields already carry, which is the one :func:`scan_tiles` selected. This used to default to ``0``, so ``scan_tiles(reference_channel=2)`` followed by the documented ``estimate_offsets(tiles)`` silently registered on image data channel 0 instead — the selection was stored on every microscope image field and read by nothing. Microscope image fields that disagree fall back to ``0``; the resolved value is recorded on the plan and printed by :func:`format_plan`, so whichever way it went is visible rather than assumed.
records.label: spacr.align.estimate_offsets#3
records.source: the plane registration is measured on. Every channel of a site then shares that site's single solution — registering channels independently would shear the composite. ``None`` (the default) takes the channel the tiles already carry, which is the one :func:`scan_tiles` selected. This used to default to ``0``, so ``scan_tiles(reference_channel=2)`` followed by the documented ``estimate_offsets(tiles)`` silently registered on channel 0 instead — the selection was stored on every tile and read by nothing. Tiles that disagree fall back to ``0``; the resolved value is recorded on the plan and printed by :func:`format_plan`, so whichever way it went is visible rather than assumed.
records.translation: Myndslagsreikning er mættur á. Hver rás vefsvæði þá deila það eina lausn vefsvæðis - að skrá rás sjálfstætt myndi sýna samsetningu. ``None`` (þekkt) tekur mynd gögnum tákn sem mikroskóp myndbönd eru þegar með, sem er :func:`scan_tiles` valinn. Þetta var notað til að standa upp á ``0``, þannig að ``scan_tiles(reference_channel=2)`` fylgt með skammt ``estimate_offsets(tiles)`` hlýtið skráður á mynd gögnum tákn 0 í staðinn - valinn var lagður á hverri myndarfelli í mikroskópum og lesið af ekkert. Mikroskópur myndbönd sem mismunandi fallir aftur til ``0``; áætlað gildi er skráður á símanum og drukkið með :func:`format_plan`, þannig að hvaða leið sem það fór er sýnilegt í stað þess að hugsa.

records.context: Every file's shape and dtype comes out of its header. A folder of 1000 tiles is scanned in the time it takes to open 1000 files, which is what makes "show me the plan before you write 800 MB" possible.
records.label: spacr.align.scan_tiles#1
records.source: Every file's shape and dtype comes out of its header. A folder of 1000 tiles is scanned in the time it takes to open 1000 files, which is what makes "show me the plan before you write 800 MB" possible.
records.translation: Hugmynd og dtype hverri skreyti kemur út úr headerinu. A mótbolta af 1000 reitir er skannað á þeim tíma sem það tekur til að opna 1000 skrif, sem er það sem gerir " sýnir mér skrefið áður en þú skrifar 800 MB" mögulegt.

records.context: Files that share ``(plate, well, field)`` are collapsed into one microscope image field with one image layer per image data channel: a Yokogawa well with four image data channels per microscope field of view produces one :class:`Tile` per microscope field of view, not four.
records.label: spacr.align.scan_tiles#2
records.source: Files that share ``(plate, well, field)`` are collapsed into one tile with one plane per channel: a Yokogawa well with four channels per field produces one :class:`Tile` per field, not four.
records.translation: Fjallar sem deila ``(plate, well, field)`` eru brjóst inn í einn mikroskópur myndbönd með eitt myndslett á rás: Yokogawa brunnur með fjórum rásir á mikroskopur sjónarfelli framleiðir einn :class:`Tile` fyrir mikroscópur ljósbönd, ekki fjórar.

records.context: how a flat field sequence maps onto the grid — see :data:`ORDERS`. Serpentine acquisitions need ``'snake-row'``.
records.label: spacr.align.scan_tiles#6
records.source: how a flat field sequence maps onto the grid — see :data:`ORDERS`. Serpentine acquisitions need ``'snake-row'``.
records.translation: hvernig fátækt sjónsvið síðu á netinu — sjá :data:`ORDERS`. Serpentine uppgötvunar þurfa ``'snake-row'``.

records.context: which channel drives registration. Defaults to the lowest channel present.
records.label: spacr.align.scan_tiles#9
records.source: which channel drives registration. Defaults to the lowest channel present.
records.translation: hvaða rás dreifir skrá. Óþekkt að minnsta rás núna.

records.context: Seams are **feathered**: each microscope image field's contribution is weighted by a linear ramp that rises from the microscope image field edge inward over :attr:`AlignPlan.feather` pixels, and the band is divided by the total weight. A hard cut would leave a straight, high-contrast edge exactly where two microscope fields of view meet — and a straight edge is the single most reliable thing a downstream segmentation will find and call an object boundary. Feathering costs one extra float32 image layer per band and makes the join a gradient instead. ``blend='average'`` weights every contributor equally and ``blend='none'`` is last-writer-wins, both kept mainly so the difference can be measured.
records.label: spacr.align.write_stack#2
records.source: Seams are **feathered**: each tile's contribution is weighted by a linear ramp that rises from the tile edge inward over :attr:`AlignPlan.feather` pixels, and the band is divided by the total weight. A hard cut would leave a straight, high-contrast edge exactly where two fields meet — and a straight edge is the single most reliable thing a downstream segmentation will find and call an object boundary. Feathering costs one extra float32 plane per band and makes the join a gradient instead. ``blend='average'`` weights every contributor equally and ``blend='none'`` is last-writer-wins, both kept mainly so the difference can be measured.
records.translation: Seams eru **feathered**: hver mikroscope myndræði þáttur er vægi með línu ramp sem stendur frá mikroskóp myndræðinu í kringum :attr:`AlignPlan.feather` pixels, og bandið er skipt af samalvöru. Hjarta skreyting myndi yfirgefa hreint, hár kontrast á kringum nákvæmlega þar sem tveir mikroskrópi myndræðum mæta - og hreint ræðing er eina áreiðanlegasta hlutur að niðurstríð segmentation mun finna og kalla objekt grandi. Feathering kostar einn extra float32 myndröð per band og gerir að tengja gradient í stað. ``blend='average'`` þykir hver þáttur jafn og ``blend='none'`` er síðast skriyting, bæði halda að mismunandi er hægt að mæla.

records.context: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop any feature column containing a NaN. On a real database it often removes every ``pathogen_*`` column, because those columns are NaN for cells without a pathogen. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop any object row containing a NaN. Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Both write a ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask of the same shape by default, so imputed values can be told apart from measured ones; the boolean mask costs 1 byte per cell against 4 for the default ``float32`` ``X``.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#15

Usually removes almost everything, for the same reason; offered because on a single-object-type export it is often exactly right. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` impute. Both write a ``layers['missing']`` boolean mask of the same shape by default, so imputed values can be told apart from measured ones; the boolean mask costs 1 byte per cell against 4 for the default ``float32`` ``X``.
records.translation: ``NAN_DROP_FEATURES`` drop hvaða eiginleika stefnu sem inniheldur NaN. Á raunverulegum gögn er það oft fjarlægð hvert ``pathogen_*`` stefnu, vegna þess að þessar stefnu eru NaN fyrir frumum án sýkla. ``NAN_DROP_OBJECTS`` drop hvaða hlutræði sem inniheldur NaN. Oft fjarlægja nánast allt, af sömu ástæðu; Tilboð vegna þess að á einstaka efni-typu útvinning er það oft nákvæmlega rétt. ``NAN_ZERO`` / ``NAN_MEAN`` er óþægilegt. Bæði skrifaðu ``layers['missing']`` boolean maski af sömu tegundinu í staðsetningu, þannig að viðtalið gildi getur verið sagt að missa frá þeim; boolean maski kostar 1 byte á frumunni gegn 4 fyrir fyrirmyndun ``float32`` ``X``.

records.context: AnnData stores NaN values, but ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` and most of scvi-tools either propagate NaN across the whole matrix or raise. Every policy therefore reports the missing values it found. Filling with zero is not the default because in spaCR a NaN usually carries meaning: a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it, a Zernike column is NaN when mahotas was not installed, and a correlation column is NaN when one channel was flat. Zero-filling the first turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size" and puts it into the same distribution as a measured one.
records.label: spacr.anndata_export#7
records.source: AnnData stores NaN values, but ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` and most of scvi-tools either propagate NaN across the whole matrix or raise. Every policy therefore reports the missing values it found. Filling with zero is not the default because in spaCR a NaN usually carries meaning: a ``pathogen_*`` column is NaN for a cell with no pathogen in it, a Zernike column is NaN when mahotas was not installed, and a correlation column is NaN when one channel was flat. Zero-filling the first turns "no pathogen" into "a pathogen of zero size" and puts it into the same distribution as a measured one.
records.translation: AnnData geymir NaN gildi, en ``sc.pp.scale``, ``sc.pp.pca``, ``sc.pp.neighbors`` og flestir scvi-tólir antingen breyta NaN yfir allan matrix eða upp. Þess vegna segir hvert stjórnmál að mismunandi verðmætum sem hann fann. Fillingu með null er ekki fyrirmyndun vegna þess að í spaCR er NaN venjulega þýðir: ``pathogen_*`` stefnu er NaN fyrir frumunni sem hefur engin sýkill í henni, Zernike stefnur er NaN þegar mahotas voru ekki sett, og samræmi stefnurinn er NaN þegar einn rás var fljótt. Null-fylgjandi fyrsta skiptir "no pathogen" í "null stærð sýkill" og setja það í sömu eyðileggjandi sem mætt einn.

records.context: A short barcode turns up in a long read by pure coincidence.  Thirty-two distinct eight base barcodes scanned across a hundred and fifty base read have about a seven percent chance of a spurious match, so a table that is genuinely absent still reports roughly seven percent of reads as hits.  Reporting that rate as a finding would misidentify the table as present and could configure a mapping that yields nothing.  Every rate this module reports therefore arrives with the rate expected by chance for that table against those reads, and with the ratio between them.  Nothing is called present unless it stands well clear of its own coincidence rate.
records.label: spacr.barcode_search#4
records.source: A short barcode turns up in a long read by pure coincidence.  Thirty-two distinct eight base barcodes scanned across a hundred and fifty base read have about a seven percent chance of a spurious match, so a table that is genuinely absent still reports roughly seven percent of reads as hits.  Reporting that rate as a finding would misidentify the table as present and could configure a mapping that yields nothing.  Every rate this module reports therefore arrives with the rate expected by chance for that table against those reads, and with the ratio between them.  Nothing is called present unless it stands well clear of its own coincidence rate.

Tíu og tvö mismunandi átta baskódar skannað á milli hundra og fimmtíu base lesingu hafa um sjö procenta sönnun á spennandi leik, þannig að tól sem er alvöru ekki enn að rafa um sjöt procenta lesinga sem hit. Rannsóknir þessar stig sem fundur myndi misidentifika tólina sem núverandi og gæti setja upp mapping sem gefur ekkert. Hver stig þessi móddur skýrar því kemur með skammt á tækifæri fyrir þá tól gegn þeim lesinga, og með samræmi milli þeirra. Software starfslista er staðfest í fullu áður en fyrsti starf byrjar, aðstæður hennar er skrifað til ``path`` eftir hverri breytingu, og starf sem þunglyndi hefur ekki gerst er skipt í stað þess að keyra gegn hálft skrifað innfang.

records.context: ``center`` removes per-batch mean shifts while preserving the global mean. ``zscore`` aligns per-batch means and variances to the global distribution. ``robust_zscore`` does the same with median/MAD and is less sensitive to heavy-tailed single-cell measurements. ``control_center`` estimates only a location shift from negative/reference controls in every batch, preserving treatment dispersion and usually best preserving biology.
records.label: spacr.batch_correction.correct_batch_effects#1
records.source: ``center`` removes per-batch mean shifts while preserving the global mean. ``zscore`` aligns per-batch means and variances to the global distribution. ``robust_zscore`` does the same with median/MAD and is less sensitive to heavy-tailed single-cell measurements. ``control_center`` estimates only a location shift from negative/reference controls in every batch, preserving treatment dispersion and usually best preserving biology.
records.translation: ``center`` fjarlægur miðjan breytingar per-batch meðan við vernda heiminum miðjan. ``zscore`` tengir miðjan og breytingarnar per-bátch við heimsstyrjöld. ``robust_zscore`` gerir það sama með miðjan/MAD og er minna tilfinningalega við þyngd-tækta einn-fruma mælingar. ``control_center`` ákvarða aðeins staðsetningu breytingu frá neikvæðum/referendum stjórnunum í hvert skipti, bjarga meðferð dispersion og venjulega best beita biológi.
