records.label: spacr.measure.get_components#3
records.source: Label mask of pathogens.
records.translation: Sjöfli á maski fyrir sýkli.

records.context: Consumes the ``merged/`` folder produced by :func:`spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks` (image data channel arrays + mask stacks saved as ``.npy``), computes shape, intensity, texture and spatial features per cell / nucleus / pathogen / cytoplasm object, and writes them to a SQLite ``measurements.db``. When ``save_png`` is enabled it also extracts per-object image regions as PNG thumbnails, which are the training input for :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr`.
records.label: spacr.measure.measure_crop#1
records.source: Consumes the ``merged/`` folder produced by :func:`spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks` (channel arrays + mask stacks saved as ``.npy``), computes shape, intensity, texture and spatial features per cell / nucleus / pathogen / cytoplasm object, and writes them to a SQLite ``measurements.db``. When ``save_png`` is enabled it also crops per-object PNG thumbnails, which are the training input for :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr`.
records.translation: Verður ``merged/`` mappinn sem er framleitt af :func:`spacr.core.preprocess_generate_masks` (rás rays + maska stacks sparað sem ``.npy``), tækir form, hærð, tækni og pláss eiginleika á cell / kjarni / sýkill / cytoplasm objekt, og skrifa þá á SQLite ``measurements.db``. Þegar ``save_png`` er aktiverður, það er einnig að útgreiða per-object image svæðum eins og PNG tækjum, sem eru þjálfun innfang fyrir :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.deep_spacr`.

records.context: Args: png_channels (ndarray): The extracted image region in file order -- red image layer first -- as :func:`spacr.crops.build_png_channels` assembles it. Written without narrowing, so a ``uint16`` extracted image region becomes a 16-bit PNG; a float extracted image region is silently written as 8-bit by cv2. Four or more image data channels raise rather than losing one to an alpha image layer. img_path (str): Where the PNG goes. Its parent folder is stamped with the format sidecar and **must already exist** -- the caller in ``_measure_crop_core`` creates it. If it does not, the stamp fails with a printed warning, ``cv2.imwrite`` returns False, and the call returns normally having written nothing at all. A bare filename with no directory part stamps the current working directory. grid (list): Anything with ``append``; read only when ``plot`` is true, and appended to in place, so the return value is the object that was passed in. ``None`` passes through untouched while ``plot`` is false. plot (bool): Truthiness, not identity, decides. False (the default) leaves ``grid`` completely untouched -- the PNG is still written -- which is why an ordinary run ends with an empty grid. True appends the extracted image region for :func:`img_list_to_grid`: an extracted image region of exactly dtype ``uint16`` is appended as a high-byte narrowed ``uint8`` copy, every other dtype is appended unchanged, and a ``uint8`` extracted image region is appended by reference, so a caller that reuses its buffer mutates what is already in the grid.
records.label: spacr.measure.save_and_add_image_to_grid#1
records.source: Args: png_channels (ndarray): The crop in file order -- red plane first -- as :func:`spacr.crops.build_png_channels` assembles it. Written without narrowing, so a ``uint16`` crop becomes a 16-bit PNG; a float crop is silently written as 8-bit by cv2. Four or more channels raise rather than losing one to an alpha plane. img_path (str): Where the PNG goes. Its parent folder is stamped with the format sidecar and **must already exist** -- the caller in ``_measure_crop_core`` creates it. If it does not, the stamp fails with a printed warning, ``cv2.imwrite`` returns False, and the call returns normally having written nothing at all. A bare filename with no directory part stamps the current working directory. grid (list): Anything with ``append``; read only when ``plot`` is true, and appended to in place, so the return value is the object that was passed in. ``None`` passes through untouched while ``plot`` is false. plot (bool): Truthiness, not identity, decides. False (the default) leaves ``grid`` completely untouched -- the PNG is still written -- which is why an ordinary run ends with an empty grid. True appends the crop for :func:`img_list_to_grid`: a crop of exactly dtype ``uint16`` is appended as a high-byte narrowed ``uint8`` copy, every other dtype is appended unchanged, and a ``uint8`` crop is appended by reference, so a caller that reuses its buffer mutates what is already in the grid.
records.translation: Argið: png_channels (þrýðandi): Mynd svæðið í skáldsáætluninni -- Róða myndum í fyrsta skipti -- eins og :func:`spacr.crops.build_png_channels` safnar það. skrifað án að smella, svo ``uint16`` myndskurður mynd svæðis verður 16-bit PNG; flóð útgreiður mynd svæðinu er hljóðlega skrifað sem 8-bit með cv2. Fjórir eða fleiri rásir hækka í stað þess að missa einn á alfa myndslagi. img_path (str): Hvar PNG fer. foreldrarmálur hennar er stjótur með formata sidekari og **must er þegar til** -- samtalinn í ``_measure_crop_core`` skapar það. ef það er ekki, stjóturinn missa með truflað varning, ``cv2.imwrite`` endurheimtir False, Og hringurinn kemur yfirleitt aftur með því að skrifa ekkert alls. A ljóst skránafn með engum skrifstofu hluta stýra núverandi vinnu skrifstofunni. Ríkis (list): Allt með ``append``; lesa aðeins þegar ``plot`` er satt, og tengist til staðnum, þannig að afturverði er hluturinn sem var sendur inn. ``None`` fer í gegnum óttað, en ``plot`` er fallegt. Sannleikur, ekki einkenni, ákvarðanir. False (þekkt) yfirgefur ``grid`` fullkomlega óttað - PNG er enn skrifað - það er ástæðan fyrir því að venjulega keyrslan endar með leyti net. True bætir út myndinni svæðið fyrir :func:`img_list_to_grid`: út myndu svæðið nákvæmlega dtype ``uint16`` bætir við sem hárbítum ``uint8`` kopi, hver annar dtyp bætir ekki breytist, og út ``uint8`` mynd svæðið bætir með referendum, þannig að kallaður sem endurnýsir bufferinu mun mutast það sem er nú þegar í netinu.

The mapping is declared rather than corrected.
records.translation: Það er REVERSE af því sem ``png_dims`` lesa eins og, og það er haldinlega haldin: hvert útgreiða mynd svæðið þegar á skálinu var skrifað með þessari mappingu, þannig að flýja það myndi þyngdlega breyta hvað hver lit þýðir og slökkva ámyndum þjálfa á þeim myndskurði mynd svæðum.

records.context: ``cv2.imwrite`` interprets a 3-image data channel array as BGR, so :func:`spacr.crops.to_cv2_bgr` reverses the array once, here, and cv2's interpretation lands the red plane in the file's red slot. It refuses more than three image data channels rather than letting cv2 write the fourth as an alpha plane for every reader to drop in silence.
records.label: spacr.measure.save_and_add_image_to_grid#6
records.source: ``cv2.imwrite`` interprets a 3-channel array as BGR, so :func:`spacr.crops.to_cv2_bgr` reverses the array once, here, and cv2's interpretation lands the red plane in the file's red slot. It refuses more than three channels rather than letting cv2 write the fourth as an alpha plane for every reader to drop in silence.
records.translation: ``cv2.imwrite`` þýðir 3 myndum rás árek sem BGR, þannig að :func:`spacr.crops.to_cv2_bgr` snúa árekinn einu sinni hér, og cv2 þýðingu landar rödd flugvél í rauð slott faila. Það neita meira en þremur gögjum rás í stað þess að leyfa cv2 skrifa fjórða sem alfa flugvöll fyrir hverri lesendur að falla í stillingu.

records.context: The format is versioned: :func:`spacr.crops.stamp_crop_folder` drops a ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidecar into the extracted-image-region folder before the first PNG lands, recording format 3 (``declared_rgb``). An unmarked folder means format 1 (legacy), whose bytes match format 3 for the same declared mapping, so both are read as-is; only format 2, whose stored image data channel order is reversed, is corrected by :func:`spacr.crops.read_crop_png`, and ``spacr.crops.migrate_crop_folder`` rewrites such a folder in place.
records.label: spacr.measure.save_and_add_image_to_grid#7
records.source: The format is versioned: :func:`spacr.crops.stamp_crop_folder` drops a ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidecar into the crop folder before the first PNG lands, recording format 3 (``declared_rgb``). An unmarked folder means format 1 (legacy), whose bytes match format 3 for the same declared mapping, so both are read as-is; only format 2, whose stored channel order is reversed, is corrected by :func:`spacr.crops.read_crop_png`, and ``spacr.crops.migrate_crop_folder`` rewrites such a folder in place.
records.translation: Formáturinn er útgáfað: :func:`spacr.crops.stamp_crop_folder` droppur ``.spacr_crop_format.json`` sidekar í myndskurði mynd-region mappinn áður en fyrstu PNG land, skrá formátur 3 (``declared_rgb``). Unmarked mapping þýðir formátum 1 (legacy), sem byttur tengjast formátum 3 fyrir sömu tilkynnt mappingu, þannig að báðir eru lesið eins og-is; Aðeins formátur 2, sem geymt rás orðin er afturkallað, er korrigerður með :func:`spacr.crops.read_crop_png`, og ``spacr.crops.migrate_crop_folder`` endurskreita slík mappur í stað.

records.context: Extracted image regions are still ``uint16``, so these are 16-bit PNGs and no intensity is discarded at write time. The narrowing to 8 bit happens once, on read, in :func:`spacr.crops.narrow_to_uint8`, which always takes the high byte (``// 256``) — replacing PIL's two incompatible rules (high byte for an RGB PNG, a *clip* at 255 for a single-image data channel one, which returned solid white for any extracted image region brighter than that).
records.label: spacr.measure.save_and_add_image_to_grid#8
records.source: Crops are still ``uint16``, so these are 16-bit PNGs and no intensity is discarded at write time. The narrowing to 8 bit happens once, on read, in :func:`spacr.crops.narrow_to_uint8`, which always takes the HIGH BYTE (``// 256``) — replacing PIL's two incompatible rules (high byte for an RGB PNG, a *clip* at 255 for a single-channel one, which returned solid white for any crop brighter than that).
records.translation: Þessar myndarreglur eru enn ``uint16``, þannig að þeir eru 16 bits PNGs og engin hjarta er fjarlægð á skrifu tími. Skammingu til 8 bits gerist einu sinni, á lesingu, í :func:`spacr.crops.narrow_to_uint8`, sem tekur alltaf hár byti (``// 256``) - skipta PIL tveimur óþekktum reglum (hár byttur fyrir RGB PNG, *clip* á 255 fyrir einn mynd gögn tákna einn, sem endurheimti hár hvítur fyrir hvaða myndskurðinn mynd svæðið ljósi en það).

records.context: :func:`spacr.measure.measure_crop` measures fields in a :class:`multiprocessing.Pool`. Under ``fork`` (the Linux default) a worker inherits this module's registries from the parent and hooks registered with :func:`register_preprocessing_hook` work without additional setup. Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` (Windows, macOS, or ``SPACR_START_METHOD``) a worker is a fresh interpreter that has never seen them, so an in-process registration would be a **silent no-op in every worker**. For that case set :data:`HOOKS_ENV_VAR`
records.label: spacr.measure_hooks#19

Under ``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` (Windows, macOS, or ``SPACR_START_METHOD``) a worker is a fresh interpreter that has never seen them, so an in-process registration would be a **silent no-op in every worker**. Í``spawn`` / ``forkserver`` (Windows, macOS, eða ``SPACR_START_METHOD``) vinnsluferli er nýtt tákn sem hefur aldrei séð þá, þannig að in-process rekstur væri **þægilegt no-op í hverri vinnsluferli**. records.context: ``spacr.io._read_and_join_tables`` already does this join, and aggregates every numeric column with ``mean``. That silently answers a different question per column: four pathogens' total area becomes an average area, a count becomes an average count, and a minimum becomes a mean of minima, which is not a minimum of anything. The join is otherwise sound -- it is where the parent link, the timelapse structured-data name and the cardinality checks live -- so this module changes what the aggregation is, not how the tables find each other.
records.label: spacr.merge_tables#3

records.translation: ``spacr.io._read_and_join_tables`` hefur þegar þetta tengjast, og tengjast hvernum tölum með ``mean``. Það svari þögulega öðruvísi spurningu á kolumni: fjórar sýkils samfélagið verður miðjandi svæðið, tölur verður miðjan tölur, og mínúmi verður miðja mínima, sem er ekki mínúma af neinu.

records.context: Measured on a synthetic infected/uninfected table with twelve pathogen columns, the median fill produced a centroid gap of 0.06 -- almost nothing -- and a dispersion ratio of 0.11. The centroid statistic alone would not have detected it, because a median fill puts the missing objects in the middle of the present ones rather than away from them. Both are reported, and ``severity`` is whichever is worse.
records.label: spacr.merge_tables.missingness_leak#10

records.translation: Mæddur á syntetískum smitandi / ósmitandi tól með tólf sýklum, median fylgjur framleiðir centróða fjarlægð 0.06 - næstum ekkert - og fjölbreytingu samræmi 0.11. centróður tölur sjálfur myndi ekki hafa uppgötvað það, vegna þess að median fyllur setja misnotandi hlutum í miðju núverandi en ekki langt frá þeim. Bæði eru tilkynnt, og ``severity`` er hvaða er verra.

records.context: ``centroid_gap`` the missing objects sit elsewhere. Near 1 means the projection has moved them about as far as the map is wide. ``dispersion_ratio`` the missing objects collapse. ``reduce_dimensions`` fills with the column median, so every uninfected cell gets the same value on every pathogen column and they land on one point. Near 0 means they have no spread of their own.

records.translation: ``centroid_gap`` saknar hlutar sitja annars staðar. Næstum 1 þýðir að sýningin hefur flytja þá um þar sem kartan er breiður. ``dispersion_ratio`` að mismunandi hlutum rennast. ``reduce_dimensions`` fylgir með miðjalli, þannig að hver uninfected fruma fær sömu gildi á hverjum sýkli stólum og þeir landast á einum punkti. records.context: The **Regression** microscope image field opens this module because :func:`perform_regression` is its main entry point: it joins per-microplate sample position image scores to sequencing counts and estimates guide- or gene-level associations for a pooled screen.  The module also contains a separate classical machine-learning workflow, :func:`generate_ml_scores`, which trains a machine-learning classification model on measured single-object features and turns those predictions into the score table a regression can consume.
records.label: spacr.ml#2
records.source: The **Regression** tile opens this module because :func:`perform_regression` is its main entry point: it joins per-well image scores to sequencing counts and estimates guide- or gene-level associations for a pooled screen.  The module also contains a separate classical machine-learning workflow, :func:`generate_ml_scores`, which trains a classifier on measured single-object features and turns those predictions into the score table a regression can consume.
records.translation: **Regression** microscope myndbönd opnar þetta modul Því að :func:`perform_regression` er mikilvægasta innfangastaður hennar: það tengist per-mikroplate sýn staðsetningu myndaskoða til að fylgjast með tölur og uppskattar leiðbeiningar- eða gen-hæð samskipti fyrir samsettu skjár. Modulinn inniheldur einnig sérstakt klassískur véllæringu vinnuflokk, :func:`generate_ml_scores`, sem þjálfa töfrun kennslunarmóli á meiddum einum hlutum eiginleika og snúa þessar fyrirspurnir í skólanum sem regressur getur notað.

records.context: Regression results go into a new, non-overwriting ``<output root>/results/<analysis kind>[_n]`` directory.  ``results.csv`` is the primary combined table; ``results_grna.csv`` and ``results_gene.csv`` make the fitted levels explicit, and ``results_significant.csv`` records thresholded hits.  The same directory holds summaries, diagnostics, volcano and laboratory microplate figures, optional publication-panel packages, resource measurements, or a detailed failure report.  A requested level with no fitted rows is kept as a header-only CSV so downstream tools can distinguish "tested, no rows" from a missing artifact.  Classical ML writes predictions, feature-importance tables, evaluation results, and a laboratory microplate heatmap beneath ``results``.
records.label: spacr.ml#6

records.context: A continuous response with no threshold raises ``ValueError``. Picking a cut for the user — the mean, the median, 0.5 — would silently redefine the hypothesis being tested: on a screening experiment whose microplate sample position scores run 0.2-0.8 a median split calls half the laboratory microplate positive by construction, and the resulting hit list is a plausible, unfalsifiable artefact of the split.
records.label: spacr.ml.binarise_response#4
records.source: A continuous response with no threshold raises ``ValueError``. Picking a cut for the user — the mean, the median, 0.5 — would silently redefine the hypothesis being tested: on a screen whose well scores run 0.2-0.8 a median split calls half the plate positive by construction, and the resulting hit list is a plausible, unfalsifiable artefact of the split.
records.translation: A stöðugt svör með engum hringjum hækkar ``ValueError``. Að taka skot fyrir notandinn - miðjan, miðjan 0.5 - myndi þollega endurtekinir hugmyndin sem er prófað: á skreynslu tilraun þar sem brunninn staðsetningar renn 0.2-0.8 miðjan skilja kalla hálfan af mikrorópstæði jákvætt með byggingu, og niðurstöður hit listan er áreiðanlegur, ófalsið artefakt skilja.

records.context: Centring gives the intercept a meaning. A fitted intercept is the response where every predictor is zero, which on a screen design is a microplate sample position with no guide in it -- a point that does not exist. Centred on the negative controls, the intercept is the control level, and every coefficient reads directly as "this far above or below the controls".

records.context: dependent_variable : str Name of the response column. random_row_column_effects : bool, default=False Reserve ``plateID``, ``rowID`` and ``columnID`` for the grouping and variance-component structure in :func:`fit_mixed_model` instead of adding them as fixed effects. block_screen : bool, default=False Add ``screenID`` as a fixed effect. Use :func:`screen_is_blockable` before enabling this for user data. level : {'grna', 'gene'}, default='grna' Resolution represented by the formula. ``'grna'`` uses ``fraction:grna`` and ``'gene'`` uses ``gene_fraction:gene``. intercept : {'fitted', 'zero', 'control', 'value'}, default='fitted' What the intercept is. ``'fitted'`` estimates it. ``'zero'`` takes it out of the design, so the fit passes through the origin and a coefficient is a whole predicted score rather than a departure from a baseline. ``'control'`` keeps the term and is completed by the caller, which centres the response on the negative controls first -- the intercept is then the control level by construction. ``'value'`` suppresses the term as well, because the caller has shifted the response by a number the user gave and the intercept is pinned at exactly that number. model_plate_position : bool, default=True Include laboratory microplate position in the model. With ``random_row_column_effects=False`` it is included as fixed laboratory microplate, row, and column terms; with ``random_row_column_effects=True`` laboratory microplate supplies the grouping variable and row/column are variance components. New application settings default to ``False`` even though this helper retains ``True`` for API compatibility.
records.label: spacr.ml.prepare_formula#2
records.source: dependent_variable : str Name of the response column. random_row_column_effects : bool, default=False Reserve ``plateID``, ``rowID`` and ``columnID`` for the grouping and variance-component structure in :func:`fit_mixed_model` instead of adding them as fixed effects. block_screen : bool, default=False Add ``screenID`` as a fixed effect. Use :func:`screen_is_blockable` before enabling this for user data. level : {'grna', 'gene'}, default='grna' Resolution represented by the formula. ``'grna'`` uses ``fraction:grna`` and ``'gene'`` uses ``gene_fraction:gene``. intercept : {'fitted', 'zero', 'control', 'value'}, default='fitted' What the intercept is. ``'fitted'`` estimates it. ``'zero'`` takes it out of the design, so the fit passes through the origin and a coefficient is a whole predicted score rather than a departure from a baseline. ``'control'`` keeps the term and is completed by the caller, which centres the response on the negative controls first -- the intercept is then the control level by construction. ``'value'`` suppresses the term as well, because the caller has shifted the response by a number the user gave and the intercept is pinned at exactly that number. model_plate_position : bool, default=True Include plate position in the model. With ``random_row_column_effects=False`` it is included as fixed plate, row, and column terms; with ``random_row_column_effects=True`` plate supplies the grouping variable and row/column are variance components. New application settings default to ``False`` even though this helper retains ``True`` for API compatibility.
records.translation: dependent_variable : str Nafn viðbrögð kolumns. random_row_column_effects : bool, default=False Reserve ``plateID``, ``rowID`` og ``columnID`` fyrir hópning og breyting-komponent byggingu í :func:`fit_mixed_model` í stað þess að bæta þeim sem stöðug áhrif. block_screen : bool, default=False Hættu ``screenID`` sem stöðugt áhrif. Notaðu :func:`screen_is_blockable` áður en þú gerir þetta fyrir notandi gögnum. level : {'grna', 'gene'}, default='grna' Resolútur sem er tilkynnt með formúlu. ``'grna'`` notar ``fraction:grna`` og ``'gene'`` notar ``gene_fraction:gene``. intercept : {'fitted', 'zero', 'control', 'value'}, default='fitted' Hvað er greiningurinn. ``'fitted'`` ákvarða það. ``'zero'`` tekur það út úr hönnunum, þannig að viðeigandi fer í gegnum uppruna og coeficient er heild fyrirvisað stig en út úr grunnlinni. ``'control'`` heldur skilaboðina og er lokið af hringandi, sem miðlar svörun á neikvæðum stjórnum fyrst - snerturinn er þá stjórnsæli eftir byggingu. ``'value'`` hættir skilaboðina líka, vegna þess að hringandi hefur breytt svarið með tölvu sem notandinn gefur og greiningurinn er spinn á nákvæmlega þennan tölvu. model_plate_position : bool, default=True Inniheldur mikróplata staðsetningu í myndavélinu. Með ``random_row_column_effects=False`` er það greint sem fasteign mikróplata, röð og stefnu skilyrði; með ``random_row_column_effects=True`` platan gefur hópur breytinguna og rán/klúmin eru breytingareikningar. Nýja notkun settingar standa upp á ``False`` jafnvel þótt þessi hjálparinn halda ``True`` fyrir API samskipti.

records.context: A per-well positive count is not comparable between microplate sample positions of different size: ``process_scores`` sums the response for the count models, so a well of 2000 cells contributes roughly four times the count of a well of 500 at the identical underlying rate. Modelling that count without ``offset(log(Ntotal))`` asks the covariates to explain well size, and any covariate correlated with it comes back as a hit. Measured on a 400-well simulation with a nuisance covariate that drives well size and nothing else, and a true rate coefficient of +1.5: without the offset the nuisance term came back at +1.88 with p = 0, ahead of the real effect; with it, +0.002 with p = 0.90.
records.label: spacr.ml.regression_model._poisson_offset#1
records.source: A per-well positive count is not comparable between wells of different size: ``process_scores`` sums the response for the count models, so a well of 2000 cells contributes roughly four times the count of a well of 500 at the identical underlying rate. Modelling that count without ``offset(log(Ntotal))`` asks the covariates to explain well size, and any covariate correlated with it comes back as a hit. Measured on a 400-well simulation with a nuisance covariate that drives well size and nothing else, and a true rate coefficient of +1.5: without the offset the nuisance term came back at +1.88 with p = 0, ahead of the real effect; with it, +0.002 with p = 0.90.
records.translation: A per-well jákvæð tákn er ekki samanburður milli brunna af mismunandi stærð: ``process_scores`` sumir svörun fyrir táknar móður, þannig að bótur af 2000 cells bidrar um fjórum sinnum táknum 500 á sama grundvöru. Tákn sem tákna án ``offset(log(Ntotal))`` biðja covariates til að útskýra brunnur stærð, og hvaða covariota tengd við það kemur aftur sem hit. Miður á 400-well sömu með neyðingu covariaat sem dreifir gott stærð og ekkert annað, og raunverulegur hámarkoeficient af +1.5: án afgreiðslu neyðs tími kom aftur á +1.88 með p = 0, fyrir raunveruleika áhrif; með það, +0.00 með p2 = 0.90.

records.context: **both masks empty** — ``ari = 1.0``, ``iou_matched_fraction = 1.0``, ``mean_matched_iou = nan``. Two models that both say "there is nothing in this microscope field of view" have made the same statement, and that is agreement; the alternative (``nan``) would drop the microscope field of view out of every aggregate, so an empty image data channel would silently shrink the sample. records.context: **Every download is checksummed, and verification happens before use.** A checkpoint truncated by a dropped connection, or swapped for a different one at the same URL, still loads. It does not throw; it produces silently different masks, and the run that used it looks exactly like the run that did not. So :func:`fetch` hashes what arrived and compares it to the hash the catalogue published: a mismatch deletes the file and throws :class:`ChecksumMismatch` — the entry is never registered. The hash that was actually computed is stored on the returned entry, so "verified" means "these bytes", not "this filename".
records.label: spacr.model_zoo#9
records.source: **Every download is checksummed, and verification happens before use.** A checkpoint truncated by a dropped connection, or swapped for a different one at the same URL, still loads. It does not raise; it produces silently different masks, and the run that used it looks exactly like the run that did not. So :func:`fetch` hashes what arrived and compares it to the hash the catalogue published: a mismatch deletes the file and raises :class:`ChecksumMismatch` — the entry is never registered. The hash that was actually computed is stored on the returned entry, so "verified" means "these bytes", not "this filename".
records.translation: **Ekki niðurstöður er skoðað, og staðfesting gerist áður en notað.** A athygli staður rökkt af slökkt tengsl, eða skipt fyrir mismunandi á sama URL, enn loður. Það kasta ekki; það framleiðir hlýtið mismunuð maskar, og keyrslan sem það notaði lítur nákvæmlega eins og keyra sem ekki gerði. Svo :func:`fetch` hash það sem kom og samanburður það við hash útgáfu listanum: mismatch fjarlægir failið og kasta :class:`ChecksumMismatch` — inntalið er aldrei skráður. hash sem var raunverulega reiknað er geymt á endurheimtu inntalinum, Svo "verified" þýðir "these bytes", ekki "this filename".

records.context: Under :data:`REPLACE` — the default — an annotation whose namespace is *exactly* ``namespace`` is updated in place. Nothing is created, nothing is unlinked and **nothing is deleted**; a re-run therefore leaves one annotation rather than a growing pile, and an annotation in any other namespace (a colleague's, OMERO's own bulk annotations) is never even considered. When more than one already exists — only possible after an :data:`APPEND` run or a concurrent writer — the oldest (lowest id) is updated and the rest are reported in ``duplicates`` rather than removed, because an annotation may be linked elsewhere.
records.label: spacr.omero.plan_annotation#2

When more than one already exists — only possible after an :data:`APPEND` run or a concurrent writer — the oldest (lowest id) is updated and the rest are reported in ``duplicates`` rather than removed, because an annotation may be linked elsewhere.
records.translation: Under :data:`REPLACE` — að formi — notkun sem er *exactly* ``namespace`` er uppfærður í stað. Enginn er skapar, ekkert er ekki tengt og **nið er fjarlægð**; a endurnýja því yfirgefur einn notkun í stað þess að vaxa, og notun í hvaða annarra nafnsvæði (kollega, OMERO eigin fjölbreytni notkun) er aldrei jafnvel tekið í huga. records.translation: Miðar á hverjum fjölmiðlum stefnu yfir stefnu sem raunverulega hafa verð þar, plus ``n_objects``. records.translation: `ops_stitch` leysa þar sem hver mikroscope myndarfelli situr og hugsanlega ekki halda pikselna - brunnur A1 er 26,855 x 26,865, sem er 1.4 GB eins og uint16 fyrir einn rás, og hvert síðar skref myndi lesa í gegnum það.

records.context: Averaging the overlaps gives a measured noise gain of about 1.15x on the image data channel segmentation runs on. records.label: spacr.ops_compose#3
records.source: Averaging the overlaps gives a measured noise gain of about 1.15x on the channel segmentation runs on. There is only one DAPI acquisition, so averaging across cycles does not apply; the gain comes from the raster's 14% overlap, where two tiles imaged the same nuclei.
records.translation: Miðarleika yfirliti gefur mættu hljóðbót um 1.15x á rás segmenningu fer á. Það er aðeins einn DAPI upphæð, þannig að meðaltali á milli hjólum er ekki gildir; bótin kemur frá 14% yfirlitið, þar sem tvö mikroskópur myndbótar mynda sama kjarna.

records.context: This constraint is enforced in code. A mean across cycles of a four-image data channel readout still looks like a four-image data channel readout: ``call_reads`` accepts it, returns a barcode of the right length, and every downstream table fills in. The processing session completes, the numbers are plausible, and the barcodes are noise. There is no later check that can catch it, because nothing downstream knows what the per-cycle values were. So :func:`decode_input` refuses an array whose cycle axis has been collapsed, and this module offers no way to average one.

records.translation: Phenotype rásir eru prófað " á sama objekt ids", og fenotype mætt í mörgum hjólum er nokkrar prófa af einum fjöldi - þannig að meðaltalinn hækkar nákvæmni sínu, eins og meðaltalið Hoechst á mikroskópum myndum sviði gerir þegar þeir yfirlappur.

records.context: Separate from :func:`decode_input`: the same operation is right for a phenotype channel and destroys a sequencing one, so it is two functions and not one with a flag: a flag would make that a caller's decision, and it is a property of the channel.
records.label: spacr.ops_sample.average_over_cycles#2
records.source: Separate from :func:`decode_input`: the same operation is right for a phenotype channel and destroys a sequencing one, so it is two functions and not one with a flag: a flag would make that a caller's decision, and it is a property of the channel.
records.translation: Skilið frá :func:`decode_input`: sama vinnu er rétt fyrir fenotype rás og eyðileggur sekkingu einn, þannig að það er tvö starfsemi og ekki einn með flagga: flagg myndi gera það ákvörðun samkeppnanda, og það er eign rás.

records.context: ``per_cycle[c][k]`` is :func:`sample_objects`' output for cycle ``c``, channel ``k``. Every entry must be the same length.

records.context: when a cycle is missing channels, when the lengths disagree, or -- the one that matters -- when only one cycle is offered, which is what a caller who has already averaged them hands over.
records.label: spacr.ops_sample.decode_input#3
records.source: when a cycle is missing channels, when the lengths disagree, or -- the one that matters -- when only one cycle is offered, which is what a caller who has already averaged them hands over.
records.translation: þegar hjól er að missa rás, þegar lengdarnir eru óþekktar, eða - það sem skiptir máli - þegar aðeins einn hjól býður upp, sem er það sem kallaður sem hefur þegar miðlað þeim hendur yfir.

records.context: One cycle is refused. A barcode is a sequence across cycles; a single "cycle" reaching here is either a run that lost its cycle axis or a caller who collapsed it. Both produce a decodable barcode of noise, and neither is visible downstream. If a single-cycle experiment ever needs decoding it should say so explicitly rather than arrive looking like this mistake.
records.label: spacr.ops_sample.decode_input#4
records.source: One cycle is refused. A barcode is a sequence across cycles; a single "cycle" reaching here is either a run that lost its cycle axis or a caller who collapsed it. Both produce a decodable barcode of noise, and neither is visible downstream. If a single-cycle experiment ever needs decoding it should say so explicitly rather than arrive looking like this mistake.
records.translation: Eitt hjól er neitað. Barkódur er sekúnd á tvær hjólum. ein "cycle" að ná hér er annaðhvort keyrir sem tapði hjólahús sín eða rennari sem kollapsaði það. Bæði framleiða dekodable barcode af hljóð, og er ekki séð niðurstríð. Ef einn hjól reynslu þarf alltaf að dekodera það ætti að segja svo útskýrt í stað þess að koma að líta eins og þessi mistök.

records.context: a name per channel, for the column names.
records.label: spacr.ops_sample.reads_rows#3
records.source: a name per channel, for the column names.
records.translation: nafni á rás, fyrir nafni stefnu.

records.context: the letter each channel votes for; when given, each row carries the base this cycle called and its margin.

records.source: the letter each channel votes for; when given, each row carries the base this cycle called and its margin.
records.translation: bréfið hver rás rösta fyrir; þegar gefið er, hver rán bori grunn þessa rán og margins hennar.

records.context: Give each segmented cell the barcode its reads agree on.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_cells#0
records.source: Give each segmented cell the barcode its reads agree on.
records.translation: Gefðu hverjum segmentum frumum barkódinn sem lesendur hans samþykkir.

records.context: ``{label: {"barcode", "reads", "agreeing", "fraction", "quality"}}`` for every cell that met the bar.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_cells#10
records.source: ``{label: {"barcode", "reads", "agreeing", "fraction", "quality"}}`` for every cell that met the bar.
records.translation: ``{label: {"barcode", "reads", "agreeing", "fraction", "quality"}}`` fyrir hvert frumu sem ná barinn.

records.context: The defaults (``min_reads=2``, ``min_fraction=0.6``) are conservative. A single read cannot be checked against anything, and a single mis-called base would silently hand a cell the wrong perturbation. A cell with no barcode costs statistical detection sensitivity; a cell with the WRONG barcode moves a real phenotype onto another guide's average and is not recoverable downstream, because nothing later can tell it happened.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_cells#2
records.source: The defaults (``min_reads=2``, ``min_fraction=0.6``) are conservative. A single read cannot be checked against anything, and a single mis-called base would silently hand a cell the wrong perturbation. A cell with no barcode costs statistical power; a cell with the WRONG barcode moves a real phenotype onto another guide's average and is not recoverable downstream, because nothing later can tell it happened.
records.translation: Skammslanir (``min_reads=2``, ``min_fraction=0.6``) eru viðhalda. einn lesing er ekki hægt að athuga fyrir neitt, og einn rangt kallað grunn myndi þöglu senda frumu við rangt störf. frumu með engin ræðalega kostar statískur uppgötvun öryggi; frumu med WRONG ræðalkód flytja raunverulegur fenotyp á miðjan annarra leiðandi og er ekki endurnýjandi niðurstríð, vegna þess að ekkert síðar getur sagt það gerðist.

records.context: Reads landing on label 0 -- background, between cells -- are discarded rather than attached to the nearest cell. A read that segmentation did not place inside anything is a read whose owner is unknown.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_cells#3
records.source: Reads landing on label 0 -- background, between cells -- are discarded rather than attached to the nearest cell. A read that segmentation did not place inside anything is a read whose owner is unknown.
records.translation: Lesa landing á merki 0 - bakgrunn, milli frumna - eru fjarlægð í stað þess að tengjast nálægustu frumu. Lesa að segmentaði var ekki staðsett inn í neitt er lesa sem eigandi þeirra er óþekkt.

records.context: how many reads a cell needs before it may be assigned.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.assign_reads_to_cells#8
records.source: how many reads a cell needs before it may be assigned.
records.translation: Hversu margir lætur fruman þörf áður en það getur verið veitt.

records.context: Without correction the raw argmax is biased: each dye emits into its neighbours' channels, so a channel that is bright overall wins comparisons it should lose, and the bias is systematic rather than noise: it mis-calls the same base everywhere.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#1
records.source: Without correction the raw argmax is biased: each dye emits into its neighbours' channels, so a channel that is bright overall wins comparisons it should lose, and the bias is systematic rather than noise: it mis-calls the same base everywhere.
records.translation: Án réttlætis er rauðargmax biased: hver dye út í rásum nágrannanna, þannig að rás sem er ljóst yfirleitt vinnur samanburði það ætti að missa, og bias er systematísk í stað þess að hlýja: það hlýtur sömu grundvöru alls staðar.

records.context: The correction is fitted from the data rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each image data channel, the spots where that image data channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that image data channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#2
records.source: The correction is fitted FROM THE DATA rather than from a calibration file, because it depends on the stain, the filters and the exposure -- which are properties of the run, not of the instrument. For each channel, the spots where that channel dominates are found, and their mean vector becomes that channel's axis; the matrix of those axes, inverted, maps observed intensity back onto base identity.
records.translation: Korrétan er búin frá gögnum en ekki frá kalíbrerafili, vegna þess að það er afhvert á litun, ámyndum og útskýringu - sem eru eiginleika áferð, ekki á tilefni. fyrir hverri mynd gögninna, staðir þar sem rás dominates eru fundið, og miðjan vektor þeirra verður þessi mynd gögi rás; matrix þessar axes, snúið, kartanum athuga hjarta aftur á grunninn identity.

records.context: ``"percentile"`` takes spots above ``percentile`` in a channel; ``"median"`` takes spots where the channel is the argmax. Percentile is the more robust of the two when one base is rare, which is the case a median call gets wrong.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#4
records.source: ``"percentile"`` takes spots above ``percentile`` in a channel; ``"median"`` takes spots where the channel is the argmax. Percentile is the more robust of the two when one base is rare, which is the case a median call gets wrong.
records.translation: ``"percentile"`` tekur stötur yfir ``percentile`` í rásinni; ``"median"`` taka stötur þar sem rásin er argmax.

records.context: let the unmixing multiply run on the card. One tiny matrix applied to every spot of every cycle is a large multiply by a small operand, which is the shape that goes to a card well.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.compensate_crosstalk#6
records.source: let the unmixing multiply run on the card. One tiny matrix applied to every spot of every cycle is a large multiply by a small operand, which is the shape that goes to a card well.
records.translation: Einn smá matrix sem er notuð á hverri stöðu á hverjum hjólum er mikill fjölbreytni af litlu operandi, sem er myndin sem fara á kortinu brunnur.

records.context: A sequencing spot changes colour from cycle to cycle, which is exactly what a constant piece of debris does not do. Taking the standard deviation over the CYCLE axis and then the mean over channels therefore scores "something here changed" rather than "something here is bright", and the brightest object in a microscope field of view is very often not a read.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.estimate_read_locations#1
records.source: A sequencing spot changes colour from cycle to cycle, which is exactly what a constant piece of debris does not do. Taking the standard deviation over the CYCLE axis and then the mean over channels therefore scores "something here changed" rather than "something here is bright", and the brightest object in a field is very often not a read.
records.translation: A eftirliti stað breytir litur frá hjól til hjól, sem er nákvæmlega það sem stöðugt stökk af slökkum gerir ekki. Að taka standa fjarlægð yfir CYCLE axis og þá miðjan yfir rás því skora "something here changed" en "something here is bright", og ljósi objekt í mikroskópum sviði er mjög oft ekki lesin.

records.context: With a single cycle there is no cycle-to-cycle variance to measure, so the standard deviation is taken across channels instead -- a spot that is one colour rather than grey. That is a weaker signal and a one-cycle experiment is a weaker experiment; it is supported because the alternative is failing on a legitimate input.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.estimate_read_locations#2
records.source: With a single cycle there is no cycle-to-cycle variance to measure, so the standard deviation is taken across channels instead -- a spot that is one colour rather than grey. That is a weaker signal and a one-cycle experiment is a weaker experiment; it is supported because the alternative is failing on a legitimate input.
records.translation: Með einum hjólum er engin hjól-til-sykli breyting til að mæla, þannig að standa fjarlægð er tekið yfir rás í staðinn - staður sem er einn lit en ekki græna. Það er svagari merki og einn hjól reynslu er svagi reynslu; það er stuðlað vegna þess að valkosturinn er ekki á lögum innfang.

records.context: Per-cycle, per-image data channel intensity at each peak.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.extract_bases#0
records.source: Per-cycle, per-channel intensity at each peak.
records.translation: Per-sykli, per-rás hjarta á hverri topp.

records.context: ignore maxima below this. ``None`` keeps every local maximum and leaves the decision to the caller, which is the right default because the useful cutoff depends on the stain.
records.label: spacr.ops_sbs.find_peaks#4
records.source: ignore maxima below this. ``None`` keeps every local maximum and leaves the decision to the caller, which is the right default because the useful cutoff depends on the stain.
records.translation: ``None`` varðveita hverri staðbundna maximum og yfirgefur ákvörðun til hringjandi, sem er rétt ástand vegna þess að gagnlegur hnappur afhöndur af litun.

records.context: Tooltips describe the setting's effect on the result rather than repeating its name. For example, "The number of features" repeats the label, whereas "More features find more overlap and cost time and memory; below about 2000 a sparse field stops matching" states the effect of raising or lowering it.
records.label: spacr.ops_settings#2
records.source: Tooltips describe the setting's effect on the result rather than repeating its name. For example, "The number of features" repeats the label, whereas "More features find more overlap and cost time and memory; below about 2000 a sparse field stops matching" states the effect of raising or lowering it.
records.translation: Til dæmis, "The number of features" endurtekið merki, þar sem "Mæri eiginleika finna meira yfirlapp og kostar tíma og minningu; undir um 2000 skammt reitur hættir að mæta" segir áhrif á að auka eða draga það.

records.context: Positions come from a least-squares solve, not a walk along the edges. Chaining placements from a seed gives every microscope image field the accumulated error of whatever path reached it, and on a round well the paths are long; solving all the edges at once spreads the residual instead and gives one answer no matter which microscope image field is called the origin.
records.label: spacr.ops_solve.solve_placements#1
records.source: Positions come from a least-squares solve, not a walk along the edges. Chaining placements from a seed gives every tile the accumulated error of whatever path reached it, and on a round well the paths are long; solving all the edges at once spreads the residual instead and gives one answer no matter which tile is called the origin.
records.translation: Positions koma frá minnsta-squares leysa, ekki að fara á hliðina. Kjarna staðsetningar frá sætu gefur hverri mikroskóp myndræði uppbyggð mistök af hvaða leið hefur náð það, og á runda brunnur leiðir eru lengi; leysa allar hliðin á einu breytir eftirfarandi í staðinn og gefur einn svör óháð hvaða mikroskop myndræðræði er kallað uppruna.

records.context: The origin is pinned to the lowest-numbered site of each connected component, so a microplate sample position that registers in two pieces still returns both rather than failing -- the caller can see the components in the result and say so.
records.label: spacr.ops_solve.solve_placements#2
records.source: The origin is pinned to the lowest-numbered site of each connected component, so a well that registers in two pieces still returns both rather than failing -- the caller can see the components in the result and say so.
records.translation: Fyrirtækið er spjótt á niðurstaða staður á hverjum tengdum hlutum, svo brunna sem skráir í tveimur hlutum enn aftur bæði í stað þess að missa - hringandi getur séð hlutum í niðurstöðu og segja það.

records.context: :mod:`spacr.ops_layout` says which microscope image fields touch, :mod:`spacr.ops_register` says how far apart a touching pair is, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve` says where each microscope image field ends up, and this runs the three of them over a microplate sample position and reports what happened.
records.label: spacr.ops_stitch#1
records.source: :mod:`spacr.ops_layout` says which tiles touch, :mod:`spacr.ops_register` says how far apart a touching pair is, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve` says where each tile ends up, and this runs the three of them over a well and reports what happened.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.ops_layout` segir hvaða mikroskópur myndarfelli ber, :mod:`spacr.ops_register` segir hversu langt fjarlægð berandi par er, :mod:`spacr.ops_solve` segir hvar hver mikroskopur myndarefni endar, og þetta keyrir þremur þeirra yfir mikroskrópur sýnileg stöðu og segir hvað gerðist.

records.context: and was wrong: the driver negated the correlation's shift, the unwrap then chose the representative one period out, identically in every edge of a direction, and the microplate sample position came out one pitch per column too large in both axes. Every edge still agreed with every other edge, so the residual was perfect and the count was perfect. A uniform error is invisible to a residual. Only the canvas said otherwise, and only because 21 columns of a known pitch has an arithmetic answer -- 20 x 1267 + 1480 = 26,820 -- to check it against.
records.label: spacr.ops_stitch#5
records.source: and was wrong: the driver negated the correlation's shift, the unwrap then chose the representative one period out, identically in every edge of a direction, and the well came out one pitch per column too large in both axes. Every edge still agreed with every other edge, so the residual was perfect and the count was perfect. A uniform error is invisible to a residual. Only the canvas said otherwise, and only because 21 columns of a known pitch has an arithmetic answer -- 20 x 1267 + 1480 = 26,820 -- to check it against.
records.translation: og það var rangt: bíllinn neitaði breytingu á tengslum, unwrap þá valdi representative einn tímabil út, sömu í hverri vegi á leiðinni, og brunninn staðsetningu kom út einn skál á kolumn of stór í báðum axis. Hver skál var enn samræmi við hverri annar skál, þannig að resturinn var fullkominn og tákn er fullkomin. Ein einstakt mistök er óhugsanlegt fyrir restinn. Einungis kanvas sagði öðruvísi, og aðeins vegna þess að 21 skál af þekktum skál hefur arithmetic svarið - 20 x 1267 + 1480 = 26,820 - til að skoða það gegn.

records.context: the well model. None fits the circle to ``sites`` or, failing that, to the measured 333-microscope field of view well.
records.label: spacr.ops_stitch.stitch_well#3
records.source: the well model. None fits the circle to ``sites`` or, failing that, to the measured 333-field well.
records.translation: None tengur hjólinu ``sites`` eða, ef það er ekki, til 333-mikroscóps sýningssvæðinu brunnur.

records.context: ``if not objects_ready(db):`` is the natural way to write the data-selection boundary, and it must answer the verdict rather than "an object exists". :attr:`reason` is still there to say why the answer was no.
records.label: spacr.ops_store.Readiness.__bool__#1
records.source: ``if not objects_ready(db):`` is the natural way to write the gate, and it must answer the verdict rather than "an object exists". :attr:`reason` is still there to say why the answer was no.
records.translation: ``if not objects_ready(db):`` er náttúrulega leiðin til að skrifa gate, og það verður að svara á ákvörðun í stað þess að "an object exists". :attr:`reason` er enn til að segja hvers vegna svarið var ekki.

records.context: One named preset: what it is, what it looks like, what to run.
records.label: spacr.organelle_types.OrganelleType#0
records.source: One named preset: what it is, what it looks like, what to run.
records.translation: Einn nefndur preset: hvað það er, hvað það lítur út, hvað á að keyra.

records.context: how many slots. Zero is legal and means a run with no organelle at all -- most runs -- and returns an empty tuple.
records.label: spacr.organelle_types.organelle_roles#1
records.source: how many slots. Zero is legal and means a run with no organelle at all -- most runs -- and returns an empty tuple.
records.translation: Null er löglegt og þýðir að keyra með engin organelle alls - flestir keyra - og endurheimtir óþægilegt.

records.context: the prefix to translate it into. Any object's prefix is accepted, not only a slot's: the same translation answers "what is this decision called for the pathogen", and the settings tables use it that way. What is checked is the Structured-data name, because translating something that is not a primary organelle setting produces a structured-data name no reader has ever heard of.
records.label: spacr.organelle_types.slot_setting#2
records.source: the prefix to translate it into. Any object's prefix is accepted, not only a slot's: the same translation answers "what is this decision called for the pathogen", and the settings tables use it that way. What is checked is the KEY, because translating something that is not a primary organelle setting produces a key no reader has ever heard of.
records.translation: áætlunin til að þýða það inn. Áætlun á hvaða hlut er samþykkt, ekki aðeins slott: sömu þýðingu svara "hvað er þetta ákvörðun kallað fyrir sýkli", og setningar tabla notar það þannig. Það sem er athugið er byggð-data nafn, vegna þess að þýðing eitthvað sem er ekki primary organelle setting framleiðir byggð data nafn enginn lesandi hefur aldrei heyrt um.

records.context: Optional filters operate on cell or nucleus area and intensity. Each filter uses distance from the median in scaled median absolute deviations (MADs), which is less sensitive to skewed measurements than a standard-deviation threshold. Filtering precedes fraction-based annotation so excluded objects do not contribute to normalization denominators.
records.label: spacr.outlier_filter#1
records.source: Optional filters operate on cell or nucleus area and intensity. Each filter uses distance from the median in scaled median absolute deviations (MADs), which is less sensitive to skewed measurements than a standard-deviation threshold. Filtering precedes fraction-based annotation so excluded objects do not contribute to normalization denominators.
records.translation: Opcionalsfilter virkar á frumum eða kjörnum sviði og þunglyndi. Hver filter notar fjarlægð frá median í skalað median absolute deviations (MADs), sem er minna tilfinningalegt við skjóta mótum en standa-deviation bragð.

records.context: A pooled screening experiment has no single correct analysis. It has a model family, an aggregation rule, a unit of analysis, a set of nuisance effects, a multiple-testing correction, and three or four filtration cutoffs -- and a hit list that is stable across all of them is a very different claim from one that appears under exactly one combination.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep#1
records.source: A pooled screen has no single correct analysis. It has a model family, an aggregation rule, a unit of analysis, a set of nuisance effects, a multiple-testing correction, and three or four filtration cutoffs -- and a hit list that is stable across all of them is a very different claim from one that appears under exactly one combination.
records.translation: Það hefur mönnun fjölskyldu, aggregation regla, einkefni af rannsóknum, setur af neikvæðum áhrifum, multi-testing korreiðslu og þrjú eða fjórar skimunar - og hit lista sem er stöðugt yfir öllu þeirra er mjög öðruvísi ákvarðan frá því sem birtist undir nákvæmlega eitt samsetningu.

records.context: This module executes that comparison as one command. It builds a trial list from a search space, runs each trial into its own folder, and returns one tidy row per trial: the settings, whether it ran, how many microplate sample positions and guides survived, how many hits it called, where the named controls landed, and how long it took.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep#2
records.source: This module runs that comparison as one command. It builds a trial list from a search space, runs each trial into its own folder, and returns one tidy row per trial: the settings, whether it ran, how many wells and guides survived, how many hits it called, where the named controls landed, and how long it took.
records.translation: Það byggir tilraun listan frá söfnuðinu, fer hvert tilraunin inn í eigin mappuna, og endurheimtir einn tíu röð á tilraunum: settingar, hvort það var að keyra, hversu mörg mikroplata staður og leiðbeiningar lifði, hve mörg hit það kalla, hvar nefndar stjórnunar landdu, og hversu lengi það tók.

records.context: Lower the current worker's CPU, I/O, and OOM-kill priority.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep.be_polite#0
records.source: Lower the current worker's CPU, I/O, and OOM-kill priority.
records.translation: Að minnka CPU, I/O, og OOM-kill priority núverandi vinnsluferli.

records.context: The adjustments are best-effort and platform dependent. On Linux, the worker uses the lowest CPU and I/O priorities and sets ``oom_score_adj=800`` so it is preferred over interactive applications when the system is under memory pressure.
records.label: spacr.parameter_sweep.be_polite#1
records.source: The adjustments are best-effort and platform dependent. On Linux, the worker uses the lowest CPU and I/O priorities and sets ``oom_score_adj=800`` so it is preferred over interactive applications when the system is under memory pressure.
records.translation: Á Linux notar vinnsluferli niðurstaða CPU og I/O og setur ``oom_score_adj=800`` þannig að það er forðast yfir samskiptaverkefni þegar kerfið er undir minnsluþrýsi.

records.context: Checked between submissions, not only at the start: the other things on the machine -- an editor, the spaCR GUI, another analysis -- grow while the sweep runs, and the sweep must yield to them rather than race them.

Pass ``(1, 2, 3, 4)`` fyrir þessar áætlun.

records.context: The image goes to Cellpose as it is, RGB or grey, and Cellpose normalises it. It is not sent through the run's historical loader (``_load_normalized_images_and_labels`` with ``background=200``): on an 8-bit extracted image region that loader saturated every pixel to 1.0 -- measured on ``malnio__2.tif``, min = max = 1.0 in every image data channel -- so the run found no plaques while the preview, reading the image as it is, found 67. One function for both is what keeps them from disagreeing again.
records.label: spacr.plaque.segment_plaque_image#1
records.source: The image goes to Cellpose as it is, RGB or grey, and Cellpose normalises it. It is not sent through the run's historical loader (``_load_normalized_images_and_labels`` with ``background=200``): on an 8-bit crop that loader saturated every pixel to 1.0 -- measured on ``malnio__2.tif``, min = max = 1.0 in every channel -- so the run found no plaques while the preview, reading the image as it is, found 67. One function for both is what keeps them from disagreeing again.
records.translation: Myndin fer til Cellpose eins og það er, RGB eða græna, og Cellpose normalizes það. Það er ekki sendið í gegnum sögulegu laddareiknin (``_load_normalized_images_and_labels`` með ``background=200``): á 8 bitum myndskurði myndareikni sem laddari sýtur hvert piksel til 1.0 - mættur á ``malnio__2.tif``, min = max = 1.0 í hverjum gögnumálum á myndinni - þannig að flutninginn fann engin blöð meðan á fyrirmyndinni, að lesa myndina eins og hún er, Að finna 67. Eitt hlutverk fyrir báðum er það sem hættir þeim að misskilja aftur.

records.context: A merge that silently changed how a measurement was combined produces a number that is wrong and looks fine, so :class:`PlateMerge` carries what the panel has to say: the anchor and the row count, the rows each source contributed, the measurements ``columns='common'`` dropped, the laboratory microplate ids shared across screens -- and every column that fell through to :data:`spacr.merge_tables.DEFAULT_AGGREGATION` because no rule matched it. That last set is recomputed by re-walking ``AGGREGATION_RULES`` (:func:`default_aggregated_columns`) rather than listed anywhere, so it cannot drift out of step with the rules.
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements#11
records.source: A merge that silently changed how a measurement was combined produces a number that is wrong and looks fine, so :class:`PlateMerge` carries what the panel has to say: the anchor and the row count, the rows each source contributed, the measurements ``columns='common'`` dropped, the plate ids shared across screens -- and every column that fell through to :data:`spacr.merge_tables.DEFAULT_AGGREGATION` because no rule matched it. That last set is recomputed by re-walking ``AGGREGATION_RULES`` (:func:`default_aggregated_columns`) rather than listed anywhere, so it cannot drift out of step with the rules.
records.translation: A fúnur sem hljóðlega breytti hvernig mótin var sameiginlegt framleiðir fjölda sem er rangt og líður vel, þannig að :class:`PlateMerge` hefur það sem panelinn hefur að segja: rán og rán, rán sem hver forrit hjálpaði, mótum ``columns='common'`` gerðist, mikróplata IDs sem deildist í gegnum skjá - og hver kolumn sem fellur í gegnum :data:`spacr.merge_tables.DEFAULT_AGGREGATION` vegna þess að engin regla matched það. Það síðasta sett er endurskoðið með endurskoðun ``AGGREGATION_RULES`` (:func:`default_aggregated_columns`) í stað þess að listast alls staðar, svo það er ekki hægt að flýja út með reglum.

records.context: This module adds no merge logic of its own. spaCR already has four places that join measurement tables, and one of them (``io._read_and_join_tables``) aggregates every numeric column with ``mean``, which turns four pathogens' total area into an average area and a minimum into a mean of minima. This module composes existing functions instead:
records.label: spacr.plate_measurements#2
records.source: This module adds no merge logic of its own. spaCR already has four places that join measurement tables, and one of them (``io._read_and_join_tables``) aggregates every numeric column with ``mean``, which turns four pathogens' total area into an average area and a minimum into a mean of minima. This module composes existing functions instead:
records.translation: Þessir mólur bæta engin samskipti skilyrði sína. spaCR hefur þegar fjórar staðir sem tengjast móttablar, og einn þeirra (``io._read_and_join_tables``) sameina hver fjölbreytni stólur með ``mean``, sem breytist fjórum sýklum samsvæðinu í miðjandi svæði og mínima í miðjan mínima.

records.context: A text identifier that takes ``first`` must have one value per group. When it has more, the column is reported rather than resolved silently. records.context: The grid is **read off the data**. It used to be pinned to ``r1..r16`` by ``c1..c27``, so every microplate sample position of a 1536 laboratory microplate past row P or past column 27 fell outside the ``Categorical``, became NaN, and was dropped by the groupby — measured, in the database, and absent from the figure with nothing said. Rows and columns now go through :func:`spacr.plate_qc.parse_row_label` / ``parse_column_label`` (which is :mod:`spacr.schema`'s letter walk, so ``AA``…``AF`` and beyond are real rows), and the axes span exactly the microplate sample positions present: a 96 laboratory microplate is still 8x12 and a 384 still 16x24, because nothing is padded out to the largest format that exists.
records.label: spacr.plot.generate_plate_heatmap#1
records.source: The grid is **read off the data**. It used to be pinned to ``r1..r16`` by ``c1..c27``, so every well of a 1536 plate past row P or past column 27 fell outside the ``Categorical``, became NaN, and was dropped by the groupby — measured, in the database, and absent from the figure with nothing said. Rows and columns now go through :func:`spacr.plate_qc.parse_row_label` / ``parse_column_label`` (which is :mod:`spacr.schema`'s letter walk, so ``AA``…``AF`` and beyond are real rows), and the axes span exactly the wells present: a 96 plate is still 8x12 and a 384 still 16x24, because nothing is padded out to the largest format that exists.
records.translation: Netið er **read úr gögnum**. Það var venjulegt að vera snúað til ``r1..r16`` með ``c1..c27``, þannig að hvert brunna staðsetningu 1536 mikróbstæður fyrri rán P eða fyrri kolumn 27 fellur út úr ``Categorical``, varð NaN, og var hleypt af hópabí - mætt, í gögninum, og fjarlægð frá tölvu með ekkert sagt. Röfur og stólar fara nú í gegnum :func:`spacr.plate_qc.parse_row_label` / ``parse_column_label`` (þ.e. :mod:`spacr.schema` bokstaða ferð, svo ``AA``...``AF`` og neðan eru raunverulegar stefnu), og axarnir spara nákvæmlega brunnar til staðar: 96 rannsóknarmikróp er enn 8x12 og 384 enn 16x24, Því að ekkert er hættir út í stærsta form sem er til.

records.context: A microplate sample position that genuinely cannot be placed — a ``prc`` with too few parts, or a row/column token holding no position — is reported through :func:`spacr.errors.raise_if_strict` (an ``ERROR`` on ``spacr.errors``, or a raise under ``SPACR_STRICT_ERRORS``) naming the identifiers concerned. Replacing a silent drop with a quieter silent drop would fix nothing.
records.label: spacr.plot.generate_plate_heatmap#2
records.source: A well that genuinely cannot be placed — a ``prc`` with too few parts, or a row/column token holding no position — is reported through :func:`spacr.errors.raise_if_strict` (an ``ERROR`` on ``spacr.errors``, or a raise under ``SPACR_STRICT_ERRORS``) naming the identifiers concerned. Replacing a silent drop with a quieter silent drop would fix nothing.
records.translation: A brunna sem raunverulega er ekki hægt að setja - ``prc`` með of fáa hluta, eða rán/klór tókinn sem hefur engin stöðu - er sagt í gegnum :func:`spacr.errors.raise_if_strict` (ein ``ERROR`` á ``spacr.errors``, eða uppi undir ``SPACR_STRICT_ERRORS``) að nefna viðeigandi skilaboð.

records.context: :mod:`spacr.object_distances` says how far one object is from another, and :mod:`spacr.bystanders` says whether a cell has an infected neighbour. records.context: The frame edge is also a boundary. The distance-to-boundary microscope field of view is computed on a mask padded with one row of background all round, so a mask that runs to the edge of the image is treated as cut off there. Without the pad, cells at the top of the image would be scored as though the monolayer continued past it.
records.label: spacr.point_patterns#4
records.source: The frame edge is also a boundary. The distance-to-boundary field is computed on a mask padded with one row of background all round, so a mask that runs to the edge of the image is treated as cut off there. Without the pad, cells at the top of the image would be scored as though the monolayer continued past it.
records.translation: Frame edge er einnig takmörk. fjarlægð-til-grandi mikroscope sviði sýn er ritað á maski með einum stefnu bakgrundsins allt í kringum, þannig að maski sem flýja til edge myndinni er meðhöndlað sem skortur þar. án pad, frumur á toppinni myndinni myndi verið ritaður eins og ef monolayer áfram að fara yfir það.

records.context: One further departure is a *choice*, not a bug fix, and is exposed as a parameter: upstream splits a microplate sample position's imaged cells **uniformly** across the genes present (``prob = gene_in_well`` is a 0/1 vector), ignoring how abundant each gene is. :func:`simulate_imaging_plate` defaults to ``imaging_split='abundance'`` and keeps ``'uniform'`` for exact R parity.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate#16
records.source: One further departure is a *choice*, not a bug fix, and is exposed as a parameter: upstream splits a well's imaged cells **uniformly** across the genes present (``prob = gene_in_well`` is a 0/1 vector), ignoring how abundant each gene is. :func:`simulate_imaging_plate` defaults to ``imaging_split='abundance'`` and keeps ``'uniform'`` for exact R parity.
records.translation: Yfir útgangur er *valur*, ekki bug fix, og er útskýrt sem parámeter: upstream skiptir ámyndun frumur mikroplaður stöðu **einiformly** í gegnum genum sem eru til staðar (``prob = gene_in_well`` er 0/1 vektor), með því að takmarka hversu mikið hver gein er. :func:`simulate_imaging_plate` standa til ``imaging_split='abundance'`` og halda ``'uniform'`` fyrir nákvæmlega R parity.

records.context: The list above is about *fidelity* to the R. A simulator whose baseline shifted under a version bump would make every statistical detection sensitivity figure already quoted from it wrong, so turning either on is an explicit act.

A simulator whose baseline shifted under a version bump would make every power figure already quoted from it wrong, so turning either on is an explicit act.
records.translation: Listi yfir er um *fidelity* til R. Þessir tveir eru um fidelity til raunverulegur skimun, og báðir breytast uppsamlað statískur uppgötvun öryggi, þannig að þeir eru **off í staðsetningu**.

records.context: A pooled Toxoplasma CRISPR screening experiment has three noisy layers stacked on top of each other — which genotypes landed in which well, how many of a well's cells the microscope saw and how well the machine-learning classification model called them, and how many reads each genotype got out of the amplicon pool. The question a screener has to answer *before* spending the microscope time is "with this library, this many microplate sample positions, this many cells per well and a machine-learning classification model at 0.80/0.12, would I actually find a hit?". That is a statistical detection sensitivity analysis, and it is only answerable by simulation because no layer is analytically tractable once the other two are stacked on it.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate#3
records.source: A pooled Toxoplasma CRISPR screen has three noisy layers stacked on top of each other — which genotypes landed in which well, how many of a well's cells the microscope saw and how well the classifier called them, and how many reads each genotype got out of the amplicon pool. The question a screener has to answer *before* spending the microscope time is "with this library, this many wells, this many cells per well and a classifier at 0.80/0.12, would I actually find a hit?". That is a power analysis, and it is only answerable by simulation because no layer is analytically tractable once the other two are stacked on it.
records.translation: A tengd Toxoplasma CRISPR skimun tilraun hefur þrjár hræðilegar lagir staðið upp á sama - sem genotypes landið í sem vel, hversu margir af kólum í mikroskópinu sá og hversu vel véllæringu skilaboðin kallaði þá, og hve margir lesur hverja genotype kom út úr amplicon pool. Frá spurning sem skreyningurinn þarf að svara *frá* spara mikroskópsins tíma er " með þessari bókasafn, þetta mörg mikróplata prófa stöðu, þetta margir frumur í skreyti og véllært skilaboð mönnun á 0.80/0.12, myndi ég raunverulega finna hit? "Það er statískur uppgötvunandi skilaboðun, og það er aðeins hægt að svara með sömunar vegna þess að engin skreyttur er analýtiðilegis á tveimur.

records.context: The second thing neither spaCRPower nor the port did. A microplate sample position where the microscope found three cells produces a positive *fraction* that can only take the values 0, 1/3, 2/3 and 1; its binomial standard error is around 0.27, which is three times the entire gap between the machine-learning classification model's hit-cell and background rates. It carries essentially no information about which genotypes were in it — and it enters the fit as one more observation alongside a microplate sample position with four hundred cells.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.drop_low_cell_wells#1
records.source: The second thing neither spaCRPower nor the port did. A well where the microscope found three cells produces a positive *fraction* that can only take the values 0, 1/3, 2/3 and 1; its binomial standard error is around 0.27, which is three times the entire gap between the classifier's hit-cell and background rates. It carries essentially no information about which genotypes were in it — and it enters the fit as one more observation alongside a well with four hundred cells.
records.translation: A mikroskóp sem fann þremur frumur framleiðir jákvæð *fraktion* sem getur aðeins tekið verð 0, 1/3, 2/3 og 1; binomial standardifelli hennar er um 0.27, sem er þriggja sinnum helgi fjarlægð milli hit-fruma og bakgrunnsreikning mönnun Machine-learning. Það bori í alvöru engin upplýsingar um hvaða genotypes voru í henni - og það kemur inn í samræmi við einn fleiri athygli við mikroskrópstæðan stað með fjórum hundrað frumur.

records.context: Neither spaCRPower nor the port had this stage, and its absence is optimistic in a specific way: it makes the read fraction an *exact* measure of which genotypes were in a microplate sample position. In a real amplicon screening experiment it is not. A barcode arrives at the wrong gene through base-call substitutions, index hopping on a patterned flow cell, PCR chimeras across the pooled reaction, and mismatch-tolerant demultiplexing — and every one of those mechanisms moves reads *toward the middle*, because the destination is drawn from the whole library rather than from the microplate sample positions the source genotype was actually in.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.misassign_reads#1
records.source: Neither spaCRPower nor the port had this stage, and its absence is optimistic in a specific way: it makes the read fraction an *exact* measure of which genotypes were in a well. In a real amplicon screen it is not. A barcode arrives at the wrong gene through base-call substitutions, index hopping on a patterned flow cell, PCR chimeras across the pooled reaction, and mismatch-tolerant demultiplexing — and every one of those mechanisms moves reads *toward the middle*, because the destination is drawn from the whole library rather than from the wells the source genotype was actually in.
records.translation: Ekki spaCRPower né hamingurinn hafði þetta skref, og það er óþægilegt á ákveðnum hátt: það gerir lesufreiðan *nákvæm* mættur sem genotypes voru í brunni stöðu. Í raunverulegu amplicon skýringu tilraun það er ekki. Barcode kemur á mismunandi gen í gegnum bas-call skiptingu, index hopping á mönnun flutning frumu, PCR chimeras í gegnum samkeppt viðbrögð, og mismatch-tolerant demultiplexing - og hver af þeim kerfnum flytja lesur *til miðjunni*, vegna þess að markmiðin er tekin frá helstu bókasafninu en ekki frá mikróbstæðra stöðu stöðu sem kjarnan var í raunveruleika.

records.context: 1. Cells contributing DNA: ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``. This is normally far larger than the *imaged* count, because sequencing sees the whole well and the microscope sees a few microscope fields of view. 2. Amplification: one lognormal PCR factor per well, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. Note both parameters are on the **log** scale despite their names; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0 is a median amplification of ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. The factor is per well, not per gene, because a well is one PCR reaction — which is exactly why read counts within a well are not independent. 3. Sequencing: reads are drawn from the amplified barcode pool **without replacement** (multivariate hypergeometric), because a finite flow cell reading a finite library is sampling without replacement, and modelling it as multinomial overstates how much independent information deep microplate sample positions carry. 4. **Mis-assignment**, when ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: a fraction of the reads is credited to the wrong gene. Off by default, because it is not in the R and a silently different baseline would make every number already quoted from this module wrong. See :func:`misassign_reads` for what it models and why it always costs power.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_sequencing_plate#2

Note both parameters are on the **log** scale despite their names; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` of 2.0 is a median amplification of ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. The factor is per well, not per gene, because a well is one PCR reaction — which is exactly why read counts within a well are not independent. 3. Off by default, because it is not in the R and a silently different baseline would make every number already quoted from this module wrong. See :func:`misassign_reads` for what it models and why it always costs power.
records.translation: 1. Frumur aðstoða DNA: ``gene_in_well * Count(lambda, var)``. Þetta er venjulega miklu stærri en *mynduð* tákn, vegna þess að eftirliti sé allan brunnur og mikroskópinn sé nokkrar mikroscópum sviði. 2. Amplification: einn lognormal PCR tegund per well, ``pcr_factor ~ LogNormal(meanlog=pcr_factor_mu, sdlog=sqrt(pcr_factor_var))``. Athuga að báðir parámeter eru á **log** skammt þrátt fyrir nafni þeirra; a ``pcr_factor_mu`` af 2.0 er miðjandi viðbótar af ``exp(2) ~ 7.4``. Sækkun: lesur eru tekin frá stærðri barkódabúni **án skiptingu** (multivariate hypergeometric), vegna þess að lokið flutning fruma lesa lokið bókasafn er að prófa án skipta, og að mynda það eins og multinomial yfirstendur hversu mikið sjálfstætt upplýsingum djúp mikróplata prófa stöðu búa. 4. **Mis-signment**, þegar ``sequencing_error_rate > 0``: hluti af lesum er skilið á rangt gen. Af staðsetningu, vegna þess að það er ekki í R og hljóðlega mismunandi grunnlinni myndi gera hvert tölur sem hefur verið heitt frá þessu moduli rangt. Sjá :func:`misassign_reads` fyrir hvað það myndi og hvers vegna það kostar alltaf orku.

records.context: **Two departures from the R original, both deliberate.** Upstream computes ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inside a ``group_by(well)``, so ``nrow`` is the *library size*: with 452 genes and ``n_reads_total = 128318`` that is 284 reads per well, against a real screening experiment near 3e4. The parameter is documented as "total reads in the screening experiment" in one vignette and "geometric mean of well reads" in another. This function takes ``n_reads_per_well`` unambiguously and reports ``n_reads_total`` as the derived sum. Second, upstream's guard ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` is computed from ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` while the urn is ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; the two differ by rounding and the draw can ask for more balls than the urn holds. The guard here is computed from the urn itself.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_sequencing_plate#3
records.source: **Two departures from the R original, both deliberate.** Upstream computes ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inside a ``group_by(well)``, so ``nrow`` is the *library size*: with 452 genes and ``n_reads_total = 128318`` that is 284 reads per well, against a real screen near 3e4. The parameter is documented as "total reads in the screen" in one vignette and "geometric mean of well reads" in another. This function takes ``n_reads_per_well`` unambiguously and reports ``n_reads_total`` as the derived sum. Second, upstream's guard ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` is computed from ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` while the urn is ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; the two differ by rounding and the draw can ask for more balls than the urn holds. The guard here is computed from the urn itself.
records.translation: **Two fjarlægir frá R upprunalegu, báðir hugsanlega.** Upstream tækir ``n_reads_per_well = round(n_reads_total / nrow(well_data))`` inn í ``group_by(well)``, svo ``nrow`` er *librar stærð*: með 452 genum og ``n_reads_total = 128318`` sem er 284 lesin á brau, gegn raunverulegu skríning reynslu nálægt 3e4. Parameterin er skráður sem "total lesin í skríningu reynslu" í einu vinstri og "geometric miðjan góða lesin" í öðru. Þessi virkefni tekur ``n_reads_per_well`` óþekkt og segir ``n_reads_total`` sem afleiðing sum. Í öðru lagi, uppsýningar ``k = min(n_cells_in_well * pcr_factor, n_reads_per_well)`` er reiknað frá ``round(sum(cells) * pcr)`` þar sem urn er ``round(cells * pcr)`` element-wise; tveir eru mismunandi í kringum og skimunina getur beðið um meiri bolt en urn holds.
