records.source: The suffix contains every registered block absent from the application sheet, in registry order, rather than only ``names``.  This keeps blocks imported by a screen's dependencies together and means a later call can replace one complete suffix instead of stacking fragments with different preference values.  ``names`` remains the caller's documentation of the blocks it requires; omitting it is the MainWindow screen-host path.
records.translation: Suffixin inniheldur allar skráðir blokkir sem eru fjarlægðir úr notkunum, í rekstur, í stað þess að aðeins ``names``. Þetta hallar blokknir sem eru innrað af afhengingu á skjám saman og þýðir að síðar kalla getur skipt einn fullkominn suffix en ekki stack fragmentum með mismunandi viðhorfsvörum. ``names`` er samtökunarblokkanna sem það þarf; að missa það er MainWindow skjár-hosta leið.

records.context: The sheet in force is not `app.styleSheet()` any more. Per-window sheeting takes the application sheet DOWN on purpose and gives each window its own, so `app.styleSheet()` is empty in every production run -- and this function read that as "nobody opted in" and returned before doing anything. Measured: opening one module registers four blocks (`SettingsBox`, `ClassEditor`, `SettingAlphabetChip`, `TableChip`) and NONE of the four reached the screen that had just imported them. That is the exact defect this function was written for, reintroduced by the change that made the window the sheet's owner.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.ensure_widget_qss_applied#6
records.source: THE SHEET IN FORCE IS NOT `app.styleSheet()` ANY MORE. Per-window sheeting takes the application sheet DOWN on purpose and gives each window its own, so `app.styleSheet()` is empty in every production run -- and this function read that as "nobody opted in" and returned before doing anything. Measured: opening one module registers four blocks (`SettingsBox`, `ClassEditor`, `SettingAlphabetChip`, `TableChip`) and NONE of the four reached the screen that had just imported them. That is the exact defect this function was written for, reintroduced by the change that made the window the sheet's owner.
records.translation: Leikurinn í gildi er ekki `app.styleSheet()` neitt meira. Per-window leikurinn tekur leikinn DOWN á tilgangi og gefur hvert leikur eigin, þannig að `app.styleSheet()` er ótta í hverri framleiðslu keyrsla - og þetta virkefni lesið sem "nobody opted in" og aftur áður en það gerðist. Meiður: opna einn móddur rekstur fjórar blokkir (`SettingsBox`, `ClassEditor`,`SettingAlphabetChip` , `TableChip`) og enginn af fjórum ná skjár sem hafði bara innlaust þá. Það er nákvæmlega mistök þessi virkefnin var skrifað fyrir, endurtekinn af breytingum sem gerði leikunni eigandi leikunnar.

records.context: ``t`` is clamped to [0, 1]. ``field_fade_alpha(0.0)`` is 1.0 — a field is fully opaque where its value begins, no matter what the page-opacity preference is set to — and ``field_fade_alpha(1.0)`` is 0.0.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.field_fade_alpha#1
records.source: ``t`` is clamped to [0, 1]. ``field_fade_alpha(0.0)`` is 1.0 — a field is fully opaque where its value begins, no matter what the page-opacity preference is set to — and ``field_fade_alpha(1.0)`` is 0.0.

records.context: White in the dark themes, near-black in the light one, because that is what ``fg`` already is. Horizontal cards and interactive hover states still use it; resting Home module tiles deliberately do not. Deriving it from ``fg`` rather than writing ``#ffffff`` means every palette gets the right ink without a raw colour drifting out of sync.
records.label: spacr.qt.theme.rim_colour#1
records.source: White in the dark themes, near-black in the light one, because that is what ``fg`` already is. Horizontal cards and interactive hover states still use it; resting Home module tiles deliberately do not. Deriving it from ``fg`` rather than writing ``#ffffff`` means every palette gets the right ink without a raw colour drifting out of sync.
records.translation: Hvítt í myrkrum málum, næstum svart í ljósi einn, vegna þess að það er það sem ``fg`` er nú þegar. Horisontalskarta og samskiptandi hover staðir enn notast það; hvíldur heimilmódula reitir hugsanlega ekki. Afleiðing það frá ``fg`` en í stað þess að skrifa ``#ffffff`` þýðir að hver palett fær rétt ink án raust litur dreifandi út úr synk.

records.context: Makes the same test Qt makes: is the object's own independent execution path the calling independent execution path? Qt refuses whenever they differ, which happens both ways round -- a worker touching a GUI object, and the main GUI execution path touching a worker-affine object; the second is easier to write by accident because the code reads as ordinary main GUI execution path code.
records.label: spacr.qt.thread_guard.install._wrong_thread#1
records.source: Makes the same test Qt makes: is the object's own thread the calling thread? Qt refuses whenever they differ, which happens both ways round -- a worker touching a GUI object, and the GUI thread touching a worker-affine object; the second is easier to write by accident because the code reads as ordinary GUI-thread code.
records.translation: Að gera sömu prófið Qt gerir: er eigin sjálfstætt útgáfu leiðin til að kalla sjálfstæði útgáfa leiðin? Qt neita þegar þeir eru mismunandi, sem gerist báðum leiðum kringum - vinnsluferli sem ber við GUI objekt, og aðal GUI útgáfur leiðin sem ber á vinnsluferlum-afina objekt; aðra er auðveldara að skrifa á ótta vegna þess að kódinn les sem venjulega aðal útgáfskorð GUI.

records.context: Three constraints shape the implementation. Animation periods are sampled from continuous ranges rather than replayed from a precomputed loop, avoiding visible jumps and large frame caches. Shading runs outside the main GUI execution path; if a frame is late, the previous frame is repeated and counted by :attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`. The animation clock remains on the main GUI execution path, and rendered frames remain deterministic functions of ``(seed, clock, size)``.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient#56
records.source: Three constraints shape the implementation. Animation periods are sampled from continuous ranges rather than replayed from a precomputed loop, avoiding visible jumps and large frame caches. Shading runs outside the GUI thread; if a frame is late, the previous frame is repeated and counted by :attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`. The animation clock remains on the GUI thread, and rendered frames remain deterministic functions of ``(seed, clock, size)``.
records.translation: Þrír takmarkanir skipuleggja framkvæmdastjórnin. Animation tímabilir eru prófað frá stöðugum ránum en ekki endurspilað frá fyrirkomputatum hlifunum, koma í veg fyrir augljósandi sprengjum og stórum kerfi. Shading keyrir fyrir utan höfuðferð GUI framkvæmd; ef ramma er sífellt, endurtekist fyrri ramma og heyrist með :attr:`AmbientWidget.repeated_frames`. Animaður klukkustundin er á heiminum GUI útgáfu, og ferðað rammar eru enn deterministic virkefni ``(seed, clock, size)``.

records.context: ``u`` runs 0..1 from one end of the arc to the other. Each component is ``sin(2*pi*(u - v*t)/lambda)``: at a fixed time it is a shape in ``u``, and as ``t`` advances that shape *slides along u* at ``v`` while the arc itself goes nowhere. That is the whole difference between an aurora and a curtain being dragged sideways, and it is the one property of this engine worth testing directly.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.ambient.AuroraEngine.fold#1
records.source: ``u`` runs 0..1 from one end of the arc to the other. Each component is ``sin(2*pi*(u - v*t)/lambda)``: at a fixed time it is a shape in ``u``, and as ``t`` advances that shape *slides along u* at ``v`` while the arc itself goes nowhere. That is the whole difference between an aurora and a curtain being dragged sideways, and it is the one property of this engine worth testing directly.
records.translation: ``u`` keyrir 0..1 frá einum endum á hliðið til annarra. Hver hluti er ``sin(2*pi*(u - v*t)/lambda)``: á ákveðnum tíma það er form í ``u``, og eins og ``t`` framar að form *slides langs u* á ``v`` meðan hliðin sjálfur fara ekki. Það er allt mismunun milli aurora og hliðs sem eru þreytt við bragð, og það er eina eiginleika þessara vélin virði að prófa beint.

records.context: So the frames are not shown as generated. Each animation's real content bounds are measured once — the union, across every frame, of everything that is neither background nor well chrome — and the frames are then cropped and rescaled so the content covers a fixed :data:`TARGET_FILL` share of the square. records.context: **Read-only.** Opening the picker reads column names and nothing else. The connection is ``file:…?mode=ro`` plus ``PRAGMA query_only = ON`` — the same pair :mod:`spacr.qt.screens.db_browser` and :mod:`spacr.agreement` use — so SQLite itself refuses a write. The dialog never creates a column: it returns a *name*, and the write path that owns creation (``annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column``, which does it lazily with ``ALTER TABLE``) stays where it is.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.column_picker#7
records.source: **Read-only.** Opening the picker reads column names and nothing else. The connection is ``file:…?mode=ro`` plus ``PRAGMA query_only = ON`` — the same pair :mod:`spacr.qt.screens.db_browser` and :mod:`spacr.agreement` use — so SQLite itself refuses a write. The dialog never creates a column: it returns a *name*, and the write path that owns creation (``annotate_engine.ensure_annotation_column``, which does it lazily with ``ALTER TABLE``) stays where it is.
records.translation: **Leyð bara.** Opnar picker lesa ræðnafn og ekkert annað. Sambandinn er ``file:…?mode=ro`` plus ``PRAGMA query_only = ON`` - sama par :mod:`spacr.qt.screens.db_browser` og :mod:`spacr.agreement` nota — svo SQLite sjálfur neita skjá. records.context: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all assume that the positive and negative controls behave the same way on every plate. When the controls drift — the cell line changes, a reagent lot changes, incubation conditions change — every downstream result shifts with them, and the analysis does not detect it, because it normalises to the controls it is given.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart#1
records.source: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all assume that the positive and negative controls behave the same way on every plate. When the controls drift — the cell line changes, a reagent lot changes, incubation conditions change — every downstream result shifts with them, and the analysis does not detect it, because it normalises to the controls it is given.
records.translation: A skríningakampan er þúsund plötur í gegnum vikur. Hit hringja, plötu normering og Z' allt viðurkenna að jákvætt og neikvætt stjórnun virkar á sama hátt á hverjum plötum. Þegar stjórnunir flýja - líni fruman breytist, flötu viðbrögð breytast, incubation skilyrði breytist - hvert niðurstríð resultat skiptir með þeim, og athygli uppgötva það ekki, vegna þess að það normalizes til stjórnun sem það er gefið.

records.context: Sigma **of the plotted statistic** is ``sigma_within / sqrt(n)``, and that is what the zones and the rules are stated in. When subgroup sizes differ between plates the limits differ per plate; they are computed per point rather than averaged, and the result says so.

records.translation: Sigma **af plotted statistikum** er ``sigma_within / sqrt(n)``, og það er það sem svæðum og reglur eru sýnt í. Þegar subgroup stærðir eru mismunandi á plátum, eru takmarkanir mismunuð per plötur; þeir eru reiknað á punktum en ekki meðaltal, og niðurstöður segir það.

Charting it with the same limits and the same rules is the same question one level up: a Z' that slides from 0.7 to 0.3 over a campaign is a screen that stopped working, plate by plate, with no single plate looking wrong.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart.zprime_frame#1
records.source: ``Z' = 1 - 3(sd_pos + sd_neg) / |mean_pos - mean_neg|`` — the number a screener actually watches, and the one that says whether a plate could have detected anything at all. Charting it with the same limits and the same rules is the same question one level up: a Z' that slides from 0.7 to 0.3 over a campaign is a screen that stopped working, plate by plate, with no single plate looking wrong.
records.translation: ``Z' = 1 - 3(sd_pos + sd_neg) / |mean_pos - mean_neg|`` - fjöldi sem skreymandi virkilega horf, og sá sem segir hvort plötur gæti fundið eitthvað alls. Skrifla það með sömu takmörk og sama reglur er sama spurning einn stig upp: Z' sem slides frá 0.7 til 0.3 yfir kampan er skrin sem hættir að vinna, plátus á plátum, með engin pláturinn líta rangt.

records.context: The casing is load-bearing; the orientation is what makes it part of the rain. It used to be stored as a single token in a single cell and drawn horizontally, overflowing rightwards across its neighbours — which read as a label pasted over the effect rather than as part of it, and cost the renderer a whole second paint pass, measured token widths, widened dirty rectangles and a cleared backing rectangle so neighbouring glyphs did not tangle with the letters. None of that machinery exists now: every cell holds exactly one character, so the word is cached and blitted like any other glyph and cannot overdraw anything. See :data:`SPACR_SPLICE_PROBABILITY` for the rate and what it works out to in practice.

records.source: The casing is load-bearing; the orientation is what makes it part of the rain. It used to be stored as a single token in a single cell and drawn horizontally, overflowing rightwards across its neighbours — which read as a label pasted over the effect rather than as part of it, and cost the renderer a whole second paint pass, measured token widths, widened dirty rectangles and a cleared backing rectangle so neighbouring glyphs did not tangle with the letters. None of that machinery exists now: every cell holds exactly one character, so the word is cached and blitted like any other glyph and cannot overdraw anything. See :data:`SPACR_SPLICE_PROBABILITY` for the rate and what it works out to in practice.
records.translation: Það var notað til að vera lagður eins og einn token í einum frumu og þreytur horisontally, yfirflutandi hægri í gegnum nágrannalega - sem lesur eins og tákn spjót yfir áhrifum en ekki sem hluti af því, og kostar renderer allan annað litur pass, mætt token breiður, breiðu djúkrar rektangle og hreinsa bakgrunni svo nágrannar glyphs ekki tangað með skilyrðum. None þessar vél eru nú: hver frumu hefur nákvæmlega einn tegund, þannig að orð er skjótur og hugsað eins og önnur glyph og getur ekki yfirgefið neitt. :data:`SPACR_SPLICE_PROBABILITY` fyrir frekari og hvað það virkar í æfingu.

records.context: 1. *The timer stops whenever the widget is not on application view* — hidden, or in a minimised window. Zero frames, zero CPU. 2. *Each string is pre-rendered once into an opaque pixmap* with the background already composited in, and blitted at its current offset every frame. Drawing 5400 glyphs with ``drawText`` costs 35 ms a frame; the same glyphs as 120 opaque strips cost 0.46 ms — and an opaque strip is 25x cheaper to blit than a translucent one, which is why the alpha is baked in rather than applied by the painter. A strip is re-rendered only when its column respawns or the styling changes; the cache is ~7 MB at 1920x1080. :meth:`DnaRainWidget.set_backdrop` gives that up deliberately — a picture under the rain is not a constant to bake against — so the translucent path is taken only by the themes that have a wallpaper to show, and dark and light keep the numbers above. 3. *Only the columns that moved are repainted.* Positions are quantised to whole cells, so a column is dirty only when its integer row changes — slow columns cost nothing on most ticks. See :data:`MAX_DIRTY_RECTS` for where partial repaints stop paying.

records.context: A residual bootstrap was the other candidate and was rejected. It shares the profile's homoscedastic-normal assumption so it buys no robustness; it needs a seed and gives a slightly different published number per seed; and — the deciding objection — percentiles of a bootstrap distribution are *always* finite, so it reports a confident-looking interval for an unidentified parameter in precisely the situation that matters. records.context: Pooling is two-stage. Each plate is fitted on its own -- by the same :func:`fit_dose_response` that fits everything else, with the same refusals -- and the per-plate log10 EC50s are then combined with a random-effects weight. One joint nonlinear mixed model would be the other way to do it; it would also mean a second fitting path with a second set of failure modes, and a plate that :func:`fit_dose_response` refuses would have to be refused again, differently, inside it. This way a refusal on one plate is the same refusal :func:`fit_dose_response` reports.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.PooledFit#2
records.source: Pooling is two-stage. Each plate is fitted on its own -- by the same :func:`fit_dose_response` that fits everything else, with the same refusals -- and the per-plate log10 EC50s are then combined with a random-effects weight. One joint nonlinear mixed model would be the other way to do it; it would also mean a second fitting path with a second set of failure modes, and a plate that :func:`fit_dose_response` refuses would have to be refused again, differently, inside it. This way a refusal on one plate is the same refusal :func:`fit_dose_response` reports.
records.translation: Sjálf er tvöfaldur. Hver plötur er búin á sjálfan sig - með sömu :func:`fit_dose_response` sem passa allt annað, með sama neyðjum - og per-plötur log10 EC50s eru þá sameiginlegur með tilfinnilegum áhrifum þyngd. Eitt sameiginlegt ekki lífræna blanda myndi vera annar leið til að gera það; Það myndi einnig þýða að annað hönnun með þriðja setur mismunandi aðgerðir, og plötur sem :func:`fit_dose_response` neita myndi verða neitað aftur, öðruvísi, inn í það. Þannig er neita á einum plötu sama neita :func:`fit_dose_response` rapporter.

records.context: The pooling uses random rather than fixed effects. Fixed-effect pooling assumes every plate measures the same value and differs only by noise. Three tight plates that disagree then give a narrow interval around a value none of them support. The DerSimonian-Laird estimate of the between-plate variance is added to each plate's own, so real variation between plates widens the answer instead of being weighted away.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.PooledFit#3
records.source: The pooling uses random rather than fixed effects. Fixed-effect pooling assumes every plate measures the same value and differs only by noise. Three tight plates that disagree then give a narrow interval around a value none of them support. The DerSimonian-Laird estimate of the between-plate variance is added to each plate's own, so real variation between plates widens the answer instead of being weighted away.
records.translation: Sameiningin notar slæmt en ekki stöðugt áhrif. Fast-effekt samanburði tekur hvert plötur saman verð og er aðeins mismunandi eftir hljóð. Þrír hægur plötur sem mismunandi þá gefur smá hliðar um gildi enginn af þeim stuðning. DerSimonian-Laird uppskattun á milli platta breytingu er lagt til hverri platta eigin, þannig að raunverulegur breyting milli plata breytir svarið í stað þess að vera þyngd.

records.context: Here the machine-learning classification model's continuous/categorical split *is* the right cut: a response is a measured quantity, and a column with four levels is a label or a count rather than something a sigmoid passes through.

records.context: when a column is missing, when either agent has no single-agent microplate sample positions -- without them there is no curve to predict the combination from, and a surface computed against the combination microplate sample positions themselves would be comparing the data to itself -- or when no well has both agents present, which is a pair of dose series and not a checkerboard.

records.context: A refusal in one group is kept beside that group and does not stop the others: a plate where one compound is cytotoxic at the top dose should still report the other twenty-three, with the cytotoxic one visibly labelled rather than missing.

records.context: Percent inhibition against each plate's own controls.

records.translation: Procent inhibition gegn eigin stjórnunum hverra plötu.

records.context: A laboratory microplate without an assay window is refused rather than scaled by noise. When a laboratory microplate's two controls do not separate there is no assay window, and dividing by that near-zero difference would turn well-to-well noise into hundreds of percent inhibition and a confident EC50 on a laboratory microplate that measured nothing. Such a laboratory microplate's rows come back with a NaN response and a :class:`PlateReport` saying so.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.normalise_to_controls#4
records.source: A plate without an assay window is refused rather than scaled by noise. When a plate's two controls do not separate there is no assay window, and dividing by that near-zero difference would turn well-to-well noise into hundreds of percent inhibition and a confident EC50 on a plate that measured nothing. Such a plate's rows come back with a NaN response and a :class:`PlateReport` saying so.
records.translation: Mikróplata sem er óþægilegt er neitað en skalað af hræðingu. Þegar tvö stjórnunir af mikrópum í plötu skilja ekki það er engin próf, og að deila með því nær-zero mun breyta brunnur til brunns hljóð í hundruð procentum hæmingu og óþekkt EC50 á mikróbum sem mætti ekkert. Slík mikróplata á rannsókninum kemur aftur með NaN svör og :class:`PlateReport` segja það.

records.context: one row per microplate sample position, with the laboratory microplate, control and response columns the spec and this call name.

records.translation: eitt stefnu per brunna, með mikróbstæli, stjórn og viðbrögð hjólum er spek og þetta samtal nafn.

records.context: ``(frame, reports)`` -- a copy of the frame carrying ``out``, and one :class:`PlateReport` per laboratory microplate in the order the laboratory microplates first appear. records.source: ``(frame, reports)`` -- a copy of the frame carrying ``out``, and one :class:`PlateReport` per plate in the order the plates first appear. Rows on a refused plate carry NaN, so a caller that fits the whole table drops those plates without having to filter first.
records.translation: ``(frame, reports)`` - kopi ramma með ``out``, og einn :class:`PlateReport` á mikrópleti í því orði sem mikróbleti í plötu birtast fyrst. Rökur á nefndum mikróbréfi búa NaN, þannig að kallaður sem passa allan borð droppar þessar mikrófleti án þess að þurfa að fljótta fyrst.

records.context: For the screen that wants to show the plate table before the user has chosen a readout to fit, and for a caller that only wants to know which plates would be dropped. A table where every plate is refused returns its refusals rather than throwing -- here the refusals are the result.

records.context: The two fits come from one plate. spaCR segments host cell and pathogen as separate object types from the same image, so host viability and parasite burden are measured at the same doses in the same run, whereas most selectivity indices divide two numbers from two experiments whose conditions may differ.

records.context: The drawer starts fully off-application view rather than hidden: a hidden widget reports no geometry, and the tutorial overlay needs a rectangle to point at. Whether it is open is tracked as its own flag rather than derived from position -- the slide takes 170 ms, and for those 170 ms a position-derived answer would call an opening drawer closed, which is how a caller ends up racing the animation.

records.context: The groups have the same row-order problem as a sorted plot. These arrays are slices of the table taken by condition, so a dot's position within its own group is not its row -- and the negative controls are drawn before the screen, so it is not its position on the plot either. Rows are therefore laid out in one flat sequence up front and carried into each scatter, rather than being inferred from the drawing order.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.ControlSeparation.set_groups#3
records.source: The groups have the same row-order problem as a sorted plot. These arrays are slices of the table taken by condition, so a dot's position within its own group is not its row -- and the negative controls are drawn before the screen, so it is not its position on the plot either. Rows are therefore laid out in one flat sequence up front and carried into each scatter, rather than being inferred from the drawing order.
records.translation: Þessar hópur hafa sömu vandamálið sem skipulegt rita. Þessir rita eru slík af borðinu tekið eftir aðstæður, Þannig er staðsetningu tóms í eigin hópum ekki rán hennar -- og neikvæðar stjórnun eru tekin fyrir skimun, svo það er ekki stöðu sína á plötinu heldur. Rökur eru því sett upp í einum fátæku fram og flutt inn í hvert skotari, En í stað þess að koma fram úr skimun.

records.context: σ is a MAD, not a standard deviation: a standard deviation is inflated by exactly the outliers a screen exists to find, so a cut measured from one is pulled outwards by the hits and then fails to call them. The median absolute deviation is not, and ×1.4826 makes it the consistent estimator for a normal -- the same statistic :func:`spacr.figures.panels.control_threshold` measures the effect-size cut from, so the dashed lines here and the lines on the volcano put three sigmas at the same value.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.EffectDistribution#2
records.source: σ is a MAD, not a standard deviation: a standard deviation is inflated by exactly the outliers a screen exists to find, so a cut measured from one is pulled outwards by the hits and then fails to call them. The median absolute deviation is not, and ×1.4826 makes it the consistent estimator for a normal -- the same statistic :func:`spacr.figures.panels.control_threshold` measures the effect-size cut from, so the dashed lines here and the lines on the volcano put three sigmas at the same value.
records.translation: σ er MAD, ekki standa skilyrði: standardi skilyrð er inflated með nákvæmlega útlendingar á skjá er til að finna, þannig að skjár frá einum er treyst út af hitunum og þá er ekki hægt að kalla þá. median absoluut skilyrðin er ekki, og ×1.4826 gerir það samræmi skilyrða fyrir venjuleg - sama stefnumót :func:`spacr.figures.panels.control_threshold` mætur áhrif-sýri skilyrðum frá, svo skreyttar línu hér og línu á vulkanum setja þrjú sigma á sama gildi.

records.context: The reason is the tested family, not the axis: on the TSG101 screen σ (MAD) is 0.229228 over the tested family and 0.229036 with the intercept added, a difference of 0.08%. Dropping it does not visibly move this picture; it restricts the picture to the 1,212 coefficients the q-values describe, which is the same family :func:`spacr.figures.panels.effect_distribution` draws and the same one the effect-size cut is measured from.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fast_plots.EffectDistribution.set_effects#5
records.source: The reason is the tested family, not the axis: on the TSG101 screen σ (MAD) is 0.229228 over the tested family and 0.229036 with the intercept added, a difference of 0.08%. Dropping it does not visibly move this picture; it restricts the picture to the 1,212 coefficients the q-values describe, which is the same family :func:`spacr.figures.panels.effect_distribution` draws and the same one the effect-size cut is measured from.
records.translation: Þess vegna er prófað fjölskyldu, ekki axis: á TSG101 skjár σ (MAD) er 0.229228 yfir prófaða fjölskyldu og 0.229036 með viðbótum viðbrögð, munur 0.08%. Dropa það flytja ekki augljóslega þessa mynd; það takmarka myndina við 1,212 samkefni sem q-verur lýsa, sem er sömu fjölskyldu :func:`spacr.figures.panels.effect_distribution` skreyti og sömu sem áhrif-sæmi skjár er meiddur frá.

records.context: A radar is drawn as a polygon, not on a polar axis. pyqtgraph has no polar view, and matplotlib's ``subplot_kw=dict(polar=True)`` was the only reason two of this module's figures could not move to the screen's renderer. The chart is then simple: each label takes an angle, each value a radius, and the whole thing is a line through the resulting points with the axes hidden.

records.context: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` enables a family-wise permutation calibration. Class labels are permuted, the complete ranking is recomputed and the maximum score from each permutation is retained. The 95th percentile of these maxima is returned as :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Calibration uses a seeded subsample of at most :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` rows and is disabled by default because computation scales with the number of permutations.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_rank#7
records.source: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` enables a family-wise permutation calibration. Class labels are permuted, the complete ranking is recomputed and the maximum score from each permutation is retained. The 95th percentile of these maxima is returned as :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Calibration uses a seeded subsample of at most :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` rows and is disabled by default because computation scales with the number of permutations.
records.translation: :attr:`ExplorerSpec.n_permutations` gerir fjölskyldu-vissur permutation kalibration. Klasa merki eru permutated, fullu rangning er recomputed og hárstaða skólan frá hverjum permutations er haldið. 95th procentsile af þessum maxima er tilbúinn sem :attr:`ExplorerResult.null_threshold`. Kalibration notar sæddur subsample á meirihluti :data:`NULL_MAX_ROWS` ránum og er óþekkt vegna þess að tölun skala með fjölda permutationer.

records.context: The registry is read as well, for a fold that still holds its row. Those modules keep their name, description and maturity in the registry, so their hosts record nothing (Regression notes this beside `investigate_hit` and `profiler`). Without the registry these modules would be missing from the answer and the dock would show their rows as the raw structured-data name. Reading the registry avoids a second copy of the same text in each host.

records.source: The registry is read as well, for a fold that still holds its row. Those modules keep their name, description and maturity in the registry, so their hosts record nothing (Regression notes this beside `investigate_hit` and `profiler`). Without the registry these modules would be missing from the answer and the dock would show their rows as the raw key. Reading the registry avoids a second copy of the same text in each host.
records.translation: Registrið er lesið líka, fyrir fólkið sem heldur enn eftir sér. Þessir mólur halda nafni, lýsingu og fullorðinu í skrá, svo að viðhalda þeirra rekst ekkert (Regression nota þetta við `investigate_hit` og `profiler`). Án rekstur myndi þessar einkunnir vera saknar frá svörunni og dók myndi sýna ránum sínum sem raust byggð gögn nafn. Að lesa rekstrinn forðast annað kopi sömu texta í hverjum hýsli.

records.translation: ``format_run_summary`` notar staðbundna breiði merki kolumn fyrir terminal og skrif útgang. Þessi parser endurheimtir þessar ránum þannig að Qt sýn getur flýjað verðkolumnina aftur til viðkomandi breiðis.

records.context: Nowhere, by itself. The panel emits :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` and the host re-hands the computed frame to whatever it is driving — the trellis, the data-selection boundary editor, the feature explorer, the Local Data Filter. No other integration is needed: a computed column is an ordinary column from the moment it exists, classified by the same :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` rule as a measured one, so it appears in the column well, in the filter picker and in the export without any of them being told about formulas.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.formula_editor#7
records.source: Nowhere, by itself. The panel emits :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` and the host re-hands the computed frame to whatever it is driving — the trellis, the gate editor, the feature explorer, the Local Data Filter. No other integration is needed: a computed column is an ordinary column from the moment it exists, classified by the same :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` rule as a measured one, so it appears in the column well, in the filter picker and in the export without any of them being told about formulas.
records.translation: Engar staðar, af sjálfum sér. Panelinn útgáfa :attr:`FormulaPanel.formulas_changed` og hýsilinn endurhaldur reiknað ramma til hvaða það er að hlaupa - trellis, gögn-sýsling grænsku útgáfur, eiginleika rannsóknari, staðbundna gögn Filter. Engar önnur tengsl er nauðsynlegt: reiknað kolumn er venjulega kolumn frá þeim tíma sem það er, rangt af sömu :func:`~spacr.qt.widgets.data_filter_panel.classify_columns` reglu sem mætt einn, þannig að það birtast í kolumni brunnur, í filter picker og í útgáfu án þess að einhver þeirra er sagt um formúlar.

records.context: The pointer arguments are not optional in practice. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fractal_cascade.CascadeEngine.render#1
records.source: THE POINTER ARGUMENTS ARE NOT OPTIONAL IN PRACTICE. The worker passes all ten positionally to whichever engine the pattern chose, and this signature stopped at six -- so every frame raised TypeError, the failure signal fired, no image ever arrived, and the widget painted its fallback colour. That is why the CPU cascade was black while the GPU one was fine and the CPU orbit followed the mouse.
records.translation: Ákvarðanir sem sýnir eru ekki valfrjáls í verkum. vinnsluferli fer yfir alla tíu staðsetningu til hvaða tegund sem mönnun valdi, og þessi undirskrift stóð á sex - þannig að hver ramma hóf TypeError, skjóta signaði flutt, engin mynd kom aldrei, og widgetin litur niðurfarinn. Það er ástæða þess að CPU cascade var svart meðan GPU einn var gott og CPU orbítur fylgdi munninn.

records.context: Wrapped with a modulo rather than reset to zero on a comparison, so a frame that arrives late -- the machine was asleep, or a run took the CPU -- lands where it should instead of skipping a whole descent.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fractal_mandelbrot.depth_after_restart#5
records.source: Wrapped with a modulo rather than reset to zero on a comparison, so a frame that arrives late -- the machine was asleep, or a run took the CPU -- lands where it should instead of skipping a whole descent.
records.translation: Í stað þess að endursetja til null á samræmi, þá landur ramma sem kemur sent - vélin var svefnun, eða keyrsla tók CPU - þar sem það ætti að skippa í stað að eyða allan niður.

records.context: Vectorised over the whole grid rather than looped per pixel: this runs while the backdrop is drawing, and a Python loop over 5,184 points times 900 iterations is a second of held GIL.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.fractal_mandelbrot.perturbation_escape_map#7
records.source: Vectorised over the whole grid rather than looped per pixel: this runs while the backdrop is drawing, and a Python loop over 5,184 points times 900 iterations is a second of held GIL.
records.translation: Vekturð yfir allan netinu en í stað þess að keyra á pikseli: þetta fer meðan bakgrunni er að drekka, og Python keyra yfir 5,184 punktur 900 iterations er sekúnd GIL.

records.context: Floored at one CPU. `os.cpu_count` returns None on some platforms, and a worker pool sized from None is a crash rather than a slow backdrop.

records.translation: Flóður á CPU. `os.cpu_count` fær None aftur á sumum plötum, og vinnsluferli baun stærð frá None er fljótur í stað þess að lágt bakgrunn.

records.translation: Hversu margir Numba vinnsluferli að taka, yfirgefa notkun sumir.

records.context: Cutoffs affect only the displayed range; they do not filter rows or change data-selection boundary membership. Limits are keyed by measurement rather than by the current X/Y assignment, so they follow a measurement when axes are exchanged.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_canvas#2
records.source: Cutoffs affect only the displayed range; they do not filter rows or change gate membership. Limits are keyed by measurement rather than by the current X/Y assignment, so they follow a measurement when axes are exchanged.
records.translation: Cutoffs hafa aðeins áhrif á sýnt sviði; þeir fljóta ekki ránum eða breyta gate landamæri. Grænir eru keypt með mæli en ekki með núverandi X / Y uppsetningu, þannig að þeir fylgja mæli þegar axes eru skipt.

records.context: The strip BELOW the rectangle is the x axis and the strip to its LEFT is the y axis -- that is where the ticks and the axis label are drawn, so it is where a user aiming at "the axis" clicks. In the corner where the two strips overlap the further overshoot wins: well to the left and barely below is the y axis, and the other way round is the x axis.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_canvas.axis_at#4
records.source: The strip BELOW the rectangle is the x axis and the strip to its LEFT is the y axis -- that is where the ticks and the axis label are drawn, so it is where a user aiming at "the axis" clicks. In the corner where the two strips overlap the further overshoot wins: well to the left and barely below is the y axis, and the other way round is the x axis.
records.translation: Í hliðinu á hægri hliðið er x axis og hliðina til leyfri er y axis. -- Það er þar sem tykkurnar og axis etikett eru tekin, svo það er þar sem notandi sem heyrir á "the axis" klikk. Í hjónunni þar sem tveir rita yfirlappur áfram overshoot vinnur: brunnur á hægri og næstum niður er y axis, Og annarra leiðin í kringum er x axis.

records.context: ``Console`` Runs an expression against the CURRENT frame and prints the answer. Not a Python shell -- a Python shell in a GUI is a way to hang the GUI, and the questions that come up while data-selection filtering are all of one shape: "how many objects satisfy this", "what is the median of that". So it evaluates pandas expressions with the frame in scope and nothing else.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_console#2
records.source: ``Console`` Runs an expression against the CURRENT frame and prints the answer. Not a Python shell -- a Python shell in a GUI is a way to hang the GUI, and the questions that come up while gating are all of one shape: "how many objects satisfy this", "what is the median of that". So it evaluates pandas expressions with the frame in scope and nothing else.
records.translation: ``Console`` Gerur útskýringu gegn RÍKUNNA kerfi og trúa svarið. Ekki Python skál - Python skály í GUI er leið til að hleyma GUI, og spurningar sem koma upp á meðan gate er allt í einu form: "hversu mörg hlutur þykir við þetta", "hvað er miðjan þess". Svo það mælar pandas útskýringar með kerfi í sviði og ekkert annað.

records.context: :class:`GateCanvas` subclasses :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` for the same reason :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_view.TrellisCanvas` does: the marks, the hue order, the density raster and the large-data policy are one implementation. What it adds is a *mode*. With no tool armed the drag is the inherited brush; with a tool armed the drag draws a shape and nothing is published until the data-selection boundary is named.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_editor#2
records.source: :class:`GateCanvas` subclasses :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` for the same reason :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_view.TrellisCanvas` does: the marks, the hue order, the density raster and the large-data policy are one implementation. What it adds is a *mode*. With no tool armed the drag is the inherited brush; with a tool armed the drag draws a shape and nothing is published until the gate is named.
records.translation: :class:`GateCanvas` subclasses :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.graph_builder.GraphCanvas` fyrir sömu ástæðu :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.trellis_view.TrellisCanvas` gerir: merki, hue orðin, þunglyndi raster og big data stjórn eru eitt framkvæmd. Það sem það bætir er *mode*. Með engin tól beint drag er erfitt brush; með tólbeint drag trekkar form og ekkert er útgáfu þar til gate hringinn er nafn.

records.context: **Polygon** — click a vertex at a time, then close it. Three vertices minimum, enforced where the data-selection boundary is built rather than where it is applied.

records.context: A data-selection boundary is drawn **inside** whatever is selected in the tree, and the canvas shows that parent's population rather than the whole table — because a data-selection boundary drawn on a picture of everything and then applied to a subset is a data-selection boundary nobody placed. The header says which population is on application view and how many objects that is.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_editor#8
records.source: A gate is drawn **inside** whatever is selected in the tree, and the canvas shows that parent's population rather than the whole table — because a gate drawn on a picture of everything and then applied to a subset is a gate nobody placed. records.translation: A gate er þreytur **inside** hvað sem er valið í tréinu, og kanvas sýnir að íbúð foreldra en ekki allan tákn - vegna þess að Gate þreyttur á mynd af öllu og síðan notuð á subset er gate enginn settur. header segir hvaða íbúð er á app sýningu og hversu mörg hlutur það er.

records.context: Adds interactive data-selection boundary drawing, dragging and hit-testing to the shared canvas, and pins the axes while a data-selection boundary exists -- see :data:`RESCALE_ON_FILTER` for why that is not optional here.

records.context: Deliberately does NOT consult `population()`. Hit-testing a data-selection boundary is pure geometry -- is this coordinate inside this shape -- and needs no rows at all. Asking for the population first meant that whenever it was unavailable, dragging died silently: `population()` returns None when the active data-selection boundary no longer exists, which is exactly the state left behind by DELETING a data-selection boundary. The remaining data-selection boundary then looked "fixed and I cannot move".
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_editor.GateCanvas.gate_at#2
records.source: Deliberately does NOT consult `population()`. Hit-testing a gate is pure geometry -- is this coordinate inside this shape -- and needs no rows at all. Asking for the population first meant that whenever it was unavailable, dragging died silently: `population()` returns None when the active gate no longer exists, which is exactly the state left behind by DELETING a gate. The remaining gate then looked "fixed and I cannot move".
records.translation: Það er óþekkt að ræða `population()`. Hit-testið gate er hrein geometría - er þetta samræmi inni í þessari form - og þarf engin stefnu alls. Að spyrja um fjölmiðla þýðir fyrst að hvert skipti sem það var óþægilegt, dragging deyja þögulega: `population()` endurheimtir None þegar aktiver gate hringurinn er ekki lengur til, sem er nákvæmlega aðstæður eftir með DELETING gögnin-sálun hringinn. Aðrar gate hringdi þá virðist "hætt og ég get ekki flytja sig".

records.context: In 3D the volume replaces all of it: the data-selection boundary tools are 2D gestures on a flat axes, and running them against a rotated projection would produce data-selection boundaries whose coordinates mean nothing.

records.context: ``(None, None)`` means full depth, which is what an undragged shape means and what the 2D data-selection boundary on that image layer already meant.

records.context: The first implementation chose the two axes that happened to face the camera.  That made the X/Y/Z plane buttons cosmetic: turning the view could make a data-selection boundary land on a different plane from the blue aura.  The selected plane is now the source of truth.  A genuinely edge-on plane is refused because its two data dimensions collapse to one screen line and no inverse exists.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_editor.GateCanvas.volume_axis_map#3
records.source: The first implementation chose the two axes that happened to face the camera. A genuinely edge-on plane is refused because its two data dimensions collapse to one screen line and no inverse exists.
records.translation: Fyrsta framkvæmd valdi tvö axes sem gerðist til að mæta myndavélina. Það gerði X / Y / Z flugvélin hnappur kosmetísk: snúa útlit gæti gert gate land á mismunandi flugvéli frá blau aura. Valinn flugvélar er nú orsaki sannleika. A alvöru edge-on flugvéla er neitaður vegna þess að tveir gögn fjölmiðlar hennar kollapsa á einu skjár líni og engin viðbrot er til.

records.source: :meth:`publish` is the point of the screen — it turns the selected gate into a :class:`~spacr.selection.DataFilter` clause and pushes it onto the shared filter, so every open view narrows to the gated population.

records.translation: Leitaðu að þungum fjölmiðlum og bæta upp einn gate á klúster.

records.source: Delete the selected gate, and everything drawn inside it.
records.translation: Hættu úr ákveðnum gate, og allt þreytist inn í það.

records.source: Show a gate hierarchy, counted against a table.
records.translation: sýna gate takmarkaði, sem er ritað gegn tólum.

records.context: Both arguments together. The counts and percentages are a property of the data-selection boundaries AND the rows they were applied to, so a tree given new data-selection boundaries against the old frame would show numbers belonging to neither.

records.source: BOTH ARGUMENTS TOGETHER. The counts and percentages are a property of the gates AND the rows they were applied to, so a tree given new gates against the old frame would show numbers belonging to neither.
records.translation: Tölur og hlutfall eru eiginleika gate og ránir sem þeir voru notuð á, þannig að tré gefið nýjum gögnum-gate ránum gegn gamla kerfi myndi sýna tölur sem tilheyra ekki.

records.context: Controls read and write :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.gate_settings.GateEditorSettings`, keeping the inline panel and modal settings dialog synchronized. records.translation: Aðgangar lesa og skrifa :class:`~spacr.qt.widgets.gate_settings.GateEditorSettings`, halda innlinda panla og móta settingar samskipti synkróni. Panelinn inniheldur DBSCAN parametrar og gangar stjórnun sem notuð er í gate leit. Projection hyperparameters búa í xd taban settings samskipta, þar sem þeir eru settar einu sinni á tólum þangað við kolumn pics.

records.translation: Taktu settingar á skjánum og sýndu þá.

records.context: Frozen: settings are replaced wholesale rather than mutated, so a screen can compare what it has against what it is given and re-read the table only when something that actually costs a read has changed.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_settings.GateEditorSettings#1

records.translation: Frozen: settings eru staðsettir miklu í stað þess að mutast, þannig að skjár getur sameinað það sem það hefur gegn því sem það er gefið og lesa aftur borðinn aðeins þegar eitthvað sem virkilega kostar lest hefur breyst.

records.context: This is how the people who use spaCR already think about their data, because it is how flow cytometry has worked for forty years: draw a threshold on a histogram, draw a polygon round the cloud on a two-parameter scatter, name it, and everything downstream is about the cells inside it. What makes it a data-selection boundary rather than a lasso is that it is a **predicate**, not a list of objects:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec#1
records.source: This is how the people who use spaCR already think about their data, because it is how flow cytometry has worked for forty years: draw a threshold on a histogram, draw a polygon round the cloud on a two-parameter scatter, name it, and everything downstream is about the cells inside it. What makes it a gate rather than a lasso is that it is a **predicate**, not a list of objects:
records.translation: Þetta er hvernig fólk sem notar spaCR hefur þegar hugsað um gögnum sínum, vegna þess að það er hvernig flutning cytometry hefur virkað í fjörutíu ár: tegund græn á histogramm, tegund polygon um skugga á tvö parametrar skál, nafn það, og allt niðurstríð er um frumur inn í það. Það sem gerir það gate hringinn en ekki lasso er það er **spredicate**, ekki lista af hlutum:

records.context: it can be **re-applied to another dataset** — the next plate, the re-run, the replicate — and still mean the same thing;
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec#2
records.source: it can be **re-applied to another dataset** — the next plate, the re-run, the replicate — and still mean the same thing;
records.translation: það getur verið **re-applyð á annan dataset** - næsta plötur, endurnýjandi, replicate - og enn þýðir það sama;

records.context: :class:`GateClause` is duck-typed onto ``DataFilter`` the way :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` and :class:`~spacr.selection.CategoryFilter` are — a ``column`` attribute, a ``mask(frame)`` and a ``describe()``. Its ``column`` is ``"gate:<name>"``, which makes ``DataFilter.add``'s replace-by-column rule do the right thing: a re-drawn data-selection boundary of the same name **replaces** its older self instead of stacking two versions of the same shape.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec#7
records.source: :class:`GateClause` is duck-typed onto ``DataFilter`` the way :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` and :class:`~spacr.selection.CategoryFilter` are — a ``column`` attribute, a ``mask(frame)`` and a ``describe()``. Its ``column`` is ``"gate:<name>"``, which makes ``DataFilter.add``'s replace-by-column rule do the right thing: a re-drawn gate of the same name **replaces** its older self instead of stacking two versions of the same shape.
records.translation: :class:`GateClause` er duck-typed á ``DataFilter`` leiðin :class:`~spacr.selection.RangeFilter` og :class:`~spacr.selection.CategoryFilter` eru — ``column`` atribút, ``mask(frame)`` og en ``describe()``. Their ``column`` er ``"gate:<name>"``, sem gerir ``DataFilter.add`` staðsetningu-a-kolumna reglu gera rétt: endurþreytur gate hringinn af sömu nafni **skiptir** eldri sjálfan sig í stað þess að stýra tvö útgáfur af sama form.

records.context: A whole chain becomes ONE clause rather than one per data-selection boundary, and that is load-bearing rather than tidy: ``singlets`` might be ``area >= 100`` and its child ``big`` might be ``area <= 500``, and as two range clauses on ``area`` the second would replace the first and silently widen the population.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec#8
records.source: A whole chain becomes ONE clause rather than one per gate, and that is load-bearing rather than tidy: ``singlets`` might be ``area >= 100`` and its child ``big`` might be ``area <= 500``, and as two range clauses on ``area`` the second would replace the first and silently widen the population.
records.translation: Allir kettir verða ONE skilyrði í stað þess að einn á gate hringjandi, og það er last-bearing en ekki tíu: ``singlets`` gæti verið ``area >= 100`` og barnið hans ``big`` gætu verið ``area <= 500``, og eins og tveir skilyrðir á ``area`` annað myndi skipta fyrstu og þögulega breyta fjölmiðla.

records.context: A box whose z range is unbounded is a RECTANGLE extended through the volume, which is what a 2D data-selection boundary already is when seen in 3D -- so the two agree rather than being different answers to the same question.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.BoxGate#2
records.source: A box whose z range is unbounded is a RECTANGLE extended through the volume, which is what a 2D gate already is when seen in 3D -- so the two agree rather than being different answers to the same question.
records.translation: Hluti sem z ranga er óhneigður er RECTANGLE breiður í gegnum volymin, sem er það sem 2D gate ranga þegar séð í 3D - þannig að tvö eru sammála í stað þess að vera mismunandi svör á sömu spurningu.

records.context: Unlike the 2-D data-selection boundaries this does not require a bound to be set: a box with open faces is a legitimate slab through the cube.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.BoxGate.__post_init__#1
records.source: Unlike the 2-D gates this does not require a bound to be set: a box with open faces is a legitimate slab through the cube.
records.translation: Annars við 2D gate takmarkaður þetta krefst ekki takmarkan til að vera sett: Bók með opnum andlitum er lögmæt slík í gegnum kuban.

records.context: How a data-selection boundary is made in the volume: frame a population by spinning and zooming, then keep what you framed. The view is already the gesture -- asking the user to also drag a shape on a rotated projection would be asking them to aim at something that is not flat.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.BoxGate.from_limits#1
records.source: How a gate is made in the volume: frame a population by spinning and zooming, then keep what you framed. The view is already the gesture -- asking the user to also drag a shape on a rotated projection would be asking them to aim at something that is not flat.
records.translation: Hvernig á að gera gate er gert í volymum: ramma fjölmiðla með spinning og zooming, þá halda það sem þú rammar. sýn er nú þegar gestur - að biðja notandinn að draga einnig form á rotated sýningu væri að biða þá til að sækja um eitthvað sem er ekki fljótt.

records.context: This data-selection boundary as plain data, including every coordinate needed to rebuild the shape.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.BoxGate.to_dict#0
records.source: This gate as plain data, including every coordinate needed to rebuild the shape.
records.translation: Þessi gate takmarkaður eins og ljóst gögn, þar á meðal hvert samskipti sem er nauðsynlegt til að endurbyggja forminn.

records.context: Clustering cannot run, or produced nothing worth data-selection filtering.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.ClusterError#0
records.source: Clustering cannot run, or produced nothing worth gating.
records.translation: Clustering er ekki hægt að keyra, eða framleiða ekkert verðmætur gögn-sælslu filtingu.

records.context: Other data-selection boundaries, combined. The point 5.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate#0
records.source: Other gates, combined. The point 5.
records.translation: Aðrir gate, sameiginlegur. punkt 5.

records.context: "if the user draws another data-selection boundary on the same 3d graph they should be able to set the new data-selection boundary as being its own data-selection boundary, subtracting or add[ing] from/to the other data-selection boundaries in view"
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate#1
records.source: "if the user draws another gate on the same 3d graph they should be able to set the new gate as being its own gate, subtracting or add[ing] from/to the other gates in view"
records.translation: „eða notandi tekur annað gate gate á sama 3d gráfi þá ætti þeir að vera fær um að setja nýjan gögnun-gate gate sem er eigin gögnin-sálun gate, subtracting eða[in] frá / til aðra gögnum-sellingu grænse í sýn“

records.context: Operands are names, not copies, and that is the whole design decision. Holding copies would make ``mask`` self-contained, which is tidier -- and would mean that adjusting one of the data-selection boundaries being combined left the composite showing the old shape, silently, for as long as nobody looked. One source of truth costs a resolver; two sources cost a wrong answer.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate#3
records.source: OPERANDS ARE NAMES, NOT COPIES, and that is the whole design decision. Holding copies would make ``mask`` self-contained, which is tidier -- and would mean that adjusting one of the gates being combined left the composite showing the old shape, silently, for as long as nobody looked. One source of truth costs a resolver; two sources cost a wrong answer.
records.translation: Operands eru nafn, ekki kopíur, og það er allt konar ákvörðun. Holding kopies myndi gera ``mask`` sjálfstætt, sem er merki - og myndi þýða að viðhald einn af gögnum-gate takmarka sem eru sameiginlegur yfirgefið sýnir gamla form, þögulega, svo lengi að enginn lítur.

records.context: if the operation is not one of :data:`COMPOSITE_OPS`, if fewer than two operands survive stripping, if the data-selection boundary lists itself, or if an operand is repeated -- a data-selection boundary unioned with itself is itself and subtracted from itself is empty, so neither is likely to be what was meant.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate.__post_init__#1
records.source: if the operation is not one of :data:`COMPOSITE_OPS`, if fewer than two operands survive stripping, if the gate lists itself, or if an operand is repeated -- a gate unioned with itself is itself and subtracted from itself is empty, so neither is likely to be what was meant.
records.translation: ef verkefnið er ekki einn af :data:`COMPOSITE_OPS`, ef minna en tvö starfsmenn lifir úr skreytingu, ef gate hringinn listar sjálfur, eða ef starfsmann er endurtekinu - gögnin-sálun hringurinn tengist sjálfur er sjálfur og afgreiður frá sjálfum er óþægilegt, þannig að það er ekki jafnvel líklegt að vera það sem var áætlað.

records.context: A composite that guessed would be guessing about data-selection boundaries it cannot see. :meth:`GateSet.columns_for` answers this properly.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate.columns#1
records.source: A composite that guessed would be guessing about gates it cannot see. :meth:`GateSet.columns_for` answers this properly.
records.translation: A samsetur sem ákvað væri að gleyma um gate sem það er ekki hægt að sjá. :meth:`GateSet.columns_for` svara þetta rétt.

records.context: Always refuses: a composite names other data-selection boundaries and cannot stand alone.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate.mask#0
records.source: Always refuses: a composite names other gates and cannot stand alone.
records.translation: Alltaf neita: samsettu nafni önnur gate og getur ekki stått einn.

records.context: It says who to ask. Evaluating this needs the data-selection boundaries it combines, and only the set holding them can look them up -- so the refusal names the operands and points at the set rather than returning an empty mask that would read as "nothing matched".
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate.mask#1
records.source: IT SAYS WHO TO ASK. Evaluating this needs the gates it combines, and only the set holding them can look them up -- so the refusal names the operands and points at the set rather than returning an empty mask that would read as "nothing matched".
records.translation: Það segir hver til að spyrja. Ákvarðanir þetta þarf gate sem það kombinerar, og aðeins setur sem halda þá getur skoðað þá upp - þannig að neita nefnir starfsmanna og punktur á setinu en að endurheimta laust maski sem myndi lesa "nothing matched".

records.context: Evaluate against a name -> data-selection boundary mapping.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate.mask_with#0
records.source: Evaluate against a name -> gate mapping.
records.translation: Hægt er að mæta við nafni -> gate grænsku mappingu.

records.context: Unchanged: moving a composite would have to move its operands, and those are other data-selection boundaries with their own users.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CompositeGate.translated#0
records.source: Unchanged: moving a composite would have to move its operands, and those are other gates with their own users.
records.translation: Unchanged: flytja samsetningu ætti að flytja operandi sína, og þeir eru aðrar gate með eigin notendur.

records.context: The cylinder. The user draws in 2D on the image layer they chose -- which is the only place a drag has a microplate sample position-defined meaning -- and the shape is extended along the axis pointing out of it.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gate_spec.CylinderGate#1
records.source: The cylinder. The user draws in 2D on the plane they chose -- which is the only place a drag has a well-defined meaning -- and the shape is extended along the axis pointing out of it.
records.translation: og cylindrin. Notandinn trekkar í 2D á myndslagi sem hann hefur valið - sem er eina staðurinn sem snúið hefur brunninn staðsetningu-defined þýðingu - og formurinn er breytt í gegnum axis sem sýnir út af henni.

records.context: The three columns this data-selection boundary reads: its two radial axes and its height axis.

records.context: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a background execution unit, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the execution concurrency rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a main GUI execution path object, never a closure, so the handler executes on the main GUI execution path and the QThread is retired. Given the application view's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a key-value mapping lookup.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.gene_panel#9
records.source: So :func:`warm_annotation` does all of it on a worker thread, through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, which is the module that already gets the threading rules right: the worker's ``finished`` is relayed through a Signal whose receiver is a bound method of a GUI-thread object, never a closure, so the handler runs on the GUI thread and the QThread is retired. Given the screen's own terms it warms every gene in one join -- 400 genes cost the same 21 ms as one -- after which a click is a dictionary lookup.
records.translation: Svo :func:`warm_annotation` gerir allt þetta á bakgrunnsreiðslu einkefni, í gegnum :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, sem er mólur sem hefur nú þegar framkvæmd samkeppnunar reglur rétt: ``finished`` vinnsluferli er sendur í gegnum Signal sem viðtalið er tengd aðferð GUI höfuðferð hlut, aldrei lokað, þannig að viðskiptavinur fer á heiminum GUI útgáfu leið og QThread er í friði. Þangað við eigin skilyrði sýningar, það heyrir hvert gén í einu tengingu -- 400 genur kostar sama 21 ms sem einn -- Eftir það er klikk key-value karting lookup.

records.context: The notes are bundled, and the bundle is what is drawn. records.context: Add every image under ``paths``, once a worker has found them.

records.context: Split in two so the main GUI execution path does not block. Everything here is a list of strings and a caption; the walk executes on this panel's own worker (:func:`_walk`, wrapping :func:`images_under`) because it is an `isdir` and a recursive `os.walk` over a path the user chose, which on one such workstation is an `autofs` share that took twenty seconds to answer a single stat. :meth:`_files_found` takes the answer back on the main GUI execution path.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.import_workbench.ImportWorkbench.add_files#1
records.source: Split in two so the GUI thread does not block. Everything here is a list of strings and a caption; the walk runs on this panel's own worker (:func:`_walk`, wrapping :func:`images_under`) because it is an `isdir` and a recursive `os.walk` over a path the user chose, which on one such workstation is an `autofs` share that took twenty seconds to answer a single stat. :meth:`_files_found` takes the answer back on the GUI thread.
records.translation: Skilað í tvö svo að helstu GUI útgáfu leið blokkir ekki. Allt hér er listan á ströndum og viðbót; ferðir út á eigin vinnsluferli á þessu sviði (:func:`_walk`, snúa :func:`images_under`) vegna þess að það er `isdir` og `os.walk` endurnýjandi yfir leið sem notandinn hefur valið, sem á einum slíkum vinnustaði er `autofs` hlut sem tók tíu sekúndur til að svara einn stat. :meth:`_files_found` tekur svarið aftur á helstu GUI framkvæmda leið.

records.context: Not for the main GUI execution path. Every path here is one the user chose, which on a microscope rig means the share the images live on: the `isdir` is what wakes an `autofs` mount, and the walk is thousands more stats behind it. Call it from :func:`_walk` on a worker -- :meth:`ImportWorkbench.add_files` is the only caller in this module and that is what it does.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.import_workbench.images_under#3
records.source: Not for the GUI thread. Every path here is one the user chose, which on a microscope rig means the share the images live on: the `isdir` is what wakes an `autofs` mount, and the walk is thousands more stats behind it. Call it from :func:`_walk` on a worker -- :meth:`ImportWorkbench.add_files` is the only caller in this module and that is what it does.
records.translation: Ekki fyrir höfuðferðin GUI. Hver leið hér er einn sem notandinn velur, sem á mikroskópum ríki þýðir að deila myndum á lífi á: `isdir` er það sem vekur `autofs` fjall, og leiðin er þúsundir af fleiri tölur bak við það. Kalla það frá :func:`_walk` á vinnsluferli - :meth:`ImportWorkbench.add_files` er eina kallaður í þessu moduli og það er það sem það gerir.

records.context: **Hover tooltip.** Move the cursor over the original and a pinned status line shows the pixel intensity for every image data channel plus, when present, the object label at that position from the last segmenta- tion. Same tooltip regardless of which view holds the cursor.

records.source: **Hover tooltip.** Move the cursor over the original and a pinned status line shows the pixel intensity for every channel plus, when present, the object label at that position from the last segmenta- tion. Same tooltip regardless of which view holds the cursor.
records.translation: **Hover tooltip.** Flytja cursor yfir upprunalega og staðsettri stefnu sýnir pixelintæmi fyrir hverri rás plus, þegar til staðar, objektetik á þessum stöðu frá síðasta segment-tion.

records.context: **The model the processing session will use, named on application view.** The panel reads the same setting the workflow reads -- ``pathogen_model`` over ``pathogen_model_name`` for pathogens, ``<object>_model_name`` otherwise (:func:`_model_keys_for`) -- offers the model zoo beside the combo, and names the model that produced the masks on the status line. A checkpoint that is not on this machine previews with cpsam and says so rather than stalling or substituting in silence.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview#8
records.source: **The model the run will use, named on screen.** The panel reads the same setting the pipeline reads -- ``pathogen_model`` over ``pathogen_model_name`` for pathogens, ``<object>_model_name`` otherwise (:func:`_model_keys_for`) -- offers the model zoo beside the combo, and names the model that produced the masks on the status line. A checkpoint that is not on this machine previews with cpsam and says so rather than stalling or substituting in silence.
records.translation: **Mólið sem meðhöndlun verður að nota, heitir á sýn ávöru.** Panelinn les sama settar vinnuflutinn lesar - ``pathogen_model`` yfir ``pathogen_model_name`` fyrir sýkli, ``<object>_model_name`` annars (:func:`_model_keys_for`) - bjóða upp á mönnun zoo við kombo, og nefnir mönnu sem framleiðti maskar á stöðu línu.

records.context: whether the panel's jobs run off the main GUI execution path. False runs each one inline, emitting the same signals in the same order, so a test can drive the panel synchronously without the behaviour diverging.

records.translation: hvort verkefni panelins fer út úr helstu GUI framkvæmdspjallinu. False keyrir hver í tengslum, útgáfa sömu merki í sama orði, þannig að prófið getur dregið panelinn synkrónlega án að hegðun skilyrði.

records.context: This is the inverse of :meth:`settings_for_propagation` and is tested as one: it reads the panel's own key and the ``<object>_`` key Mask declares, such as ``cell_diameter``, so the diameter, flow threshold and cell probability are seeded along with the image data channels.

records.translation: Þetta er á móti :meth:`settings_for_propagation` og er prófað eins: það lesa eigin lykill panelsins og ``<object>_`` lykill Mask segir, eins og ``cell_diameter``, þannig að miðjan, flutningarríði og líkamsþyngd célar eru sætt saman með rás.

records.source: the preview panel this dialog edits. It is also the dialog's parent, and the widgets the dialog lays out belong to the panel rather than to it -- the dialog only knows which rows they sit on, which is what lets a morphology change re-gate them.

records.context: The controls are the panel's and are re-parented in here for the lifetime of the dialog, so their values survive it being closed and reopened. records.translation: Styrkurnar eru panelins og eru endurfæðir hér fyrir lífi samskipti, svo verur þeirra lifir það er lokað og endurhætt. Panelinn er sagt hvaða samskipt er opinn, þannig að morphology breyting getur endur-data-gate gate ránum - widgets lifir á panelinu, en það er samskipta sem veit hvaða rán hver situr á.

records.context: How many of this session's masks the comparison panel can lay over one another: the last eight, oldest dropped first. Each is a full-size label array, and keeping every run would hold them all in memory.

records.context: ``io._rename_and_organize_image_files`` reduces every z-stack to ``np.max`` over its image layers, per microscope field of view and per image data channel, before anything reaches ``stack/``. This is the preview's copy of that, so what the user is looking at is what masking runs on.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.load_preview_mip#1
records.source: ``io._rename_and_organize_image_files`` reduces every z-stack to ``np.max`` over its planes, per field and per channel, before anything reaches ``stack/``. This is the preview's copy of that, so what the user is looking at is what masking runs on.
records.translation: ``io._rename_and_organize_image_files`` lítur hvert z-stack á ``np.max`` yfir myndslagsins, per mikroscope sviði sýn og per rás, áður en eitthvað er að ná ``stack/``. Þetta er kopi þess, þannig að það sem notandi er að horfa á er það sem masking fer á.

records.context: The result is always RGB888, so the caller cannot hand Qt a buffer whose real row length disagrees with the ``w * 3`` stride below. Channel counts other than three are reconciled here — extra channels are dropped, missing ones are filled with black — because a mismatch made ``QImage`` read ``h * w * 3`` bytes out of a buffer that only held ``h * w``.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview.numpy_to_qpixmap#1
records.source: The result is always RGB888, so the caller cannot hand Qt a buffer whose real row length disagrees with the ``w * 3`` stride below. Channel counts other than three are reconciled here — extra channels are dropped, missing ones are filled with black — because a mismatch made ``QImage`` read ``h * w * 3`` bytes out of a buffer that only held ``h * w``.
records.translation: Síðasta er alltaf RGB888, þannig að samtalinn getur ekki gefið Qt buffer sem raunverulegur rán lengd mismunandi við ``w * 3`` stríði hérna. Rás tölur annað en þrír eru samræmi hér - extra rásir eru hættir, saknar eru fyllt með svart - vegna þess að mismatch gerður ``QImage`` lesa ``h * w * 3`` byttur út úr bufferinu sem aðeins hefur ``h * w``.

records.context: Slot 1 stays plain ``organelle``: one organelle is the ordinary case, and numbering it "organelle 1" would relabel every existing screen to say something new about a run that has not changed.

records.context: Split from :meth:`add_paths` so the main GUI execution path does not block on the filesystem. records.translation: Skilja frá :meth:`add_paths` þannig að helstu GUI útgáfur blokkir ekki á skálsystemi. Allt hér er listan af ströndum; ``isdir`` og ``listdir`` sem snúa niður skál í skál sem fer á eigin vinnsluferli þessara útgáfa (:func:`files_under`), vegna þess að drop er útgáf sem notandinn hefur valið og á mikroskópum ríki sem er að deila myndirnar lifandi á - einn stóð undir svefnandi ``autofs`` fjall var mætt á meira en tíu sekúndur, á sjálfstætt útgáfu útgáfum sem litur.

records.source: Not for the GUI thread. records.context: The compact card is intentionally image-first. With propagation enabled, every workflow setting is copied to the main Measure form as it changes.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measure_preview#1
records.source: The compact card is intentionally image-first.  Its ``Crop settings…`` dialog contains the Measure settings that can be evaluated on one merged array: general mask/channel controls, object-crop output controls, measurement filters, and preview-only display controls.  With propagation enabled, every pipeline setting is copied to the main Measure form as it changes.
records.translation: Kompakta kortin er ímynlega mynd-first. ``Crop settings…`` samskipti hennar inniheldur mættingunum sem hægt er að mæla á einum sameiginlegum hliðum: almenn maska/rás stjórn, objekt-myndur-region útgang stjórn, mætting filter, Með því að breyta er auðvelt, hver vinnufluð setting er kopið til höfuðmyndarmyndarinnar eins og það breytist.

records.context: Cell extracted image regions are grouped by three independent companion-object dimensions: nucleated/unnucleated, infected/uninfected, and with/without organelles. records.source: Cell crops are grouped by three independent companion-object dimensions: nucleated/unnucleated, infected/uninfected, and with/without organelles.  This keeps all cells visible while making it explicit which categories would be retained by the current filter settings.
records.translation: Celle myndskurðir myndar svæðum eru samanstendur af þrjá sjálfstætt samskipta-eðli stærð: nukleated / unnucleated, infected / uninfected, og með / án organelles. Þetta hallar allar frumur sýnilegar og gerir það útskýrt hvaða flokkur myndi vera geymt með núverandi filter settingar.

records.context: the preview panel this dialog edits. It is also the dialog's PARENT, and the widgets the dialog lays out belong to the panel rather than to it -- the dialog only knows which rows they sit on, which is what lets a morphology change re-data-selection boundary them.

records.translation: Panelinn byggir stjórnunum spjallinu þegar reikninginn ná það í stað þess að byggja alla 702 upp á framan, þannig að reikning sem hækkar meðan þetta samskipti er opinn kemur sem stjórnun með engum ránum; `_adopt_new_slot_controls` setja þá í blokkinn áður en gate hringinn undir ákvarðanir sem eru sýnt.

records.context: Asked of :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` rather than of ``os.path``. This property is read once per laboratory microplate row by `_fill_table`, and again by `paths`, `screens` and `describe` -- so a project with eight laboratory microplates on a sleeping `autofs` mount was eight twenty-second stats on the main GUI execution path before the tab had drawn anything. The probe answers from a cache, reports a path it has not seen as present, and stats it on its own bounded worker; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` is the half that corrects the row when the real answer lands.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.measurement_scan_panel.AttachedDatabase.present#2
records.source: Asked of :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` rather than of ``os.path``. This property is read once per plate row by `_fill_table`, and again by `paths`, `screens` and `describe` -- so a project with eight plates on a sleeping `autofs` mount was eight twenty-second stats on the GUI thread before the tab had drawn anything. The probe answers from a cache, reports a path it has not seen as present, and stats it on its own bounded worker; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` is the half that corrects the row when the real answer lands.
records.translation: Spurning um :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe` en ekki ``os.path``. Þessi eign er lesið einu sinni í mikrópleti með `_fill_table`, og aftur með `paths`, `screens` og `describe` - þannig að verkefni með átta mikrókrapleti á svefnandi `autofs` fjallinni var átta tólf sekúndur á helstu GUI framkvæmdspjallinu áður en taburinn hafði dregið eitthvað. Spurningarnar svör frá skjölum, útskýra leið sem hann hefur ekki séð sem núverandi, og stýra það á eigin tengd vinnsluferli; `DatabaseMergePanel._follow_path_probes` er hálfa sem korrigerar röð þegar raunverulegur svör landar.

records.context: Called on every click, so it cannot read the databases each time. What it needs is sqlite metadata and the distinct plate ids, a millisecond on a local disk, but the same read on a share that is asleep may not return at all. So it draws from what `refresh` asked for, waits at most :data:`READ_BUDGET_S` for anything not back yet, and says "reading…" for the rest until :meth:`_on_read_landed` corrects it.

records.source: Called on every click, so it cannot read the databases each time. What it needs is sqlite metadata and the distinct plate ids, a millisecond on a local disk, but the same read on a share that is asleep may not return at all. So it draws from what `refresh` asked for, waits at most :data:`READ_BUDGET_S` for anything not back yet, and says "reading…" for the rest until :meth:`_on_read_landed` corrects it.
records.translation: Það sem það er nauðsynlegt er sqlite metadata og mismunandi plata IDs, millisekund á staðbundnum skreymum, en sama lesun á hlutum sem er að sofa getur ekki aftur alls. Þannig kemur það frá því `refresh` spyrja, bíður í meirihluti :data:`READ_BUDGET_S` fyrir eitthvað ekki aftur enn, og segir "reading…" fyrir allt annað þar til :meth:`_on_read_landed` korrigerar það.

records.context: When a dataset's laboratory microplate / microplate sample position / microscope field of view / channel assignment is *inferred* — from a container file's internal structure or from a folder layout — the guess is rarely perfect.
