records.context: ``empty / near-empty fields`` Zero objects is a failure. Fewer than ``seg_qc_min_objects`` (10) is a warning and suppresses the per-microscope field of view robust statistics, because below ten objects a MAD is not a reliable spread estimate — the same threshold at which diameter.py collapses its confidence two levels. If the *laboratory microplate* median is also below that floor (a low-MOI pathogen channel, say), empty microscope fields of view are demoted to a warning: that is a property of the assay, not of the microscope field of view.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#12
records.source: ``empty / near-empty fields`` Zero objects is a failure. Fewer than ``seg_qc_min_objects`` (10) is a warning and suppresses the per-field robust statistics, because below ten objects a MAD is not a reliable spread estimate — the same threshold at which diameter.py collapses its confidence two levels. If the *plate* median is also below that floor (a low-MOI pathogen channel, say), empty fields are demoted to a warning: that is a property of the assay, not of the field.
records.translation: ``empty / near-empty fields`` Zero objekts er mislykkun. Mjög en ``seg_qc_min_objects`` (10) er varning og takmarka per-mikroscope sviði sýn stöðugt tölfræði, vegna þess að undir tíu sviði MAD er ekki áreiðanleg fjölbreytingu uppskattning - sama þröskuldur sem diameter.py rennur trú sína tveimur stigum. Ef *laboratorium mikroskóp* miðjan er einnig undir þeim sviði (mjög-MOI sýkill rás, segja), tölu mikroscóp sviði kynningar eru dæmdur til varning: það er eigandi fyrirmyndarinnar, ekki mikroskop sviði.

records.context: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every image data channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full laboratory microplate that is hours. A laboratory microplate whose segmentation collapsed — an image data channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone, but checking them by hand means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious microscope fields of view, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#2
records.source: ``measure_crop`` is the expensive step in spaCR: it opens every mask, cuts every object out of every channel, computes hundreds of features per object and writes them to SQLite. On a full plate that is hours. A plate whose segmentation collapsed — a channel out of focus, a diameter two-fold wrong, a confluent monolayer that fused into slabs — costs exactly the same hours and then produces a measurement table that has to be thrown away. The failure is obvious from the masks alone, but checking them by hand means opening a thousand ``.npy`` files. Mask statistics can highlight suspicious fields, but cannot establish their cause or validate biological interpretation.
records.translation: ``measure_crop`` er dýrstaða skref í spaCR: það opnar hvert maski, sniður hvert objekt út úr hverjum gögninum á myndum, táknar hundruð eiginleika á hlutum og skrifa þá til SQLite. Á fullri mikrópleti sem er klukkustundir. Mikróplátur sem er að rennast - rás út úr huga, tvöfalt mismunandi miðjandi, samskipt monolayer sem fúsist í skálum - kostar nákvæmlega sömu klukkustundir og þá framleiðir mæslubíl sem þarf að kasta út. Svona er augljóslega frá maskarum einum, en að skoða þá með hönd þýðir að opna þúsund ``.npy`` skrá. Maska tölfræði getur hvetjast misst mikroscópum sviðum lífsins, en getur ekki staðfest orsaka þeirra eða staðfestur líffræðilegur þýðingu.

records.context: This module checks them. It reads the label masks that :mod:`spacr.object` has just written, scores every microscope field of view against a handful of robust statistics, and prints a scorecard naming microscope fields of view that exceed configured thresholds. It changes nothing: ``seg_qc='report'`` (the default) surfaces the flags, it does not silently drop microscope fields of view. Deciding which microscope fields of view to keep is the user's call and it needs the evidence, not a filter.
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#3
records.source: This module checks them. It reads the label masks that :mod:`spacr.object` has just written, scores every field against a handful of robust statistics, and prints a scorecard naming fields that exceed configured thresholds. It changes nothing: ``seg_qc='report'`` (the default) surfaces the flags, it does not silently drop fields. Deciding which fields to keep is the user's call and it needs the evidence, not a filter.
records.translation: Þessi mótulinn lætur þeim. Það lesur merki maskar sem :mod:`spacr.object` hefur bara skrifað, skora hvert mikroscope sviði sýn gegn smá sterka tölfræði, og trúa niðurstöður sem nefnir mikroskóp sviðum sýn sem yfirheyrir uppbyggð takmarkanir. Það breytir ekkert: ``seg_qc='report'`` (þekkt) yfirborði völdum, það drop ekki þögulega mikroskop sviði sjónar. Að ákveða hvaða mikroskróp sviði líta til að halda er notandinn samtal og það þarf vitni, ekki filter.

records.context: Design constraint: this executes right after segmentation on every microscope field of view of the laboratory microplate, so it must be cheap. Everything below is ``np.bincount`` on a label image — microseconds per microscope field of view. The one expensive check (the distance-transform cross-check for fusion) runs *only* on microscope fields of view dense enough for fusion to be the explanation, so a healthy laboratory microplate never pays for it. Like :mod:`spacr.diameter`, this module imports **no torch and no cellpose**; this is tested (see ``tests/test_seg_qc.py``).
records.label: spacr.seg_qc#4
records.source: Design constraint: this runs right after segmentation on every field of the plate, so it must be cheap. Everything below is ``np.bincount`` on a label image — microseconds per field. The one expensive check (the distance-transform cross-check for fusion) runs *only* on fields dense enough for fusion to be the explanation, so a healthy plate never pays for it. Like :mod:`spacr.diameter`, this module imports **no torch and no cellpose**; this is tested (see ``tests/test_seg_qc.py``).
records.translation: Hugbúnaður takmarka: þetta fer strax eftir skammtur á hverri mikroskópum sviði sýningu í mikroskrópum, þannig að það þarf að vera ódýr. Allt hér að neðan er ``np.bincount`` á merki mynd — mikrosekundum á mikroskur sviði. Einn kostar athygli (afstand-transform kross-check fyrir samning) virkar *aðeins* á microscope sviðum sýningu þungur nóg til samning að vera útskýring, svo heilbrigð mikroskerfi má aldrei greiða fyrir það. Eins og :mod:`spacr.diameter`, þessi mólus inn **no torch og ekki cellpose**; þetta er prófað (sjá ``tests/test_seg_qc.py``).

records.context: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`) is neither: it is one act of routing. "Open exactly these twelve objects, because they are the cells this model called infected and the annotator called uninfected." A filter and a selection are *state* that every view reads; a request is an *event* that travels once, from the view that made it to the view that can show it. It carries the reason with it, because a view showing twelve extracted image regions out of ninety thousand has to be able to say why those twelve — otherwise they read as the whole dataset.
records.label: spacr.selection#11
records.source: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`) is neither: it is one act of routing. "Open exactly these twelve objects, because they are the cells this model called infected and the annotator called uninfected." A filter and a selection are *state* that every view reads; a request is an *event* that travels once, from the view that made it to the view that can show it. It carries the reason with it, because a view showing twelve crops out of ninety thousand has to be able to say why those twelve — otherwise they read as the whole dataset.
records.translation: **A request** (:class:`ObjectRequest`) er ekki neitt: það er einn aðferð. „Open nákvæmlega þessar tólf hlutum, vegna þess að þeir eru frumur þessi móður kallað smittir og annotator kallað ósmittir.“ A filter og útval eru *státur* sem hver sýning lesa; ein forrit er *verkefni* sem ferðast einu sinni, frá sýningu sem gerði það til sýning sem getur sýnt það.

records.context: **The object type is part of that identity.** Object tables are one type per table, so without the type a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same microscope field of view compose to the *identical* structured-data name. A cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide, which is where object linking is most useful — four objects would open as three extracted image regions, and which one you got would depend on the row order of ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` keeps the first). The type now goes into the object component of the structured-data name, exactly as :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` writes it

records.source: **The object type is part of that identity.** Object tables are one type per table, so without the type a nucleus labelled 1 and a pathogen labelled 1 in the same field compose to the *identical* key. A cell's own children are exactly the objects most likely to collide, which is where object linking is most useful — four objects would open as three crops, and which one you got would depend on the row order of ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` keeps the first). The type now goes into the object component of the key, exactly as :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` writes it
records.translation: **Object type er hluti af þessari identity.** Object tables eru eitt tegund á tól, þannig að án tegundinni er kjarnað 1 og sýklum 1 í sömu mikroskópum vegabréði samsetur við *identical* byggð gögn-nafn. Sjálfur börn fruman eru nákvæmlega hlutum sem líklegast að snúast, sem er þar sem hlut tengslu er mest gagnlegt - fjórir hlutur myndi opna eins og þrjú myndskurðir myndar svæðum, og hver einn sem þú færð myndi afhyggja á eftirliti af ``png_list`` (:func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` halda fyrstu). Típinn fer nú inn í hlutkomponentin á byggð-data nafn, nákvæmlega eins og :func:`spacr.schema.object_id` skrifa það

records.context: Raised rather than silently dropped. records.source: Raised rather than silently dropped. A filter naming a column that is not there has almost always been carried over from a different table, and quietly ignoring it would narrow the population by less than the user asked for while the UI still showed the filter as active — which reads as "these are all the cells that match" when it is not.
records.translation: A filter sem heitir kolumn sem er ekki þar hefur nánast alltaf verið flutt frá öðru tól, og þögulega að neita það myndi smella fjölmiðla með minna en notandi spurði um meðan UI enn sýndi filter eins aktiv - sem lesa eins og "þetta eru allar frumur sem matnar" þegar það er ekki.

records.context: why these objects, in the words the receiving view will put on application view ("predicted infected, annotated uninfected"). Required and non-blank: a grid showing twelve extracted image regions out of ninety thousand and not saying why is read as the whole dataset.

records.context: Order is preserved and duplicates are dropped. Order is load-bearing: it is what carries "worst errors first" from a confusion-matrix cell through to whatever opens them, and a duplicated key would draw the same extracted image region twice in the grid.

records.context: Public because a *resolver* has to compose the same spelling the producer did. :func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` builds its lookup structured-data names out of ``png_list``'s own metadata columns, and a ``fieldID`` of ``'f_1'`` composes to ``'f%5F1'`` here while a bare ``'_'.join`` composes it to ``'f_1'`` — so a routed selection's structured-data name matched nothing and that extracted image region was silently dropped from the extracted image regions it opened, while its neighbours in the same selection opened normally.
records.label: spacr.selection.escape_key_component#1
records.source: Public because a *resolver* has to compose the same spelling the producer did. :func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` builds its lookup keys out of ``png_list``'s own metadata columns, and a ``fieldID`` of ``'f_1'`` composes to ``'f%5F1'`` here while a bare ``'_'.join`` composes it to ``'f_1'`` — so a routed selection's key matched nothing and that crop was silently dropped from the crops it opened, while its neighbours in the same selection opened normally.
records.translation: Öll vegna þess að *resolver* verður að koma upp sama spelling framleiðandi gerði. :func:`spacr.active_learning.crops_for_object_keys` byggir sögu uppsettur gögn nafn frá eigin metadata stólum ``png_list``, og ``fieldID`` af ``'f_1'`` komst til ``'f%5F1'`` hér, en bara ``'_'.join`` komst það til ``'f_1'`` - þannig að byggð gögn-nafn af rútum útgáfu matched ekkert og að myndskurð myndu svæðið var þögulegt niður úr afgreiddu myndum svæðum sem hún opnaði, Þar sem nágrannar hans í sömu valkostum opnuðu venjulega.

records.source: The one line a reader adds after loading a table, so every key built from the frame afterwards says which of a cell's children it names. Readers are where this belongs: a frame does not know what it is, but whatever ran ``SELECT * FROM nucleus`` does.

records.context: This module is the analysis that happens **after** :func:`spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping` has written its ``unique_combinations.csv`` / ``qc.csv``. It answers the two questions a pooled-screen experimenter asks of a mapping run:

records.source: This module is the analysis that happens **after** :func:`spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping` has written its ``unique_combinations.csv`` / ``qc.csv``. It answers the two questions a pooled-screen experimenter asks of a mapping run:
records.translation: Þessi hugbúnaður er rannsóknin sem gerist **eftir** :func:`spacr.sequencing.generate_barecode_mapping` hefur skrifað sitt ``unique_combinations.csv`` / ``qc.csv``. Það svara tveimur spurningum sem töluður skimun tilraunandi spyr um mapping:

records.context: **Why a module of its own rather than more of** :mod:`spacr.sequencing`: that module is the read path — FASTQ in, count table out — and it is imported into every ``multiprocessing`` worker of a mapping run. The QC here is a separate, later job over the table that path produced; it pulls in plotting and statistics that the read workers must not pay for, and it is the piece a user re-runs a dozen times while choosing a threshold, long after the reads are mapped.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc#4
records.source: **Why a module of its own rather than more of** :mod:`spacr.sequencing`: that module is the read path — FASTQ in, count table out — and it is imported into every ``multiprocessing`` worker of a mapping run. The QC here is a separate, later job over the table that path produced; it pulls in plotting and statistics that the read workers must not pay for, and it is the piece a user re-runs a dozen times while choosing a threshold, long after the reads are mapped.
records.translation: **Hvers vegna að einum móddum er eigin en meira af** :mod:`spacr.sequencing`: þessi móddur er lesning leið - FASTQ inn, tákna tabla út - og það er inn í hvert ``multiprocessing`` vinnsluferli á skáldsþræði. QC hér er sérstök, síðar vinnu yfir skáls sem fer út; það tekur í skálssþræðum og tölfræði sem lesning vinnsluferli þarf ekki að borga fyrir, og það eru hlutinn sem notandi endurskoða tíu sinnum meðan valda takmörk, lengi eftir að lesningar eru skáld.

records.context: The population is fixed — a well that loses its last gRNA stays in the denominator as a zero — and that is what makes the result a non-increasing function of the threshold: every well's count only ever falls, so every order statistic of them only ever falls. Dropping emptied microplate sample positions instead would let the median jump *up* when a sparse well is removed, and a target could then be met at two thresholds far apart with no way to say which was meant.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.WellFractions.statistic_at#1
records.source: The population is fixed — a well that loses its last gRNA stays in the denominator as a zero — and that is what makes the result a non-increasing function of the threshold: every well's count only ever falls, so every order statistic of them only ever falls. Dropping emptied wells instead would let the median jump *up* when a sparse well is removed, and a target could then be met at two thresholds far apart with no way to say which was meant.
records.translation: Sýningin er stöðugt - björn sem tapar síðasta gRNA stendur í tákninu eins og null - og það er það sem gerir niðurstaðan ekki hækkað virkefni þröskuldur: sumur hverra björnu aðeins fallir, þannig að hverrar tölur þeirra bara fallir. Í staðinn, að drepa mikrónaplaðs staðar myndi láta miðjan hopp *up* þegar sparsæri vel er fjarlægð, og markmiðið gæti þá verið náð á tveimur hliðum langt frá með engin leið til að segja hvaða var áætlað.

records.context: Only substitutions are considered, and only within a reference set. Indels would change the barcode's length and so shift every field after it in the read, which the regex rejects outright rather than mis-assigning; and a row barcode cannot be confused with a gRNA barcode because they are read out of different positions.
records.label: spacr.sequencing_qc.barcode_collisions#2
records.source: Only substitutions are considered, and only within a reference set. Indels would change the barcode's length and so shift every field after it in the read, which the regex rejects outright rather than mis-assigning; and a row barcode cannot be confused with a gRNA barcode because they are read out of different positions.
records.translation: Endels myndi breyta lengd ræðalega og svo skipta hvert sjónsvið eftir það í lesunni, sem reggae neita út rétt en ekki missa; og ræðar ræðakódur getur ekki verið blandað með gRNA ræðalkód vegna þess að þeir eru lesin út úr mismunandi stöðum.

records.context: QC a barcode-mapping run and derive its abundance threshold from a target.

records.context: the library as designed — names from the gRNA reference. Supplying it lets the dropout be reported ("2% of the library was never seen") rather than only the observed count, which shows whether the screening experiment has the coverage it was powered for.

records.source: the library as designed — names from the gRNA reference. Supplying it lets the dropout be reported ("2% of the library was never seen") rather than only the observed count, which shows whether the screen has the coverage it was powered for.
records.translation: bókasafn eins og áætlað — nafn frá gRNA tengslum. Með því að veita það leyfa að niðurstaða sé sýnt ("2% af bókasafninu var aldrei séð") í stað þess að aðeins athygli fjölda, sem sýnir hvort skimun reynslu hefur takmörk sem það var veitt fyrir.

records.context: A pooled screening experiment is pipetted, and pipetting has geometry: an edge row that dried, a column the multichannel missed. records.source: A pooled screen is pipetted, and pipetting has geometry: an edge row that dried, a column the multichannel missed. Both show up as a whole row or column of wells sitting at a different depth from the rest of the plate, and both bias every per-well fraction computed inside them.
records.translation: A kombinuð skríning tilraun er pipetted, og pipetting hefur geometría: hliðarræði sem þurrkur, kolumn sem multichannel missed. Bæði sýna sig eins og helri ræði eða kolumn brunnar stöðu sitja á mismunandi djúpt frá öðrum mikróðum rannsóknarplatta, og bæði bias hvert per-mikróplata stöðu hlut sem er reiknað inn í þeim.

records.context: DataFrame ``[prc, plateID, rowID, columnID, reads, n_grnas]`` sorted by ``reads`` ascending, so the starved end of the plate reads off the top.

records.context: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.label: spacr.submodules#2
records.source: Four spaCR tiles currently share this landing page, but they answer different biological questions.  :func:`analyze_plaques` segments plaque images and summarizes plaque number and area.  :func:`analyze_recruitment` measures a fluorescent marker around pathogens or vacuoles relative to host cytoplasm. :func:`analyze_invasion` uses differential pre/post-permeabilization staining to classify parasites as attached outside or invaded inside a host cell. :func:`analyze_replication` counts parasites within each parasitophorous vacuole and compares the resulting replication-state distributions.  Cellpose training, testing, and model-application utilities also live here, but they are not substitutes for those four assay entry points.
records.translation: Fjórir spaCR tileir eru núna að deila þessa landingssíðu, en þeir svara mismunandi líkfræðilegar spurningar. :func:`analyze_plaques` segmentir plaque myndir og summarizes plaque fjölda og sviði. :func:`analyze_recruitment` mætur fluorescent markera um sýkil eða vacuoles í samræmi við umfrymi hýsils. :func:`analyze_invasion` notar skilgreiningar pre/post-permeabilization litun til að græða parásitum sem tengjast út eða inn í hýsli. :func:`analyze_replication` heitir parásíum í hverjum parasitophorous vacuole og samanburður niðurstöður replication-state útbreytingar.Cellpose þjálfun, prófa, og mönnun-tilefni notendur einnig hér, en þau eru ekki staðsettir fyrir þessum fjórum skammála.

records.context: Plaque analysis writes ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` with ``summary``, ``stats``, and ``details`` tables.  Recruitment returns per-object and per-well DataFrames and writes their CSVs and plots.  Invasion returns per-parasite classifications, per-microscope field of view thresholds and QC, per-well efficiencies, condition summaries and comparisons, controls, and figures; saved runs place those artifacts under ``results/analyze_invasion``. Replication returns per-vacuole counts, well and condition distributions, pairwise and omnibus statistics, figures, and the grouping method actually used, with saved output under ``results/analyze_replication``.  Model utilities produce trained weights, evaluation tables, masks, and object summaries as appropriate.
records.label: spacr.submodules#6
records.source: Plaque analysis writes ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` with ``summary``, ``stats``, and ``details`` tables.  Recruitment returns per-object and per-well DataFrames and writes their CSVs and plots.  Invasion returns per-parasite classifications, per-field thresholds and QC, per-well efficiencies, condition summaries and comparisons, controls, and figures; saved runs place those artifacts under ``results/analyze_invasion``. Replication returns per-vacuole counts, well and condition distributions, pairwise and omnibus statistics, figures, and the grouping method actually used, with saved output under ``results/analyze_replication``.  Model utilities produce trained weights, evaluation tables, masks, and object summaries as appropriate.
records.translation: Áhugbúnaður skrifa ``<src>/masks/plaques_analysis.db`` með ``summary``, ``stats`` og ``details`` tólum. Rekrutning endurheimtir per-object og per-well DataFrames og skrifa CSVs og plots. Invasion endurheimtir per-parasítaklassifi, per-mikroscope sviði líkamlegir og QC, per-well efnahagslegir, ástæða samsetningar og samræmi, stjórnun, og tölur; Sjálfur rúnir stað þessar tegundir undir ``results/analyze_invasion``. Replika endurheimtir per-vakuole reikningar, bót og tilstandsbreytingar, pairwise og omnibus tölur, tölur og hópningsmetan sem virkilega er notað, með sparað afleiðing undir ``results/analyze_replication``. Mönnun tækjum framleiða þjálfað vægi, tákn tól, maskar, og efni samræmi eins og viðeigandi.

records.context: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use microplate sample positions rather than treating parasites from one microplate sample position as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the microplate sample position scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.label: spacr.submodules#9
records.source: The analysis unit matters.  Invasion is inferred from *absence* of outside stain, so weak staining can only inflate the invaded fraction; thresholds are therefore recorded per field and statistics use wells rather than treating parasites from one well as independent replicates.  Replication groups by vacuole, not by host cell, because one cell can contain several vacuoles; 3, 5, 6, and 7 parasites remain in an explicit non-power-of-two QC bucket instead of being rounded into a biologically expected class.  Plaque area is calibrated against the well scale when available, so comparisons should retain the acquisition metadata that defines that scale.
records.translation: Það er mikilvægt að analýsa einkefni. Invasion er niðurstaðað frá *absence* útlendis stain, þannig að slæmt stain getur aðeins inflatir innraðra hluta; Þess vegna eru takmarkanir skráð á sviði og gögn nota mikróplata staðar í stað þess að meðhöndla parásit frá einum mikróblata staður sem sjálfstætt replikater. Replika hópur af vacuole, ekki af hýsli frumu, vegna þess að einn frumu getur innihald nokkrar vacuoles; 3, 5, 6 og 7 parasitas eru enn í óþægilegu QC hlifunum í stað þess að vera rundað í biológlega áætlað flokki. Plaque svæðið er kalíbrerað gegn mikróplaðstæða skala þegar það er til staðar, þannig að samanburðir ættu að halda upphæðin metadata sem skilgreina þessi skala.

records.context: The design follows from this asymmetry. "Inside" is defined by an absence, and absence is the unreliable direction. Poor antibody penetration, a focal image layer off the parasite's equator, photobleaching, a low-expressing parasite — every one of them removes outside signal from a parasite that is outside, and every one of them therefore *inflates* invasion efficiency. Nothing plausible pushes the error the other way. The threshold on the outside image data channel is the single number the assay rests on, so it is derived from the data, reported per microscope field of view in ``fields``, cross-checked against a control-derived cut when one exists, and bracketed by a sensitivity pair that says how much of the answer is the threshold.
records.label: spacr.submodules.analyze_invasion#4
records.source: The design follows from this asymmetry. "Inside" is defined by an absence, and absence is the unreliable direction. Poor antibody penetration, a focal plane off the parasite's equator, photobleaching, a low-expressing parasite — every one of them removes outside signal from a parasite that is outside, and every one of them therefore *inflates* invasion efficiency. Nothing plausible pushes the error the other way. The threshold on the outside channel is the single number the assay rests on, so it is derived from the data, reported per field in ``fields``, cross-checked against a control-derived cut when one exists, and bracketed by a sensitivity pair that says how much of the answer is the threshold.
records.translation: Hugmyndin fylgir af þessu óþekktum. "Inside" er ákveðið af óþekkingu, og óþykkt er ótrúlegri leið. Sjúkrandi andstæðing, hámarklæði mynd út af eyðimörkinum parasita, fotoblaaching, níu útskýrandi parasita - hver þeirra fjarlægur útlendisign frá parasita sem er utan, og hver þeirra vegna þess *ýkir* skilvirkni innrásar. Það er ekkert áreiðanlegt dreifir mistökina á annan hátt. records.context: 1. A suggestion is never confusable with a decision. Suggestions are stored as their own values -- a suggested 1 becomes 11 -- so nothing that reads the annotation column can mistake one for a human's answer, and a processing session that goes wrong is undone by deleting a value rather than by remembering which rows were touched. 2. A suggestion never overwrites an annotation. Writes carry ``IS NULL``. Not when the model is confident, not on a repeat execution. A human's labels are the ground truth the model was fitted on; losing one silently would cost hours and would not be noticed until a processing session came out wrong. 3. There is no confidence floor; the order carries the uncertainty. Every unannotated extracted image region gets a suggestion, sorted most-confident first, and the reviewer stops where they stop agreeing. A threshold would make that decision with an arbitrary number. 4. A judgement is recorded, not inferred. Confirming a suggestion turns it into an ordinary label and rejecting one clears it -- and both are written down beside the column, in ``<column>_verdict``, as the class that was confirmed (``+c``) or rejected (``-c``). A rejection is information the next round can train on -- "not class 1" is an example of class 2 in a two-class column -- whereas a NULL would record nothing. The verdict column is added the first time a source is opened, so tables made before it existed gain it without a migration step.
records.label: spacr.suggest#4

records.context: The timeflows plan rests on one claim about the training data: an object keeps the same label in every frame it appears in. A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.
records.label: spacr.timeflows_qc#2

A time-flow head is trained to point from a pixel of an object in frame ``t`` at that object's centre in frame ``t+1``, and the only thing that says which object in ``t+1`` is the same object is the label. If the annotation recycles a label after its object dies or leaves, the model is trained to point at an unrelated cell, and no later score catches it -- the held-out check scrambles the same wrong labels and agrees with itself.

Tím flutningshóp er þjálfað til að sýna frá pikseli af hlutum í rammi ``t`` á miðjum hlutina í ramma ``t+1``, og eina sem segir hvaða hlutur í ``t+1`` er sömu hlutur er merkin. Ef merkin endurreiktir merkið eftir að hlutur hans deyja eða látið, táknar mönnun til að kynna á ekki tengt frumu, og enginn síðar tákna það - hold-out checkambles sömu mismunandi merki og samþykkir sig.

records.context: ``run_ids`` the runs that contributed settings, in order. ``changed`` ``[{'key', 'values': {run_id: value}}]`` for structured-data names present in every contributing run whose values differ — the signal. ``env`` same shape, for structured-data names :func:`is_env_key` classifies as environment drift. Never merged into ``changed``. ``drift`` ``[{'key', 'present': [...], 'missing': [...]}]`` — schema drift. ``same`` / ``shared`` counts of unchanged and shared keys. ``identical`` True when two or more runs contributed settings and nothing at all differs. Callers must say "no differences" rather than render an empty table. ``no_settings`` run ids that had no settings to contribute. ``env_manifest`` the manifest ``env`` diff, when the folders are run-journal runs.

records.context: Computing the position as ``sorted({nucleus, cell, pathogen, organelle})`` instead agrees with role order only when the roles are in ascending image data channel order. With ``nucleus_channel=2, cell_channel=0, organelle_channel=1`` the stack is ``[2, 0, 1]`` -- raw image data channel 1 sits at position 2 -- while the sorted reading gives position 1, which holds the cell image. Cellpose would then segment organelles on the cell image layer without any warning, and downstream counts and intensities would be measured from the wrong masks.
records.label: spacr.utils.dense_mask_channel_positions#2
records.source: Computing the position as ``sorted({nucleus, cell, pathogen, organelle})`` instead agrees with role order only when the roles are in ascending channel order. With ``nucleus_channel=2, cell_channel=0, organelle_channel=1`` the stack is ``[2, 0, 1]`` -- raw channel 1 sits at position 2 -- while the sorted reading gives position 1, which holds the cell image. Cellpose would then segment organelles on the cell plane without any warning, and downstream counts and intensities would be measured from the wrong masks.
records.translation: Að reikna stöðu sem ``sorted({nucleus, cell, pathogen, organelle})`` í staðinn samþykkir hlutfallarráð aðeins þegar hlutfallin eru í auglýsingu myndur gögnum táknarráð. Með ``nucleus_channel=2, cell_channel=0, organelle_channel=1`` er stack ``[2, 0, 1]`` - raust rás 1 situr á staðinn 2 - en skipulegt lesing gefur staðinn 1, sem hallar fruman mynd. Cellpose myndi þá segma organelles á frumunni myndslagi án þess að varna, og downstream tölur og hjarta myndi verið metnað frá mismunandi maskar.

records.context: path to any file PIL can open. It is forced through ``convert('RGB')``, so a 16-bit or float microscopy TIFF is downcast to 8-bit and a single-image data channel image is replicated across three image data channels rather than rejected -- the dynamic range of a raw scientific image is lost here, so rescale to 8-bit yourself if that matters. Aspect ratio is not preserved: ``Resize((224, 224))`` takes both dimensions, so non-square extracted image regions are stretched, not letterboxed. Returns a ``(1, 3, 224, 224)`` tensor with the batch axis already added, so it can be fed to a model directly but must be concatenated, not stacked, to batch several images.
records.label: spacr.utils.load_image#2
records.source: path to any file PIL can open. It is forced through ``convert('RGB')``, so a 16-bit or float microscopy TIFF is downcast to 8-bit and a single-channel image is replicated across three channels rather than rejected -- the dynamic range of a raw scientific image is lost here, so rescale to 8-bit yourself if that matters. Aspect ratio is not preserved: ``Resize((224, 224))`` takes both dimensions, so non-square crops are stretched, not letterboxed. Returns a ``(1, 3, 224, 224)`` tensor with the batch axis already added, so it can be fed to a model directly but must be concatenated, not stacked, to batch several images.
records.translation: leið til hvaða skrá PIL er hægt að opna. Það er forðast í gegnum ``convert('RGB')``, þannig að 16-bit eða float microscopy TIFF er niður til 8-bit og einn rás mynd er endurspeglað í gegnum þrjá rás en ekki neitað - dynamic range af raust vísindalegu mynd er tapt hér, svo skalað til 8 bits sjálfur ef það er mikilvægt. Aspect samning er ekki geymt: ``Resize((224, 224))`` tekur bæði stærð, svo ekki-square mynda svæðum eru þreytt, ekki boksað. Það endurheimtir ``(1, 3, 224, 224)`` þreytingu með batch axis þegar lagt, svo það getur verið mat á mönnun beint en þarf að vera smellandi, ekki stacked, til mörgum myndum.

records.context: the raw setting value. A string is stripped and, if it case-insensitively matches one of the "no filter" spellings (``""``, ``"none"``, ``"null"``, ``"all"``, ``"all_channels"``, ``"all channels"``, ``"*"``), collapsed to ``None`` -- otherwise the stripped string is returned as a feature-name substring. Anything that is not a string (a real ``None``, or a list of channels) passes through untouched, so this is safe to apply unconditionally to whatever the settings key-value mapping holds. Note ``"*"`` means *no filter*, not a glob: real patterns are not supported, and the surviving string is matched as a plain substring of the column name.
records.label: spacr.utils.normalize_feature_filter#2
records.source: the raw setting value. A string is stripped and, if it case-insensitively matches one of the "no filter" spellings (``""``, ``"none"``, ``"null"``, ``"all"``, ``"all_channels"``, ``"all channels"``, ``"*"``), collapsed to ``None`` -- otherwise the stripped string is returned as a feature-name substring. Anything that is not a string (a real ``None``, or a list of channels) passes through untouched, so this is safe to apply unconditionally to whatever the settings dict holds. Note ``"*"`` means *no filter*, not a glob: real patterns are not supported, and the surviving string is matched as a plain substring of the column name.
records.translation: Þess vegna er hræðilegt hlutverki. A stringa er skreyt og, ef það samsvarar tilfinnilega við einn af "no filter" leikjum (``""``, ``"none"``, ``"null"``, ``"all"``, ``"all_channels"``, ``"all channels"``, ``"*"``), kollapsed til ``None`` - annars skreytt stringa verður aftur sem eiginleika-nafn substring. Allt sem er ekki stringa (eð raunverulegt ``None`` eða listan af rásum) fer í gegnum óttað, þannig að þetta er örugg að velja óþekkt á hvaða settingar key-value mapping halda. Nota ``"*"`` þýðir *no filter*, ekki globa: raunverulegur mönnun er ekki stuðlað, og yfirleitt stringa er samræmi eins og hrein substring á nafni stefnu.

records.context: 3-channel ``(H, W, 3)`` image already scaled to ``[0, 1]``. It is added to the colormap rather than blended, so a ``[0, 255]`` image swamps the heatmap and the result is a near-uniform wash. A 2-D grayscale array fails to broadcast against the 3-channel heatmap. An image negative enough that the blend has no positive pixel left raises ``ValueError`` rather than returning a black frame, because a black attribution map cannot be distinguished from a map with no attribution.
records.label: spacr.utils.show_cam_on_image#2
records.source: 3-channel ``(H, W, 3)`` image already scaled to ``[0, 1]``. It is added to the colormap rather than blended, so a ``[0, 255]`` image swamps the heatmap and the result is a near-uniform wash. A 2-D grayscale array fails to broadcast against the 3-channel heatmap. An image negative enough that the blend has no positive pixel left raises ``ValueError`` rather than returning a black frame, because a black attribution map cannot be distinguished from a map with no attribution.
records.translation: 3 rás ``(H, W, 3)`` mynd er þegar skalað til ``[0, 1]``. Það er lagt á litaraðinu í stað þess að blanda, þannig að ``[0, 255]`` mynd svampar heittaraðina og niðurstöður er nánast einstaka þvo. A 2-D grayscale útgáfu er ekki sendur gegn 3-rás heittari. Myndin neikvæð nóg að blendinn hefur engin jákvæð pixel hlið uppheyrir ``ValueError`` en að koma aftur svarta ramma, vegna þess að svarta viðbótaraðilaðila getur ekki verið skilgreint frá kartunni með engin viðbótar.
